steps: with sharp knife , slice about 1" off top of each artichoke cut off stem near base with scissors , trim about 1 / 2" off top of each leaf with sharp knife , halve each artichoke vertically then scoop out and discard the fuzzy center of choke place artichoke halves in your crock pot add hot water and lemon slices cover and cook on high 4 to 5 hours or low for 8 to 10 hours or until done drain and serve with lemon butter sauce , as below lemon butter sauce---------------- combine all ingredients

name: Crock pot fried chicken
ingredients: chicken drumsticks|butter|flour|seasoning salt|italian seasoning|onion powder|paprika|black pepper
steps: combine all the spices and the flour in a freezer bag or in a shallow dish dredge each chicken piece well , and plop into your crockpot i used the shallow dish method , because we were out of freezer bags when all the chicken is in the crock , pour 1 / 4 cup of melted butter over it cook on high for 6 hours or on low for 8-10 hours

name: Crock pot frijoles refritos refried beans
ingredients: dried pinto bean|water|sea salt|vidalia onion|garlic cloves|extra virgin olive oil|fresh green chile|jalapenos|ground cumin
steps: sort & rinse beans place in crockpot , cover with water and soak 8 hours or overnight drain water from beans & rinse again remove water from the crockpot and rinse again place back in crock pot and add water & salt cover and cook on low 10 hours reserving liquid , drain beans & place in bowl heat oil in skillet & saute onions and garlic over medium heat until tender transfer to blender add chilies , cumin , and jalepenos , and blend until smooth add cooked beans to blender and blend until smooth pour into crock pot stir well and gradually add reserved liquid until beans reach desired consistency cook on high 20-30 minutes

name: Crock pot frozen meatballs cranberry chipotle
ingredients: meatballs|jellied cranberry sauce|pineapple chunks|brown sugar|chipotle chile
steps: place meatballs in the crock pot in a small bowl , combine remaining ingredients , mixing well pour over meatballs cook on lo heat 4-5 hours serve with toothpicks

name: Crock pot fruited oatmeal
ingredients: milk|brown sugar|butter|salt|cinnamon|rolled oats|apple|raisins|walnuts
steps: grease the inside of the crock pot put all ingredients and mix with a whisk cover just before going to bed , turn the crock pot on low the cereal will be ready in the morning serve with milk or cream

name: Crock pot fudge and cream pudding cake
ingredients: unsalted butter|all-purpose flour|light brown sugar|unsweetened cocoa|baking powder|cinnamon|salt|light cream|vegetable oil|vanilla|dark brown sugar|hot water|whipped cream
steps: coat inside of crock pot with butter combine flour , brown sugar , 3 tbsp cocoa , baking powder , cinnamon , and salt in bowl add cream , oil and vanilla stir well to combine pour into crock pot combine dark brown sugar and remaining 2 tbsp cocoa into medium bowl add hot water , stir well to combine pour sauce over cake batter do not stir cover , cook on high for 2 hours let cook , spoon out add whipped cream if desired

name: Crock pot game hen
ingredients: rock cornish game hen|garlic cloves|yellow onions|water|chicken bouillon cube|parsley|garlic salt|pepper|onion powder
steps: place onion slices in crock pot stuff bird cavity with whole garlic cloves rub seasonings on outside of bird place bird on onion bed add 1-2 inches of water to crock pot with boullion cube cook 5-6 hrs on low bird is done when drumstick pulls out easily

name: Crock pot game hens
ingredients: rock cornish game hens|your favorite dressing
steps: fix dressing and stuff into game hens seal each hen separately and tightly in aluminum foil seal any leftover dressing tightly in foil place sealed hens in crock pot with extra dressing packet on top cook on low 12 hours

name: Crock pot garbonzo bean soup with pepperoni
ingredients: onion|potatoes|garbanzo beans|minced garlic cloves|chicken broth|flavoring|pepperoni
steps: saute chopped onion in a little olive oil , until fragrant add all ingredients , except pepperoni , to crockpot cook on low for 6 hours once done cooking , stir in pepperoni and serve

name: Crock pot garlic brown sugar chicken
ingredients: chicken|brown sugar|vinegar|sprite|garlic|soy sauce|pepper
steps: place chicken in crock pot mix all remaining ingredients and pour over chicken cook on low for 6-8 hours serve over rice or noodles you can thicken the juices after cooking with a little cornstarch

name: Crock pot garlic garlic garlic chicken
ingredients: fresh thyme|fresh rosemary|fresh sage|fresh italian parsley|chicken broth|garlic|salt|ground black pepper|whole chickens|celery|french bread
steps: place 1 sprig thyme , rosemary , sage and parsley in chicken cavity place celery in crock pot put chicken on top of celery pour chicken stock around the chicken add garlic around chicken chop remaining herbs sprinkle herbs , salt and pepper over chicken cover cook on low 8- 10 hours or on high 4- 6 hours to serve , place chicken , garlic and celery on serving platter squeeze roasted garlic out of skins onto toasted french bread slices and spread with knife enjoy !

name: Crock pot garlic mashed potatoes
ingredients: baking potatoes|water|butter|salt|black pepper|garlic cloves|milk
steps: toss potatoes , water , butter , salt , pepper , and garlic and put them into the crock pot cook the potatoes for 4 hours on high or 7 hours on low in the crock pot add milk and mash the potatoes

name: Crock pot garlic pork with sweet potatoes
ingredients: canola oil|boneless pork loin roast|salt|fresh ground black pepper|onion|garlic cloves|poultry seasoning|white wine|sweet potatoes|chicken broth
steps: if there is a lot of visible fat on the pork roast , trim it away in a large , heavy skillet , heat oil over medium-high heat sprinkle salt and pepper on pork roast , then brown roast in hot oil on all sides , for about 10 minutes total time remove browned roast to a plate and temporarily set aside in fat in skillet , saute sliced onion and minced garlic , seasoned with the poultry seasoning , just until onion starts to soften place in bottom of slow cooker turn heat to high and add white wine to skillet scrape up all the bits sticking to skillet , then pour this mixture over the onions in the crock pot cover onions with cubed raw sweet potato place browned pork roast on top of sweet potato cubes , then pour chicken stock over roast cover and cook on low power for for 7 to 8 hours , or until sweet potatoes are tender and pork is cooked

name: Crock pot garlic rice pilaf
ingredients: butter|garlic cloves|long grain brown rice|chicken broth|salt|pepper
steps: melt butter in a saucepan , add rice and garlic , saute until golden add 2 cups of chicken broth and bring to a boil place into crock pot , with remaining 3 cups of broth cook on high , 4-5 hours

name: Crock pot garlic smashed red potatoes
ingredients: red potatoes|garlic cloves|olive oil|salt|water|cream cheese with chives and onions|milk
steps: halve or quarter potatoes as necessary to make similar size pieces place in a 4 to 6 quart crock pot add garlic , oil , salt and water mix well to coat all potato pieces cover and cook on high for 3-1 / 2 to 4-1 / 2 hours or until potato pieces are tender with a fork or potato masher , mash potatoes and garlic stir in cream cheese until well blended stir in enough milk for soft serving consistency serve immediately , or cover and hold in slow cooker on low setting for up to 2 hours i have used a 3 ounce piece of cream cheese , cubed , in place of the tub of cream cheese and chives and onions

name: Crock pot garlic rosemary chicken breast
ingredients: boneless skinless chicken breasts|minced garlic cloves|butter|chicken broth|rosemary|salt|pepper|parsley flakes
steps: place butter and garlic in microwave-safe bowl and heat until butter is soft blend together roll chicken breasts in garlic-butter mixture and place in crock pot sprinkle chicken breasts with salt , pepper , parsley and rosemary add broth to bowl with remaining garlic-butter , reheat if necessary to allow smooth blending , and add mixture to crock pot cook on low setting for 6 - 8 hours serving size is approximately half a chicken breast and a small amount of sauce

name: Crock pot ginger orange rhubarb
ingredients: rhubarb|water|caster sugar|oranges, juice and rind of|preserved ginger in syrup
steps: place all the ingredients in your crock pot and mix well cook on low for 4 to 6 hours let it cool and then chill in the fridge until ready to serve , it will thicken somewhat when it is cooling and the flavors will mellow

name: Crock pot ginger beef curry
ingredients: chuck steaks|onions|ginger|garlic cloves|turmeric|paprika|ground cumin|ground coriander|cardamom|ground cloves|ground red pepper|ground nutmeg|cinnamon stick|tomato paste|water|fresh cilantro|salt
steps: combine onions , ginger , garlic , cinnamon stick , turmeric , and paprika in crock pot coat beef strips with flour and add to crock pot add cumin , coriander , cardamom , cloves , red pepper and nutmeg in a small bowl mix tomato paste and water add to crock pot cook on low for 8 to 9 hours stir in cilantro add salt to taste

name: Crock pot ginger chicken
ingredients: soy sauce|water|brown sugar|gingerroot|chicken thighs
steps: mix soy sauce , water , brown sugar and ginger and pour into a crock pot put in as many chicken thighs as can be covered with sauce cook 4 to 6 hours on low i like to quickly crisp up the chicken under the broiler before serving

name: Crock pot ginger teriyaki pork chops
ingredients: marinade|brown sugar|fresh gingerroot|center-cut pork loin chops
steps: mix kikkoman teriyaki sauce , brown sugar and ginger together place chops in crock pot pour sauce over the chops cook on low for 7 hours

name: Crock pot gingerbread pudding cake
ingredients: nonstick cooking spray|gingerbread mix|milk|raisins|water|brown sugar|butter|vanilla ice cream
steps: lightly coat the inside of a 3-1 / 2 or 4-quart slow cooker with cooking spray set aside in a medium bowl stir together the gingerbread mix and milk until moistened stir in raisins spread gingerbread batter evenly in the bottom of the prepared cooker in a medium saucepan combine water , brown sugar , and butter bring to boiling carefully pour sugar mixture over batter in cooker cover and cook on high heat for 2 hours turn off cooker , or , if possible , remove liner from cooker let stand , uncovered , for 45 minutes before serving to serve: spoon warm cake into dessert dishes if desired , serve with vanilla ice cream

name: Crock pot gingered pineapple chicken
ingredients: boneless chicken breast halves|green onion|crushed pineapple|crystallized ginger|lemon juice|low sodium soy sauce|brown sugar|garlic powder
steps: combine all ingredients in the crock pot cover and cook on low for 8 hours serve with rice or flat noodles

name: Crock pot glazed carrots
ingredients: carrot|brown sugar|butter|water|ground cinnamon
steps: place all ingredients into a lightly sprayed 2 quart slow cooker stir together place lid on slow cooker and cook on high for 1 hour stir together one more time and then turn heat down to low and cook for an additional 2 1 / 2 - 3 hours

name: Crock pot glazed pork roast with carrots and corn
ingredients: boneless pork shoulder|baby carrots|barbecue sauce|honey|balsamic vinegar|seasoning salt|all-purpose flour|frozen whole kernel corn
steps: placr roast in crock pot and arrange carrots around and on top roast in a bowl , mix 1 / 2 cup barbecue sauce , honey , vinegar and seasoned salt and pour over pork and carrots cover and cook on low 8 to 10 hours remove pork and vegetables from cooker and place on serving platter in a bowl , mix 2 / 3 cup barbecue sauce and flour and gradually stir into juices in cooker increase heat setting to high cover and cook about 15 minutes , stirring occasionally , until thickened stir in corn cover and cook 5 minutes longer serve sauce over pork and vegetables

name: Crock pot goetta
ingredients: water|pinhead oats|salt|pepper|ground beef|ground pork|onions|sage|thyme|bay leaves|cornmeal
steps: place water , oats , salt and pepper into the crock pot and mix well cover and cook on high for 1 hour , stirring 2 or 3 times add meats and break up well add onion , sage , thyme and bay cook for 4 hours on low , stirring now and again uncover and add cornmeal-stir well cook uncovered for 30 minutes turn out into 3 loaf pans , cool and chill in fridge when set turn out and freeze what you want slice and fry in a little butter or oil until brown and crusty , but dont let them touch in the pan or they will run

name: Crock pot golden cauliflower slow cooker
ingredients: frozen cauliflower|condensed cheddar cheese soup|bacon|salt|pepper
steps: place cauliflower in crock pot and season with salt and pepper pour soup on top and sprinkle with bacon cook on high for an hour and a half if cauliflower is frozen cook for two hours on high

name: Crock pot golden chicken and noodles
ingredients: boneless skinless chicken breast halves|broccoli cheese soup|milk|onion|salt|dried basil|pepper|cooked noodles
steps: place chicken in crock pot combine the soup , milk , onion , salt , basil and pepper and pour over chicken cover and cook on high for 1 hour reduce heat to low and continue to cook 5-6 hours longer or until the meat juices run clear serve over noodles

name: Crock pot golden chicken curry
ingredients: potatoes|carrot|skinless chicken breasts|bell pepper|onion|olive oil|margarine|garlic paste|curry powder|turmeric|white pepper|ground ginger|ground cinnamon|salt|flour|chicken broth
steps: place potatoes , carrot , chicken , and bell pepper in bottom of crock pot in a large saucepan on medium heat , saut onion in olive oil and margarine until translucent then stir in garlic paste , curry powder , turmeric , white pepper , ginger , cinnamon , and salt next , gradually add flour mixing thoroughly into a pasty consistency finally , slowly pour in chicken broth , thoroughly diluting the flour mixture make sure there are no lumps last , pour broth mixture over the ingredients in the crockpot cover and cook on high for 6 8 hours , stirring occasionally serve over hot rice accompanied by sour and / or sweet pickled condiments

name: Crock pot golden chicken with noodles campbell s
ingredients: cream of chicken soup|water|lemon juice|dijon mustard|garlic powder|carrots|boneless chicken breast halves|cooked egg noodles|fresh parsley
steps: mix soup , water , lemon juice , mustard , garlic and carrots in slow cooker add chicken and turn to coat cover and cook on low 7 to 8 hours or until done serve over noodles sprinkle with parsley serves 8

name: Crock pot golden mushroom roast
ingredients: fresh mushrooms|potatoes|golden cream of mushroom soup|onion soup mix|beef roast|salt|cracked black pepper
steps: place mushrooms , potatoes , and beef in crock pot mix golden cream of mushroom soup and dry onion soup add beef roast cover and cook on low 8 to 10 hours

name: Crock pot gooey chicken burritos
ingredients: boneless skinless chicken breasts|chunky salsa|fat-free cream of chicken soup|rotel tomatoes|cheese|sweet onion|black olives|quick-cooking tapioca|flour tortilla
steps: combine all ingredients , except tortilla , in crock pot cook on low setting 6-8 hours shred chicken spoon onto warmed tortillas and roll

name: Crock pot gorgonzola chicken
ingredients: chicken breasts|mushroom soup|pepper|onion|bacon|gorgonzola
steps: add onion , then chicken & bacon to crock , cover with soup / broth , layer slices of gorgonzola on top crock on high for first 4 / 5 hours and then low to keep warm

name: Crock pot goulash
ingredients: stew meat|cream of mushroom soup|beef broth|cornstarch|water|egg noodles
steps: add stew meat , cream of mushroom soup and beef broth to crock pot cook on low for 8 hours before serving mix cornstarch and warm water and add to crock pot to thicken gravy serve over noodles

name: Crock pot grains
ingredients: millet|barley|brown rice|onion|green bell pepper|carrot|kidney beans|tomato sauce|canned tomato|canned corn|dried oregano|dried basil|garlic powder|salt and pepper
steps: combine all ingredients in a crock pot add water to reserved tomato liquid to equal 2 1 / 2 cups stir into grain mixture cover and cook on low setting 8 hours stir before serving

name: Crock pot greek chicken and potatoes
ingredients: potatoes|chicken breasts|lemon juice|garlic cloves|chicken stock|dried oregano|salt|pepper|onion powder|carrot
steps: place potatoes in the bottom of crock pot top with chicken breasts combine the remaining ingredients and pour over the chicken and potatoes cook on the low setting for 10-12 hours

name: Crock pot greek lamb artichoke onion stew
ingredients: lamb shoulder|yellow onions|tomato puree|dry red wine|red wine vinegar|garlic|cinnamon stick|salt|pepper|sugar|ground allspice|cumin|dried oregano|artichoke hearts|fresh parsley|walnuts|feta cheese
steps: mix all ingredients in a large slow cooker cover and cook on low for 8 to 10 hours or until lamb and onions are tender stir in artichoke hearts cover and let stand 5 minutes remove the cinnamon stick serve sprinkled with walnuts and feta

name: Crock pot greek lemon chicken
ingredients: boneless skinless chicken breasts|oregano|seasoning salt|pepper|lemon rind|chicken broth|lemon juice|garlic cloves|cornstarch
steps: spray crock pot with non-stick combine lemon rind , 1 / 2 cup broth , garlic and lemon juice pour into pot sprinkle both sides of each frozen breast with seasonings , add to pot cover and cook on low 6 - 8 hours remove chicken to plate and keep warm pour liquid from pot into small sauce pan combine corn starch with remaining 1 / 2 cup broth add to sauce pan heat , stirring constantly , until mixture comes to boil and sauce thickens serve chicken with rice cooked in chicken broth instead of water and top with the sauce you can cook as few as 2 breasts with the same quantity of other ingredients

name: Crock pot green bean casserole
ingredients: french style green beans|cut green beans|98% fat-free cream of mushroom soup|mushroom pieces|nonfat milk|worcestershire sauce|black pepper|onion
steps: combine canned green beans with 1 can of mushrooms and onion slices place in crock pot sprayed with cooking spray mix cream of mushroom soup , fat free milk , worcestershire sauce , black pepper and other can of mushrooms in separate bowl cover green beans with sauce do not stir cook on low for 6-8 hours

name: Crock pot green beans bacon
ingredients: string bean|bacon|garlic|onion|olive oil|salt|fresh ground pepper
steps: place bacon at the bottom of the crockpot place other ingredients on top of the bacon in crock pot stir cover and cook on low for 6 hours if you have a large crock pot , you can double the recipe

name: Crock pot green beans ham
ingredients: fresh green beans|smoked ham hock|garlic cloves|onion|swanson chicken broth|salt|black pepper
steps: place cut up ham hock in crock pot rinse beans and snap into halves or thirds place beans over ham place chopped onion and minced garlic over bean / ham mixture sprinkle with salt and pepper pour chicken broth over all cover and cook on high 4 hours

name: Crock pot green chile stuffed chicken breast
ingredients: chicken breast halves|cream cheese|monterey jack cheese|chili powder|salt|pepper|whole green chilies|cream of mushroom soup|red enchilada sauce
steps: combine cream cheese and jack , add seasoning take a green chilie and slice lengthwise - stuff with cheese mixture placed stuffed chili on chicken filet and roll secure with toothpick if needed alternatively: sometimes when i am in a hurry , i use diced green chiles and just throw everything into the pot ! still tastes great ! place chicken in crock pot , cover with soup and sauce cook on low for 4 hours serve with rice if desired

name: Crock pot green chile burrito taco filling
ingredients: rump roast|onion|taco seasoning mix|dried oregano leaves|garlic powder|diced green chilies|tomato sauce
steps: layer ingredients , meat first , in crock pot cook on low for 8-10 hours do not stir for first 5 hours shred meat after 7 hours serve on flour or corn tortillas top with sour cream , if desired

name: Crock pot green chile pork
ingredients: boneless pork|oil|onion|ground cumin|oregano|chicken broth|diced green chilies|mexican-style tomatoes|garlic|salt and pepper
steps: brown pork cubes in oil add onions and cook until they are tender place pork and onions in crockpot , and add remaining ingredients cook on low until pork is tender , about 8 hours with a large spoon , stir the mix , breaking the pork into large shreds by pressing the meat cubes against the side of the crockpot

name: Crock pot green chili beef
ingredients: beef roast|green chili salsa|cilantro
steps: place roast in crock pot pour green chili salsa over it add cilantro place lid on crock pot and cook on low 7-9 hours shred meat and stir into sauce use in burritos , or on nachos serve with sour cream , cheese , guacamole

name: Crock pot green turkey chili
ingredients: onion|turkey|white kidney beans|corn|tomatillo salsa|green chilies|garlic|ground cumin|salt|cilantro|sour cream|red onion|lime wedge
steps: put turkey thighs on top of onion in a 3 1 / 2 quart or larger crock pot add beans and corn mix salsa , chiles , garlic , cumin and salt in a medium bowl , pour over top cover and cook on low 8 to 10 hours until meat is tender remove turkey to a cutting board cut into bite size pieces , discard bones return meet to cooker , stir in cilantro

name: Crock pot greens and chicken
ingredients: mustard greens|boneless skinless chicken breast halves|apple cider vinegar|water|salt and pepper
steps: spray a 4 quart slow cooker crock with vegetable spray fill with greens that have been washed , destemmed and coarsely chopped or torn , cut chicken breast halves in large pieces and lay on top of the greens add vinegar , water and seasonings cook on low for 5 to 6 hours or until chicken is 170f internally and greens are tender

name: Crock pot ground beef and beans
ingredients: ground beef|onion|garlic|celery|jalapeno pepper|dried chili pepper flakes|carrots|green bell peppers|tomato paste|beer|barbecue sauce|sugar|canned mushroom slices|baked beans|red kidney beans|seasoning salt|black pepper
steps: in a large pot or skillet brown the ground beef with onions , garlic , celery , jalapeno peppers and chili flakes until the beef is no longer pink drain fat add in all the remaining ingredients stir to combine bring to a simmer then transfer to the crock pot cover and cook on low heat for about 5 hours season with salt and pepper about halfway through cooking

name: Crock pot ground beef minestrone soup
ingredients: ground beef|onion|celery|green pepper|garlic cloves|carrots|potatoes|zucchini|green beans|crushed tomatoes|bay leaves|basil|oregano|thyme|parsley|sugar|worcestershire sauce|beef bouillon cubes|chicken bouillon cubes|water
steps: brown ground beef along with onion , celery , green pepper , and garlic boil 3 c of water and mix in beef & chicken bouillon put all ingredients into crock pot and stir cook on high 2 hours , low for 3 - 5 hours or if you want to extend the cooking time all on low for 8 - 10 hours or to your desired doneness of the veggies

name: Crock pot ground beef stew
ingredients: ground beef|potatoes|baby carrots|water|dry onion soup mix|garlic clove|italian seasoning|salt|garlic powder|pepper|condensed tomato soup|italian tomato paste
steps: in a large skillet , cook beef over medium heat until no longer pink and drain personally i keep frozen cooked hamburger in my freezer which makes this an even quicker recipe for me to put together in a crock pot , combine potatoes , carrots , water , onion soup mix , garlic , italian seasoning , salt , garlic powder and pepper stir in the cooked beef cover and cook on high for 4 to 5 hours stir in tomato soup and tomato paste cover and cook for 1 hour longer or until heated through

name: Crock pot guisado verde
ingredients: vegetable oil|boneless pork shoulder|onion|garlic cloves|tomatillos|diced green chilies|fresh jalapeno pepper|fresh cilantro|dried oregano|salt and pepper|water|monterey jack cheese|sour cream|corn tortilla strips
steps: heat the oil in a large skillet over medium heat and brown the pork on all sides reserving the juices in the skillet , transfer the pork to the crock pot in the skillet with the pork juices over medium heat , saute the onion and garlic about 1 minute transfer to the crock pot along with skillet juices mix the tomatillos , green chile peppers , jalapeno peppers , and cilantro into the crock pot season with oregano , salt and pepper pour in 1 quart of water or enough to cover all ingredients cover and cook on high for 6-7 hours remove pork from crock pot and shred with a fork return shredded pork to the crock pot spoon the crock pot mixture into bowls and top with cheese , sour cream and tortilla strips to serve

name: Crock pot gumbo
ingredients: butter|flour|frozen mixed vegetables|tomatoes|oysters|boneless skinless chicken breast|crawfish tail meat|shrimp|andouille sausages|chicken bouillon cubes|bay leaves|water|salt|pepper|seasoning salt|dried basil|dried parsley|green onion|crushed red pepper flakes
steps: put the tomatoes and frozen vegetables in the crock pot on high heat make a roux by melting the butter and flour in a large skillet and stir constantly until roux is a light caramel color on medium heat - do not burn the roux ! lower heat is better , but will take longer add the cooked roux to the crock pot add the bouillon cubes , water , crushed red pepper and bay leaves boil the chicken breast in a pot of water on the stove until no pink remains , let cool and then shred the meat by hand and add to the crock pot add the andouille sausage and let everything cook on high for about 4-5 hours about 45 minutes before you want to eat , add all the seafood to the pot and season to taste with salt , pepper , herbs and your favorite seasoning blend serve over hot , cooked rice and garnish with chopped green onion hot pepper sauce and gumbo file seasoning are optional and should be added to each bowl by the person who will be eating it

name: Crock pot gumbo pork chops
ingredients: pork chops|flour|salt|garlic powder|dry mustard|oil|chicken gumbo soup|steamed rice
steps: in a shallow dish , combine flour , salt , garlic powder and mustard dredge chops to coat in a skillet , heat oil and brown chops place chops in a crock pot and pour skillet drippings over chops in the same skillet , add the soup and stir to loosen brown bits from the pan pour this over the chops cover and cook on low for 6-8 hours serve over or with steamed rice , if desired

name: Crock pot ham
ingredients: mitchell black forest ham|crushed pineapple|brown sugar|allspice|whole cloves|shallots|dark raisin
steps: mix all the ingredients except raisins and ham in your crock pot place ham in crock pot , spoon some of the mixture over the ham , turn to low cook for 4 hours , after 3 hours add the raisins to the pot carve and serve put sauce in a serving bowl and it's done

name: Crock pot ham cola
ingredients: brown sugar|dry mustard|prepared horseradish|cola|ham
steps: thoroughly combine brown sugar , mustard and horseradish moisten with enough cola to make a smooth paste reserve remaining cola run entire ham with mixture place in crock pot and add remaining cola cover and cook on high for one hour turn to low setting for 6-7 hours

name: Crock pot ham scalloped potatoes
ingredients: ham|potatoes|onion|cheddar cheese|cream of mushroom soup|salt and pepper|paprika
steps: put half of ham , potatoes and onion in crock pot sprinkle with salt and pepper , then add grated cheese repeat with remaining half spoon undiluted soup over top sprinkle with paprika cover and cook on low for 8-10 hours or on high for 4-5 hours

name: Crock pot ham and beans
ingredients: dried great northern beans|garlic cloves|sweet onion|kosher salt|black pepper|parsley|ground cloves|smoked ham|water
steps: sort beans and soak in enough water to cover overnight or you may sort them and place in a saucepan with 2-inches of water to cover bring them to a boil , boil for 3 minutes , then cover and remove from heat allow to sit for one hour after boiling whichever method you use , rinse and drain the beans before placing them in the crock pot put the rinsed beans , garlic , onion , salt , pepper , parsley , cloves , ham or ham hocks into the crock pot along with 6 cups water or broth cover crock , and cook on low for about 8 hours , or until beans are tender and creamy skim any excess fat , if necessary , before serving

name: Crock pot ham and pineapple
ingredients: black forest ham|pineapple chunks
steps: place ham in crock pot arrange pineapple chunks or rings around ham gently pour juices from cans over all cover and cook on low 6 hours

name: Crock pot ham and potato scallop
ingredients: red potatoes|cooked ham|corn|green pepper|instant minced onion|condensed cheddar cheese soup|milk|all-purpose flour|garlic pepper seasoning
steps: in crock pot , combine potatoes , ham , corn , green pepper , and onion mix soup , milk , flour , and garlic pepper in a small bowl beat with whisk until smooth and stir into potato mixture cover and cook on low heat for 7 to 9 hours or until potatoes are tender

name: Crock pot ham and potatoes
ingredients: ham|potatoes|onion|salt and pepper|cheddar cheese|cream of celery soup|paprika
steps: put half of ham , potatoes and onions in crock pot sprinkle with salt and pepper , then grated cheese repeat with remaining half spoon undiluted soup over top sprinkle with paprika cover and cook on low 8-10 hours or on high 4 hours

name: Crock pot ham and potatoes au gratin
ingredients: nonstick cooking spray|au gratin potato mix|cooked ham|roasted red pepper|water|condensed cheddar cheese soup
steps: lightly coat a 3 1 / 2 quart or 4 quart slow cooker with cooking spray place au gratin potato mixes with contents of seasoning packets , the ham , and roasted red pepper in the prepared cooker in a large bowl stir the water into soup pour soup mixture over potato mixture in cooker cover and cook on low heat setting for 7 to 8 hours or on high heat setting for 3 1 / 2 to 4 hours

name: Crock pot ham and scalloped potatoes
ingredients: ham|cream of tartar|water|potatoes|cheddar cheese|onions|cream of mushroom soup|paprika|salt and pepper
steps: toss sliced potatoes in 1 / 2 teaspoon cream of tartar and 1 cup water drain put half of ham , potatoes , and onions in crockpot sprinkle with salt and pepper , then grated cheese repeat with remaining half spoon undiluted soup over top sprinkle with paprika cover and cook in crock pot on low 8 to 10 hours (high: 4 hours)

name: Crock pot ham bone and beans
ingredients: ham bone|yellow onion|celery|carrot|bay leaves|garlic|great northern bean|low sodium chicken broth|pepper
steps: add onion and celery to crock pot place ham bone or hocks on top of onion and celery pour rinsed beans around ham and sprinkle with pepper add bay leaves and garlic add chicken stock and stir to combine all ingredients cover and cook on low for 8 hours when ham is tender remove meat from bones and return meat to the pot stir to combine and break up ham pieces to thicken smash some of the beans on the side of crock pot when done skim any fat off and discard bay leaves

name: Crock pot ham bean potatoes
ingredients: fresh green beans|ham|baking potatoes|onion
steps: dice the ham , onion and potatoes put everything in the crockpot along with 3 cups of water and season to taste with pepper put on low for about six hours

name: Crock pot ham pineapple and beans
ingredients: pinto beans|black beans|pork and beans|unsweetened pineapple chunks|hickory flavored barbecue sauce|prepared yellow mustard|onion|green pepper|smoked ham|red wine vinegar|fresh ground pepper
steps: combine all ingredients except vinegar and pepper in a crock pot cover and cook on low heat setting 5 / 12 to 6 hours stir in the vinegar and season with pepper to taste

name: Crock pot hamburger n potato casserole
ingredients: hamburger|onion|potatoes|cream of mushroom soup|milk
steps: spray crock pot with non stick vegetable spray layer potatoes , onions and hamburger until all is used , sprinkling each layer very lightly with salt and pepper mix soup and milk together and pour over top cook 3 to 4 hours on high

name: Crock pot hamburger cabbage casserole revised
ingredients: cabbage|95% lean ground beef|onion|garlic salt|italian spices|black pepper|uncooked rice|light spaghetti sauce|water|crushed tomatoes|basil|seasoning salt
steps: place 3 cups or 1 / 2 bag of cabbage in bottom of crock pot brown beef with onions , garlic salt , and italian mixed spices in non-stick skillet and drain put beef on top of cabbage , and then do the same with the rice top with remaining cabbage , and sprinkle with salt and pepper combine spaghetti sauce , water , tomatoes , basil , and seasoned salt in a bowl pour sauce mixture over top of cabbage cover and cook on high for 4 to 5 hours makes 6 servings with each serving size being 1 1 / 4 heaping cups for all weight watchers folks , this is 4 points per serving and is very filling

name: Crock pot hamburger casserole
ingredients: potatoes|carrots|frozen peas|onions|celery|garlic salt|salt and pepper|ground beef|tomato soup|water
steps: layer vegetables in order given into slow cooker sprinkle each layer with garlic salt , pepper , and salt place meat on top of celery combine soup and water pour over all and cover and cook on low for 8 hours

name: Crock pot hamburger soup
ingredients: lean ground beef|black pepper|basil|seasoning salt|dry onion soup mix|boiling water|tomato sauce|soy sauce|carrot|celery|macaroni|parmesan cheese
steps: crumble beef into crock pot add seasons and soup mix stir in water , tomato sauce and soy sauce add celery and carrots cover and cook on low 6 to 8 hours refrigerate several hours or overnight skim off fat add macaroni and parmesan cheese cover and heat for 10-15 minutes

name: Crock pot hamburger tomato soup
ingredients: lean ground beef|onion|celery|cabbage and carrot coleslaw mix|tomato paste|tomatoes with onion and garlic|beef broth|worcestershire sauce|sugar
steps: brown hamburger and drain thoroughly place in crock pot add remaining ingredients stir to blend cook on high for 3 to 4 hours

name: Crock pot harvest stoup
ingredients: lean ground turkey|yellow onion|garlic cloves|kidney beans|sweet potato|red potatoes|acorn squash|tomatoes and green chilies|chicken broth|clove|allspice|salt and pepper
steps: peel and chop all of the vegetables , and add it to the crockpot break up the ground meat with your fingers and add it inches dump in the kidney beans and the can of tomatoes and chilies add the broth and the seasonings stir well it will look like there isn't enough liquid , but more will be made from the vegetables and meat i promise cook on low for 7 to 9 hours mine took about 9 hours because i have an older crockpot yours may take less time

name: Crock pot hash browns casserole
ingredients: frozen hash brown potatoes|cream of chicken soup|butter|dried onion|milk|cheddar cheese|black pepper|corn flakes
steps: stir together butter , onions , hash browns , soup , milk , cheese , pepper , and 1 / 2 cups cornflakes pour into greased crock pot top with remaining corn flakes cover and cook on high for 3-4 hours

name: Crock pot hawaiian chicken
ingredients: sprite|barbecue sauce|boneless skinless chicken breasts|pineapple chunks|cooked white rice
steps: place cleaned chicken breast on bottom of crock pot mix together sprite and bbq sauce pour over chicken cook on low for 6 hours when it all done the sauce is thin i add a little cornstarch to thicken it up and it turns out perfect in the crock pot when it was all done , i take a fork and kinda pulled the chicken apart i serve this over white rice

name: Crock pot hawaiian chicken breasts
ingredients: green onions|butter|chicken breast halves|flour|salt and pepper|pineapple|avocado|rice
steps: chop onions using only 1" of green tops saute in 1 tablespoons of butter until glazed transfer to crock pot coat chicken breasts in seasoned flour saute in butter until brown on both sides transfer to crock pot drain pineapple , pour juice over chicken cover and cook on low 3 to 4 hours or until breasts are tender saute pineapple slices in butter until golden place on heated plate top each with a chicken breast slice avocado into 8 lengthwise strips place 2 strips on each chicken breast serve pan drippings over rice

name: Crock pot hawaiian chicken one dish meal
ingredients: chicken tenderloins|soy sauce|carrots|sliced water chestnuts|pineapple chunks|sweet and sour sauce|cornstarch|ginger|frozen oriental-style vegetables
steps: combine chicken and soy sauce in slow cooker and mix to coat stir in carrots , water chestnuts , and juice only from pineapples cook on low setting for 3 to 4 hours refrigerate pineapples until later twenty minutes before serving , turn heat to high setting whisk together sweet and sour sauce , ginger , and cornstarch add to crock pot , along with pineapple and vegetables when vegetables are tender , the dish is ready to serve or hold on low i often serve with white rice

name: Crock pot hearty pork stew
ingredients: boneless pork loin roast|carrots|onion|parsnips|butternut squash|chicken broth|fresh sage leaf|fresh thyme leaves|pepper|all-purpose flour|butter
steps: in a 4 to 5 quart slow cooker , mix together all the ingredients except the flour and margarine cover and cook on low heat 6 to 7 hours or until pork is no longer pink and vegetables are tender mix flour and margarine gradually stir into stew until well blended turn slow cooker to high and cook for an additional 30 to 45 minutes , stirring occasionally

name: Crock pot herb bread
ingredients: granulated sugar|warm water|active dry yeast|unbleached all-purpose flour|cooking oil|dried oregano|ground sage|garlic powder|onion powder|salt|cornmeal
steps: stir first amount of sugar into warm water in large warmed bowl and sprinkle with yeast let stand for 10 minutes stir to dissolve yeast , add next 8 ingredients and beat on low to moisten beat on medium for 2 minutes , work in second amount of flour grease 3-1 / 2 quart slow cooker and sprinkle with cornmeal turn dough into prepared slow cooker smooth top with wet spoon or hand put wooden match or an object 1 / 8-inch thick between lid and edge of slow cooker to allow a bit of steam to escape cook on high for about 2-1 / 2 hours (at this point check temperature with an instant read thermometer if the temperature is at least 190f the bread is done if it's done you should loosen sides with knife and turn out onto a clean surface and enjoy if it's not done yet you can either leave it in the crock pot for an additional 30 to 60 minutes or turn if out onto a clean surface , flip it over and return to the crock to allow the other side to brown cook on high for an additional 30-60 minutes to brown other side of bread cut into 14 slices

name: Crock pot herbed chicken and shrimp
ingredients: salt|pepper|boneless skinless chicken breasts|butter|onion|tomato sauce|white wine|garlic clove|dried basil|medium shrimp
steps: combine salt and pepper and rub over the chicken pieces in a skillet , brown chicken on all sides in butter transfer chicken to crock pot in a bowl combine the onion , tomato sauce , wine or broth , garlic and basil and pour over chicken cover and cook on low for 4-5 hours or until juices run clear stir in the shrimp cover and cook on high for 20-30 minutes or until shrimp turn pink

name: Crock pot herbed chicken with orange sauce
ingredients: chicken breasts|onion|garlic cloves|dried rosemary|fresh coarse ground black pepper|salt|orange juice
steps: arrange chicken in the bottom of a crock pot combine remaining ingredients and pour over chicken cover and cook on low 7-8 hours

name: Crock pot herbed chicken with sweet potatoes
ingredients: skinless chicken pieces|dried oregano|salt|fresh ground black pepper|condensed cream of chicken soup|sweet potatoes|chicken flavor stuffing mix|water|unsalted butter|green beans
steps: place the chicken pieces in a 5- or 6- quart crock pot , season to taste , spoon the soup over the chicken and top with the sweet potatoes combine the stuffing mix with the water and butter and spoon it over the sweet potatoes cover and cook on low for 4 to 6 hours , or until the sweet potatoes are tender , and the chicken is cooked right through: when the juice of the chicken - when the thickest pieces are pierced - is no longer pink towards the end of the cooking time , add your choice of green vegetable

name: Crock pot herbed stew
ingredients: stew meat|beef bouillon|red wine|garlic cloves|onion|marjoram|bay leaf|potatoes|baby carrots|celery|sour cream|flour
steps: add all ingredients to crock pot except sour cream and flour cook on low for 8 hours or high for 4 hours mix together flour and sour cream add to crock pot stir until sour cream has melted allow to thicken 15 minutes salt and pepper to taste

name: Crock pot hobo beef stew
ingredients: round steaks|stewed tomatoes|tomato sauce|onion|worcestershire sauce|basil|rosemary|pepper|potatoes|frozen mixed vegetables
steps: combine all ingredients in crock pot cook on low 8-10 hours

name: Crock pot hoisin chicken
ingredients: chicken pieces|hoisin sauce|plum sauce|soy sauce|fresh gingerroot|lime, juice of|cornstarch|salt and pepper|fresh garlic
steps: mix all ingredients in a bowl add the chicken to the mixture coat well put all ingredients in the slow cooker cook for 5-6 hours , or until chicken is tender serve with rice

name: Crock pot hoisin chicken wings
ingredients: chicken wings|hoisin sauce|honey|garlic cloves|fresh ginger|sesame oil
steps: i used a 4 qt round crockpot for this dish it was a perfect size dump chicken into crockpot add the hoisin sauce , honey , garlic , ginger , and sesame oil cover and cook on low for 7-8 hours , or on high for 4-5 stir well to mix flavors cook on high for another 30 minutes

name: Crock pot holiday dressing
ingredients: butter|onions|celery|fresh parsley|fresh mushrooms|dried bread|seasoning|rubbed sage|dried thyme|dried marjoram|kosher salt|peppercorn|chicken broth|eggs
steps: melt the butter in a skillet over medium heat and saute the onions , celery , mushrooms and the parsley until tender but not browned in a large mixing bowl , spoon the sauteed vegetables over the bread cubes and then add all the spices and herbs into the mix stir mix the beaten eggs with the chicken stock and add this to the mix a little at a time as you stir carefully you may not need every bit of the stock-egg blend so be careful to not turn your dressing into soup you should still be able to discern the bread cubes but they should be fairly wet transfer the mix into your crock pot and cover cook on high for an hour and then reduce to the low setting and allow it to cook for four to eight more hours until it reaches the consistency that you like if you don't have the paul prudhomme seasoning you can use seasoned salt or , better yet , poultry seasoning

name: Crock pot home again pot roast
ingredients: beef bouillon granules|boiling water|diced tomatoes|dry red wine|leek soup mix|worcestershire sauce|garlic cloves|dried thyme|dried marjoram|dried rosemary|boneless chuck roast|carrots|parsnips|flour|cold water
steps: add bouillon to water , stir to dissolve and pour into crock pot add tomatoes , wine , soup mix , worcestershire , garlic and herbs and mix to combine add roast and turn to coat with mixture add vegetables , cover and cook on low 9-11 hours remove roast and cover with foil turn cooker up to high , whisk flour and water until smooth , add to the pot and stir to combine cover and cook another 10 minutes or until thickened

name: Crock pot honey garlic chicken
ingredients: boneless skinless chicken thighs|garlic cloves|dried basil|honey|soy sauce|ketchup
steps: place chicken in the bottom of slow cooker mix the rest of the ingredients in a small bowl pour over the chicken cover and cook on low for 6-7 hours or high for 3-4 hours remove chicken to a plate and cover to keep warm pour remaining liquid in a saucepan reduce liquid to desired thickness , and pour over chicken

name: Crock pot honey glazed ham
ingredients: ham|honey|orange juice|carrots
steps: place carrots in the bottom of the crock pot and put ham on top mix orange juice and honey together and pour over ham and carrots cook on low for 6-8 hours basting once an hour

name: Crock pot honey ham oamc
ingredients: deli ham|whole cloves|honey
steps: cut ham in equal halves stick 20 whole cloves into each half you can cut a diamond pattern first if you want , and stick one clove into the center of the diamond place each ham into a ziploc bag and freeze until ready to use if desired , defrost one ham the night before you wish to make it place 4 tbsp of honey over one ham before cooking and cook on high for about 3 hours or on low for 6 hours , increase cooking time if making from frozen repeat steps 5 and 6 for second ham

name: Crock pot honey orange chicken
ingredients: chicken thighs|honey|orange juice|chicken broth|salt|dry mustard|fresh gingerroot|fresh garlic|soy sauce|broccoli|cornstarch|water|cooked rice
steps: place frozen thighs in the crock pot whisk remaining ingredients except broccoli , cornstarch , water and rice together and pour over chicken cook on low 4 to 5 hours if using broccoli , add to crock pot 1 hour before chicken is done before serving , remove chicken and broccoli to serving dish and keep warm turn crock pot on high stir cornstarch into water and add to crock pot stir occasionally until it thickens and bubbles serve over the cooked rice

name: Crock pot honey ribs and rice
ingredients: country-style pork ribs|condensed beef consomme|water|maple syrup|honey|soy sauce|barbecue sauce|dry mustard|instant rice
steps: combine all ingredients except ribs and rice in a crock pot mix and add ribs , cook on low 6 to 8 hours remove ribs and keep warm turn pot to high and add rice cook until done , about 30 minutes

name: Crock pot honey dijon ham
ingredients: smoked ham|apple juice|brown sugar|honey|dijon mustard
steps: place ham in 4 to 6 quart slow cooker add apple juice mix brown sugar , honey and mustard spread over ham cover and cook on low 6 to 8 hours or until ham is hot and glazed remove ham from slow cooker place on cutting board cut ham in half reserve one half cut remaining half into slices place on serving platter to serve place 1 1 / 2 cups cubes in a resealable plastic fod storage bags seal and label bags with date of preparation refrigerate both bags up to 3 days or freeze up to 1 month for later use if frozen , thaw in refrigerator befoore using

name: Crock pot honey mustard bbq short ribs or pot roast
ingredients: short rib of beef|dijon-style mustard|garlic|honey|salt and pepper|hickory flavored barbecue sauce|cornstarch|cold water
steps: season ribs with salt and pepper , if desired place in slow cooker in a bowl , combine mustard , minced garlic , honey , bbq sauce , and more salt and pepper to taste at this point , you may add the water with the cornstarch in with the sauce , or add it the last 30 minutes of cooking just mix the 2 tbsp cornstarch in 2 tbsp water add to sauce , stir pour the sauce over ribs cover and cook on low , for 6-7 hours , or until tender the last 30 minutes of cooking , mix the cornstarch with the water add to the sauce in the crock pot , stir and cook until thickened

name: Crock pot honeyed lamb
ingredients: butter|leg of lamb|salt and pepper|cornstarch|ground ginger|dry cider|clear honey|rosemary
steps: preheat crock pot on high heat butter in large skillet and brown lamb on all sides season with salt and pepper transfer to crock pot stir the cornstarch and ginger into the butter mixing well add cider and honey and bring to the boil , stirring continuously pour the mixture over the lamb sprinkle with rosemary cook on high for 5-7 hours or until cooked through depending on your crock pot baste once or twice during cooking

name: Crock pot hot sour soup
ingredients: lean pork|fresh mushrooms|sliced water chestnuts|bamboo shoot|rice wine vinegar|soy sauce|sesame oil|garlic and red chile paste|firm tofu|chicken broth|water|green onion top
steps: put all ingredients except green onion tops in crock pot cook covered for about 8 hours on low when ready , serve topped with green onion tops

name: Crock pot hot and spicy sausage
ingredients: green bell peppers|onion|sausage links|spaghetti sauce|sun-dried tomato pesto
steps: put sausages and veggies into crock pot pour spaghetti sauce and pesto over top cook on low for 5-6 hours serve with pasta or on toasted buns

name: Crock pot hot apple cider
ingredients: brown sugar|apple cider|allspice|whole cloves|cinnamon sticks|orange juice concentrate
steps: combine all ingredients in a crock pot cover and simmer on low for 2-4 hours strain before serving hot serves 8

name: Crock pot hot apple cider with mango and orange
ingredients: apple cider|orange spice tea bags|tea bags|orange|cinnamon sticks|brown sugar
steps: add the apple cider to a crock pot , add cinnamon sticks , tea bags and brown sugar slice the oranges in slices and add to crock pot turn on high until heated through , 1 hour , depending on your crock pot turn to low and let people serve themselves from the crock pot

name: Crock pot hot buttered rum
ingredients: brown sugar|butter|salt|cinnamon|whole cloves|nutmeg|hot water|rum
steps: put all ingredients in a crock pot stir well cover and cook on high 2 hours , then turn on low for 3 hours serve from crock pot in warm mugs

name: Crock pot hot cheesy chicken dip
ingredients: velveeta cheese|cooked chicken|tomatoes and green chilies|ground cumin|green onion
steps: put everything into the slow cooker except green onions and mix as best as possible cook on low 2 hours until cheese is melted , stirring occasionally shift crock pot setting to warm add green onions and gently stir to combine serve directly out of crock pot on warm setting i serve with corn chips or tortilla chips

name: Crock pot hot dog chili
ingredients: chili with beans|tomato paste|green pepper|onion|prepared mustard|salt|chili powder|frankfurters|frankfurter buns
steps: in the crock pot , combine chili with beans , tomato paste , green pepper , onion , mustard , salt , and chili powder cover and cook on low for 3 to 4 hours in large saucepan , drop frankfurters into boiling water simmer several minutes toast buns serve frankfurter on each bun spoon chili mixture onto frankfurters

name: Crock pot hot dogs franks and beans easy
ingredients: baked beans|pink beans|brown sugar|ketchup|mustard powder|red pepper flakes|dried onion|beef hot dogs
steps: put everything in a crock pot cook at high for 2 hours or low for 4 or more

name: Crock pot hot fudge brownie cake
ingredients: brown sugar|water|cocoa powder|brownie mix|chocolate chips|eggs|butter
steps: spray crock with pam in a sauce pan bring brown sugar , 3 / 4 cup of water and coco powder to a boil stir to make sure sugar is desolved shut off heat combind remaining ingredients in a bowl , put into crock pour mixture in sauce pan over batter cover and cook on high for 2 hours or untill done the center of the cake should spring back alittle , will look wet because of the mixture that was poured on top spoon out and enjoy !

name: Crock pot hot fudge cake ww 4 points
ingredients: skim milk|sugar-free instant chocolate pudding mix|chocolate fudge cake|water|unsweetened applesauce|egg whites
steps: spray crock pot with cooking spray whisk skim milk with dry pudding mix in crock pot until dissolved in a medium bowl , mix dry cake mix , water , applesauce and egg whites with whisk for two minutes until blended very gently pour cake mixture over pudding mixture do not mix ! cover and cook on high for 2 1 / 2 hours serve hot

name: Crock pot hot fudge sundae cake
ingredients: plain flour|sugar|cocoa|baking powder|salt|milk|vegetable oil|vanilla|nuts|brown sugar|baking cocoa|hot water|cooking spray
steps: spray inside of 2- 3 1 / 2 quart crock with cooking spray mix flour , sugar , 2 tbs cocoa , baking powder and salt in medium bowl stir in milk , oil and vanilla until smooth stir in nuts spread batter evenly in slow cooker mix brown sugar and 1 / 4 cup cocoa in small bowl stir in hot water until smooth pour evenly over batter in crock cover and cook on high 2- 2 1 / 2 hours or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean turn off crock let cake stand uncovered 30- 40 minutes to cool slightly before serving spoon warm cake into dessert dishes spoon sauce over top 6 servings

name: Crock pot hot whole grain cereal
ingredients: bulgur|brown rice|barley|millet|cornmeal|rolled oats|dried mixed fruit|cinnamon|water|vanilla
steps: spray the inside of the crock pot with nonstick cooking spray combine all the grains , the dried fruit and cinnamon in crock pot and mix well stir in water and vanilla cover crock pot and cook for 6 to 8 hours on low check occasionally , and stir to prevent sticking stir the cereal before serving you can add more water to change the texture

name: Crock pot hot wings
ingredients: chicken wings|frank's red hot sauce|butter|water|garlic cloves
steps: place the first 4 ingredients in a crock pot on low heat for 8 hours remove wings from crock pot and place on a cookie sheet or broiling pan pour sauce into a saucepan and reduce by half add minced garlic spoon sauce over wings and broil for 3 minutes

name: Crock pot hot n spicy sloppy joes
ingredients: ground beef|onion|garlic clove|spicy hot v8|ketchup|water|brown sugar|jalapenos|yellow mustard|chili powder|worcestershire sauce
steps: in a large skillet cook ground beef , onion , and garlic till meat is brown and onion is tender drain off fat meanwhile , in a 3 1 / 2- or 4-quart crockery cooker combine tomato juice catsup water brown sugar jalapeo peppers , if desired mustard , chili powder and worcestershire sauce stir in meat mixture cover cook on low-heat setting for 10 to 12 hours or high-heat setting for 3 to 5 hours toast buns spoon meat mixture over buns and sprinkle with cheese serves 8

name: Crock pot huevos rancheros mexican ranch style eggs low carb
ingredients: butter|eggs|light cream|mexican blend cheese|pepper|chili powder|garlic clove|green chilies|red enchilada sauce|sharp cheddar cheese|tortillas
steps: grease crock pot with the butter , and set aside in a large bowl , combine the eggs , cream , mexican cheese , pepper , and chili powder add the garlic and chilies , and stir pour mixture into the crock pot , cover , and cook on low for 3 hours and 45 minutes remove lid and top with enchilada sauce and cheddar cheese replace lid and cook until sauce is warm and cheese is melted top tortillas with eggs and serve

name: Crock pot hula chicken
ingredients: honey|soy sauce|brown sugar|garlic powder|dried ginger|chicken bouillon|boneless skinless chicken breasts|pineapple chunks|baby carrots
steps: pour honey , soy sauce , brown sugar , garlic powder , ginger , bouillon and pineapple juice in the crock pot and stir lay chicken on bottom of pot and cover with carrots and pineapple chunks cook in your crock pot for 4-6 hours on low or 3-4 on high if you are using frozen chicken breast , just add another hour on low or 1 / 2 hour on high i actually like the thinner sauce for this one a reviewer suggested thickening the sauce , so i will include carrolj's recommendation - after the meat , carrots and pineapple are removed , add 1 / 2 cup of water mixed with 4 tablespoons of cornstarch then cook the sauce until thickened and smooth

name: Crock pot hungarian beef goulash
ingredients: onion|carrots|all-purpose flour|dried marjoram|salt|pepper|beef stew meat|beef broth|red wine|tomato paste|ground paprika|garlic cloves|sour cream|egg noodles
steps: place onions and carrots in crock pot combine next four ingredients toss beef with this mixture and add to crock pot combine broth , wine , tomato paste , paprika and garlic pour over beef cover crock pot and cook 7-8 hours on low when stew is ready cook noodles and transfer to platter stir sour cream into stew top noodles with stew

name: Crock pot hungarian goulash
ingredients: beef stew meat|onion|garlic|ketchup|worcestershire sauce|brown sugar|salt|paprika|dry mustard|water|flour
steps: place meat in crockpot and cover with sliced onion combine garlic , ketchup , worcestershire sauce , sugar , salt , paprika and mustard stir in water , mix well , and pour over meat cover and cook on low for 8 to 10 hours turn control to high dissolve flour in a small amount of cold water and stir into meat mixture cook on high for 10 to 15 minutes or until slightly thickened serve over noodles or rice

name: Crock pot indonesian beef
ingredients: flour|beef chuck|vegetable oil|onion|potatoes|carrot|soy sauce|curry powder|ground ginger|bay leaf|garlic powder|cayenne pepper|light coconut milk|salt|pita bread|parsley|low-fat plain yogurt|lime wedge
steps: line crockpot with crockpot liner put flour into ziplock , add beef , and shake until meat is coated heat oil in a large nonstick skillet over , saut beef meanwhile put veggies in bottom of crockpot transfer beef to crockpot , deglaze skillet with soy , scraping up any brown bits and pour over beef in medium bowl , mix together curry , ginger , bay leaf , garlic powder , and cayenne , stir in coconut milk , pour over all in crock pot wait on salt :) cover and cook on high for 6 hours , or low for 8 hours remove bay leaf and stir in salt serve over pita or naan bread with parsley , yogurt , and lime

name: Crock pot indonesian beef or pork
ingredients: stewing beef|vegetable oil|garlic cloves|onions|ground coriander|ground cumin|gingerroot|ketjap manis|vegetable stock|green chilies|sambal oelek|kaffir lime leaves
steps: put all ingredients in your food-processor except the meat , oil and the lime leaves process until almost like a paste heat the oil in a large frying pan and fry the onion mixture on medium heat for approx 5 minutes turn up the heat and add the meat , stir and fry for another 5 minutes transfer to the crock pot , add the lime leaves and cook on low for 6 to 8 hours , depending on your crock pot when done taste and add more sambal if desired

name: Crock pot indonesian chicken
ingredients: boneless skinless chicken thighs|soy sauce|garlic cloves|fresh ginger|sesame oil|cayenne pepper|peanut butter
steps: in a small bowl , combine soy sauce , garlic , ginger , sesame oil , and cayenne pepper place chicken pieces in a crock pot spoon sauce mixture over top of the chicken cover and cook on low heat setting about 7 hours or until chicken is tender and fully cooked the chicken should start to shred easily remove chicken from crock pot and stir peanut butter into juices until smooth spoon sauce over chicken and serve with rice

name: Crock pot indonesian style country ribs
ingredients: country-style spareribs|onion|ketjap manis|pineapple juice|lime, juice of|tomato ketchup|brown sugar|fresh ginger|ground turmeric|ground cayenne pepper|thai red chili peppers|jasmine rice
steps: place ribs in the bottom of the crock pot separate onion into rings and place on top of pork in a small bowl , mix together ketjap manis , pineapple juice , lime juice , ketchup , brown sugar , ginger , turmeric , and cayenne pepper until blended pour mixture over pork and onions cover crock pot and cook on low for 6-8 hours or on high for 3-4 hours or until pork is tender and cooked through serve pork with rice , garnished with slices of hot chiles serving suggestion: for my dinner , i also took some sliced crimini mushrooms and snow peas , and stir-fried those with some hot chilies until they were partly cooked , then added a ladle of the sauce from the crock and allowed it to thicken onto the veggies until the veggies were crisp tender i served the veggies also with chunks of fresh pineapple on the side

name: Crock pot irish stew dublin coddle
ingredients: stewing beef|bacon|breakfast sausage|white potatoes|celery|onion|parsnips|carrots|chicken stock|pearl barley|worcestershire sauce|sugar|garlic cloves|salt and pepper|extra virgin olive oil|basil|cilantro|parsley
steps: put a dash of oil in a pan and heat adding the garlic and onion sear the stewing beef in the pan adding the worcestershire sauce cook for 5 minutes or until the beef is browned in your crock pot or stock pot add 1 l of chicken stock prepare vegatables and add slice sausage , bacon and add to pot add pearl barley , herbs and sugar and stir add the stew beef and contents of the wok to pot / crock pot add salt and pepper to taste a quick check will tell you how much of the second litre of chicken stock to add close to serving time we like to check the consistency and using corn starch and a little water thicken up to the desired texture working long days this dish works for us when popped in the crock pot for 5 to 7 hours when we cook it on the stove it takes about 3 to 5 on a low simmer we enjoy our stew with dinner buns , but from experience irish soda bread works really well i will put a recipe up for this soon also please enjoy and look forward to your comments deb and john

name: Crock pot italian bean soup with chicken
ingredients: great northern beans|pinto beans|garlic powder|italian seasoning|ground mustard|dried onion|pepper|water|chicken stock cubes|cooked chicken
steps: 1 rinse beans in sink in colander 2 combine all ingredients in 5 quart crock pot and set on low for 4 hours

name: Crock pot italian beef
ingredients: sirloin tip roast|pepperoncini peppers|water|garlic salt|onion salt|basil|italian seasoning|accent seasoning
steps: put all ingredients into crock pot cook on low for 8 hours or more break up meat and serve on deli rolls

name: Crock pot italian beef or venison
ingredients: roast|beef bouillon cubes|good seasonings italian salad dressing mix|pepperoncini peppers
steps: put roast in crock pot add bouillon cubes and powdered dressing mix pour entire jar of peppers over roast cook 6-8 hours on high when roast is tender and falling apart , finish shredding and serve on fresh hoagie rolls delicious !

name: Crock pot italian beef philly cheese steak garlic bread sandwich
ingredients: beef stew meat|onion|pepperoncini peppers|beef stock|garlic salt|pepper|garlic powder|onion powder|oregano|dried parsley|dried onion|paprika|parmesan cheese|celery seed|monterey jack cheese|sourdough bread|garlic clove|butter|mayonnaise
steps: put the beef in the crock pot and sprinkle with garlic salt and pepper add the remaining ingredients except the last five , stir , and cook on high for three hours coarsely shred beef with a fork and cook an additional hour while beef is finishing up , toast bread cut garlic clove in half and rub on 4 slices of bread and then spread butter on them spread mayonnaise on the remaining 4 slices , top with cheese broil all the slices of bread until cheese is melted spoon meat and peppers with juices on to garlic-buttered bread slices top with cheese-mayo bread slices

name: Crock pot italian beef sandwiches
ingredients: beef roast|good seasons italian dressing|garlic|pepperoncini peppers|water
steps: spray crock pot with cooking spray cut roast in half put roast in crockpot and add all ingredients cook for 7-8 hours on low or until beef is cooked to your desire remove roast and shred put shredded beef back in broth to blend with slotted spoon put beef on bun

name: Crock pot italian chicken
ingredients: garlic powder|seasoning salt|black pepper|skinless chicken pieces|oil|spaghetti sauce mix|italian seasoning|white wine|zucchini
steps: mix together the garlic powder , seasoning salt and pepper rub this mixture into the skinned chicken pieces heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat brown the chicken on all sides , about 2 minutes combine chicken in crock pot with the spaghetti sauce mix , italian seasoning , and white wine or chicken broth cover and cook on lo for 7 to 8 hours add zucchini during last hour of cooking serve over prepared thin spaghetti or as desired

name: Crock pot italian chicken and fettuccine
ingredients: boneless skinless chicken breast|green beans|onion|stewed tomatoes|tomato paste|dried italian seasoning|garlic cloves|fresh mushrooms|fettuccine|parmesan cheese
steps: cut chicken into about 1 in pieces , set aside place green beans , onion , and mushrooms in your slow cooker place chicken pieces over veggies in a sm bowl combine undrianed tomatoes , tomato paste , italian seas , and garlic pour over chicken cover and cook on low-heat setting for 5-6 hour or on high-heat setting for 2 1 / 2-3 hours serve over hot cooked fettuccine sprinkle w / parm cheese

name: Crock pot italian chili
ingredients: ground beef|bulk italian sausage|diced tomatoes|tomato sauce|onion|sweet red pepper|water|celery|beef broth|chili powder|italian seasoning|sugar|garlic|salt|kidney beans|fresh mushrooms|fresh parsley|mozzarella cheese
steps: in a large skillet , cook beef and sausage over medium heat until no longer pink in crock pot , combine the tomatoes , tomato sauce , onion , red pepper , water , celery , broth , chili powder , italian seasoning , sugar , garlic and salt drain beef mixture and add to the crock pot cover and cook on low for 6 hours or until vegetables are tender add the beans , mushrooms , and parsley cover and cook on high for 30 minutes or until vegetables are tender serve with cheese if desired

name: Crock pot italian pot roast
ingredients: baby carrots|potatoes|beef roast|au jus mix|italian salad dressing mix|tomato juice
steps: place carrots and potatoes in a slow cooker and place the roast on top sprinkle seasoning packets in a mixing bowl with the tomato juice and blend don't worry if there are lumps , they will work out during cooking pour the mixture over the roast and veggies cook on low for 8-1 / 2 hours or on high for 4-1 / 2 hours

name: Crock pot italian roast beef
ingredients: boneless beef roast|spaghetti sauce mix|celery|onion|green pepper|water|salt and pepper|ketchup
steps: put all the ingredients in a crock pot on low overnight or on high for 5 hours shred meat with a fork put meat back in the crock pot and add the ketchup cook another 6-8 hours on low or 3 hours on high serve on the roll or bread of your choice

name: Crock pot italian sausage dinner
ingredients: italian sausage|water|green onions|steak sauce|red pepper flakes|italian seasoning|salt|diced tomatoes with juice|basmati rice
steps: place water , sausage and green onions in crock pot add steak sauce , red pepper flakes , italian seasoning and salt cover with lid and cook on low for 6-8 hours or on high for 3 hours stir in uncooked rice and tomatoes with juice cover and cook an additional 1 hour

name: Crock pot italian sausage hoagies
ingredients: italian sausages|olive oil|meatless spaghetti sauce|green pepper|sweet red pepper|water|romano cheese|dried oregano|dried basil|hoagie rolls
steps: in a skillet over medium-high heat , brown sausage in oil and drain transfer to crock pot add the spaghetti sauce , peppers , water , cheese , oregano and basil cover and cook on low for 4 hours or until sausage is no longer pink fill each hoagie roll with sausage , peppers and sauce

name: Crock pot italian sloppy joes
ingredients: italian turkey sausage|onion|garlic cloves|red bell pepper|green bell pepper|crushed tomatoes|rosemary|salt & fresh ground pepper|spinach leaves|provolone cheese
steps: in a medium non-stick skillet , cook the sausage over medium-high heat , breaking up as it cooks into small bits until cooked through , about 5-6 minutes add onions and garlic , and cook another 2 minutes transfer to the slow cooker and add the bell peppers , crushed tomatoes , rosemary and fresh cracked pepper cover and cook on low 4 hours makes 3 1 / 2 cups to serve , place heaping 1 / 2 cup of meat on a hamburger roll and if desired , top with cheese and baby spinach

name: Crock pot italian wedding soup
ingredients: meatballs|chicken broth|cooked chicken|carrot|celery|frozen chopped spinach|garlic salt|pepper|romano cheese|acini di pepe pasta
steps: pop the meatballs in the microwave for 1 minute on defrost so you can quarter them combine rest of ingredients except pasta in crock pot and cook all day on low add the pasta during the last hour of cooking freezes well

name: Crock pot italian zucchini
ingredients: zucchini|yellow squash|diced tomatoes|onion|garlic|green bell pepper|italian seasoning|water|salt and pepper
steps: put all ingredients in the crock pot and cook on low for 6-8 hours

name: Crock pot jack daniels corned beef
ingredients: corned beef brisket|garlic powder|black pepper|green bell pepper|onion|barbecue sauce
steps: place brisket in crock pot season with garlic powder and black pepper top with green pepper and onion slices pour about half the bottle of bbq sauce over the top cook on low for 7-9 hours remove brisket from crock pot and slice to desired thickness pour remaining bbq sauce over sliced brisket let sit for 15 minutes before serving

name: Crock pot jambalaya
ingredients: skinless chicken breasts|smoked sausage|prawns|green pepper|red pepper|yellow pepper|celery ribs|onion|baby corn|red chilies|garlic cloves|chopped tomatoes|tomato paste|beef stock|rice|black pepper|white pepper|cayenne pepper|paprika|ground cumin|dried basil|dried oregano|frying oil
steps: heat 1 / 2 the oil in a wok until just about smoking & fry chicken until light golden , add to crock pot combine chopped green , red , yellow peppers , chopped onion , chopped garlic , sliced celery & chopped red chilli's , heat the remaining oil & fry until semi soft , add to crock pot add all the remaining ingredients , herbs & spices to the crock pot except for the rice & prawns give it a good stir cook on medium for 6 hours 20 mins from end add the hot cooked rice & the prawns

name: Crock pot jerk chicken
ingredients: onion|ground ginger|habanero pepper|ground allspice|dry mustard|fresh ground black pepper|red wine vinegar|soy sauce|garlic cloves|chicken tenders
steps: combine onion and ginger in a food processor process until finely chopped add remaining ingredients , except chicken , and pulse until well blended place chicken in a 3 1 / 2 to 5-quart slow cooker and cover with sauce cover , set on low , and cook for 6-8 hours , or until chicken is tender , 3-4 hours on high enjoy !

name: Crock pot jerked chicken sandwiches
ingredients: jamaican jerk spice|boneless skinless chicken thighs|green peppers|onion|chicken broth|ketchup|hoagie rolls
steps: rub jerk seasoning generously over chicken thighs place pepper and onion in bottom of crock pot place chicken over vegetables in a small bowl , combine broth and ketchup mix well pour broth mixture over chicken cover cook on low for 6-8 hours remove chicken from crock pot and shred return to crock pot and mix well with a slotted spoon place chicken mixture into buns

name: Crock pot kalua pork
ingredients: pork butt|liquid smoke|garlic cloves|salt
steps: cut slits in pork and rub with salt , garlic & liquid smoke or soy sauce wrap in plastic and let in rest overnight in the fridge 10-12 hours before serving , place in crockpot add an inch of water turn crockpot on low and leave it to cook for 10-12 hours , flipping pork over halfway through remove from the crockpot and shred with two forks eat as is or on a sandwich or even stir fried quickly with some shredded cabbage !

name: Crock pot kielbasa sauerkraut
ingredients: onion|kielbasa|sauerkraut|brown sugar|water|apple cider
steps: slice 1 onion into thin strips and caramelize drain and rinse sauerkraut slice kielbasa into 1-inch lengths combine water , cider and brown sugar combine all ingredients well in crock pot cook on high 6 hours

name: Crock pot kielbasa and bean soup
ingredients: low-fat chicken broth|dry pinto beans|dried split peas|kielbasa|carrots|celery|onion|garlic|thyme|diced tomatoes
steps: place all the ingredients except the tomatoes in a crockpot cook on low for 7 hours add the diced tomatoes with juice and cook on high for 30 minutes added

name: Crock pot kielbasa cassoulet
ingredients: low-fat turkey kielbasa|black beans|white beans|pinto beans|tomato sauce|carrots|onion|red wine|light brown sugar|garlic cloves|fresh thyme sprigs
steps: spray 3 to 5 quart crock pot with non-stick cooking spray rinse beans and drain separate onion slices into rings put all ingredients into crock pot , stir to combine cook on high 4 hours or low 8 - 10 hours hints: use whatever combination of beans you have on hand , but don't use seasoned beans it's much better made with wine the alcohol cooks off you can buy tiny bottles in a four pack if you're not a wine drinker leave the thyme sprigs whole the leaves will fall off during cooking remember to fish out the stems before serving

name: Crock pot kielbasa sauerkraut potatoes
ingredients: polska kielbasa|sauerkraut|potatoes
steps: pour the large can or jar of sauerkraut , with juice , on one side of crock pot drain 2 cans of potatoes and put on other side of crockpot pour the other can of potatoes with juice inches cut up meat into small chunks and put on top this must go for 10 hours on low for the flavor of the meat to get to potatoes i substitute large can of sauerkraut with my own homemade and substitute the potatoes with one quart jar of my canned potatoes with a little of juice

name: Crock pot kinda cassoulet
ingredients: chicken breasts|flour|oil|turkey sausage|shallots|garlic cloves|parsley|fresh thyme|salt|white kidney beans|dry red wine
steps: brown sausage in oil , then remove sausage from pan and slice dredge chicken in flour and brown in same oil add chicken , shallots , garlic , herbs and seasonings to crock pot top with beans and sliced sausage cover and cook on low for 6 hours or until chicken is tender

name: Crock pot kowloon chicken
ingredients: chicken|salt|pepper|ground ginger|garlic clove|chicken broth|pineapple|water chestnuts|green onions|cornstarch|soy sauce|vinegar
steps: sprinkle chicken with salt and pepper place in slow cooker combine ginger , garlic , broth and syrup from pineapple set aside cut pineapple slices into fourths arrange pineapple and water chestnuts over chicken pour ginger sauce over all cover and cook on high 1 hour reduce heat to low and cook an additional 2 to 3 hours or until chicken is tender add green onions dissolve cornstarch in soy sauce and vinegar stir into pot cover and cook on high 10 to 15 minutes or until slightly thickened serve with crisp chinese noodles

name: Crock pot lady s chicken noodle soup
ingredients: water|cooked dark chicken meat|sweet potato|broccoli|onion|celery|chicken bouillon granules|balsamic vinegar|kosher salt|pepper|spaghetti noodles|raw spinach leaves|parmesan cheese
steps: line your slow cooker with a liner put water , chicken , all vegetables except for the spinach leaves into the crock pot stir in the bouillon and vinegar salt and pepper to taste cover and cook on low for 7-8 hours , or until sweet potatoes are tender and the onion is translucent 15 minutes before serving , put in raw spaghetti noodles and a large handful of spinach cover and turn crock pot up to high garnish with parmesan and asiago cheeses , if desired

name: Crock pot lamb and barley stew
ingredients: lamb stew meat|onion|turnip|carrots|beef broth|dark beer|pearl barley|fresh ground pepper|salt|dried thyme|fresh parsley
steps: place the meat , onion , turnips and carrots in the crock pot stir in the broth , beer , barley and all seasonings cover and cook on low for 8-10 hours stir in the parsley before serving

name: Crock pot lamb chops
ingredients: onion|dried oregano|dried thyme|garlic powder|salt|ground black pepper|lamb loin chops|garlic cloves
steps: place onion in a crock pot combine oregano , thyme , garlic powder , salt , and pepper rub over the lamb chops place chops over onion top with garlic cover and cook on low for 4 to 6 hours or until the meat is tender

name: Crock pot lamb chops dinner
ingredients: lamb chops|potatoes|fresh carrot|asparagus spear|onion|sweet soy sauce|water|fresh garlic cloves|bay leaves|curry powder|salt|pepper
steps: spray crock pot with non-stick spray brown lamb chops on both sides if desired place in bottom of crock pot in fry pan used to brown lamb chops , cook onions and garlic , with curry powder , just until beginning to turn transparent transfer onions and garlic to crock pot , spreading evenly over lamb chops lay bay leaves on top arrange potato quarters evenly on top of previously arranged ingredients being sure they do not touch the sides of the crock pot arrange carrots over top try to avoid leaving any potatoes exposed as they will tend to turn dark salt and pepper to taste cover cook on high for at least 3 hours , or cook on low for at least 6 hours , or cook on high , then reduce to low allowing 2 hours on low for each hour on high when there is only an hour left of cooking time , place asparagus spears on top of all and sprinkle a little more curry powder on top if you wish , you can add a tablespoon of butter on top of the asparagus

name: Crock pot lamb shanks
ingredients: lamb shank|olive oil|ground black pepper|brown onions|garlic cloves|mushrooms|beer|worcestershire sauce|beef stock powder|crushed tomatoes|dried oregano|dried basil|dried thyme|bay leaf
steps: heat oil in pan over medium to high heat and brown lamb shanks on all sides season lamb shanks with pepper place sliced onions at bottom of crock pot and put lamb shanks on top drizzled with remaining oil and juices from the pan place mushrooms and garlic cloves over the top mix beer , worcestershire sauce , stock powder , tomatoes , oregano , basil , thyme and bay leaf in a bowl pour mixture over the top of lamb shanks cook in crock pot on low for 6-8 hours depending on your crock pot remove bay leaves serve with vegetables and juices poured over the top of the shanks i served over wholegrain bread but mashed potatoes would be the best match

name: Crock pot lamb stew
ingredients: boneless lamb|flour|seasoning salt|seasoned flour|olive oil|water|brown gravy mix|green pepper|marjoram|garlic cloves|potatoes|onions|celery|carrots
steps: in a resealable bag , mix together the flour , seasoned salt and seasoned pepper add lamb and shake to coat in a large skillet add olive oil and brown the lamb cubes remove and place in crock pot in a medium bowl , whisk together the water , gravy mix , marjoram and garlic add the vegetables and gravy liquid to crock pot and mix well cover and cook on low 8-10 hours

name: Crock pot lamb stew with barley
ingredients: lamb stew meat|cooking oil|onion|garlic cloves|low sodium chicken broth|diced tomatoes|pearl barley|dry white wine|fresh dill|salt|fresh ground black pepper|roasted sweet red peppers|of fresh mint
steps: heat oil in a large heavy-bottomed skillet , or an electric frying appliance , such as in my case brown half of the meat in the hot oil and set aside add remaining meat add onion when meat is nearly browned after the onion is tender , two minutes or so , add the garlic to the onion / meat mixture and saute for a couple of more minutes in a 3 1 / 2- to 5-quart slow cooker , combine the broth , undrained tomatoes , barley , wine , dried dillweed , salt , and black pepper add the meat mixture and stir cover cook on low-heat setting for 8 to 10 hours or on high-heat setting for 4 to 5 hours before serving , stir in the roasted peppers and fresh mint if using fresh dill , stir that in as well

name: Crock pot lamb stuffed green bell peppers
