steps: in a crock-pot add all together except , bell pepper and shrimp cook on high for 4 hours add shrimp and bell pepper and cook an additional 30 minutes serve over rice or combine with enough rice to the desired consistency instead of rice , prepare pasta and serve over it for pastalaya

name: Crock pot kahuna kielbasa
ingredients: turkey kielbasa|heinz ketchup|brown sugar|pineapple chunks in juice|green bell pepper|maui onion|soy sauce
steps: slice kielbasa into 1 / 2 inch slices and place in crock pot add the bell pepper , onion and pineapple chunks in a separate bowl mix ketchup , brown sugar and pineapple juice stir until thoroughly blended mix all ingredients into crock pot and cook on low for approximately 4 1 / 2-5 hours

name: Crock pot lasagna sherri griffin
ingredients: lasagna noodles|ground beef|onion|garlic clove|mozzarella cheese|parmesan cheese|cottage cheese|ragu hearty robusto pasta sauce|parsley|basil|salt|pepper
steps: break noodles into pieces cook according to package directions and drain brown ground beef , onion and garlic drain excess fat put ground beef , noodles and remaining ingredients into crockpot and mix well cover and cook on low for 5 to 6 hours

name: Crock pot lemon garlic chicken
ingredients: chicken pieces|dried oregano|salt|pepper|oil|water|lemon juice|garlic cloves
steps: rinse chicken and dry on paper towels in a small bowl combine the oregano , salt , and pepper sprinkle on chicken and pat inches in a large skillet brown the chicken in the oil transfer to crockpot when browned add water , lemon juice , and garlic to the skillet bring to a boil and pour over chicken cook on low for 5 to 6 hours or on high for 2 1 / 2 to 3 hours

name: Crock pot mac and cheese
ingredients: elbow macaroni|evaporated milk|milk|cheddar cheese|salt|pepper|cayenne
steps: turn on crock pot to allow to heat spray crock pot with non stick cooking spray cook elbow macaroni per box directions , drain and place in mixing bowl add all remaining ingredients mix well place all into crockpot top with remaining cheese and cover cook on high for approximately 3 - 4 hours reduce to low and continue cooking until ready to serve all cooking times may vary depending on the appliance used

name: Crock pot macaroni and cheese
ingredients: macaroni|oil|evaporated milk|milk|salt|shredded cheddar cheese|butter
steps: cook macaroni until just barley tender , drain lightly grease crockpot toss macaroni with oil and add to crockpot stir in remaining ingredients stir , cover and cook 3-4 hours on low do not stir while cooking enjoy !

name: Crock pot maple dijon chicken
ingredients: chicken breast|chicken broth|sweet potatoes|onion|dijon mustard|maple syrup|garlic cloves|bay leaves|thyme
steps: place chicken into crockpot and toss it with thyme , dijon mustard and maple syrup peel and slice sweet potato and onion place onion , sweet potato and minced garlic on top of chicken add chicken broth and bay leaves cook on low for 6-8 hours this is done when the chicken is cooked through and the vegetables reach desired tenderness

name: Crock pot meatball stew
ingredients: potatoes|baby carrots|onion|celery ribs|meatballs|condensed tomato soup|beef gravy|water|onion soup mix|beef bouillon granules
steps: place the potatoes , carrots , onion , celery and meatballs in a crock pot in a bowl , combine the remaining ingredients pour over meatball mixture cover and cook on low for 9-10 hours or until vegetables are crisp-tender

name: Crock pot meatball stone soup
ingredients: meatballs|beef broth|italian-style diced tomatoes|potato|onion|garlic powder|frozen mixed vegetables|parmesan cheese
steps: combine all ingredients in a 4-quart crockpot cover and cook on lo heat 9-11 hours or until vegetables are tender stir in the frozen vegetables which have been thawed cover and cook on hi heat 1 hour serve with parmesan cheese

name: Crock pot meatloaf
ingredients: ground beef|ketchup|brown sugar|egg|italian style breadcrumbs|worcestershire sauce|onion|water
steps: mix all ingredients in a large bowl form into a meatloaf shape that will fit into your crock pot put foil under the meatloaf in crock pot cut it long enough to cover the bottom and sides of meatloaf place meat loaf in crock pot and top with an additional 3-4 tablespoons ketchup cover and cook on high for 2-2 1 / 2 hours i served this with roasted potatoes with parmesan and herbs !

name: Crock pot meatloaf and packet potatoes
ingredients: lean ground beef|green bell pepper|onion|egg|breadcrumbs|steak sauce|ketchup|garlic powder|season salt|fresh ground pepper|yukon gold potatoes|olive oil
steps: in a large bowl combine all ingredients except potatoes , second amount of seasoned salt and olive oil mix thoroughly and pat into the bottom of your crock i just level mine out , covering the entire bottom of the crock then , take a large piece of aluminum foil and place the diced potatoes , drizzle with olive oil and season with seasoned salt then , fold the aluminum foil into a nice packet and place on top of the meatloaf cook on high for 3 to 4 hours until done i serve this as is with ketchup on the side because that is the way we like it feel free to top with tomato sauce or gravy

name: Crock pot mexican chicken
ingredients: boneless skinless chicken breasts|black beans|rotel|black olives|corn|salsa|onion|garlic cloves|sea salt
steps: place frozen chicken breasts in crock pot add all other ingredients cook on high for 5-6 hours remove chicken and shred with two forks return chicken to crock pot , reduce to low , and cook for 1-2 hours

name: Crock pot mexican orange chicken pollo con naranja
ingredients: frozen orange juice concentrate|garlic cloves|pepper|cumin seed|cayenne|jalapeno|salt|chicken breasts|onion|red potatoes
steps: set crock pot to high add orange juice , garlic , pepper , cumin , cayenne , jalapeno and salt to blender or food processor and blend until smooth place chicken pieces in crock pot and pour orange juice mixture over chicken top with onions and potatoes cook for 6 hours on high internal chicken temperature should reach 160 before serving , and the meat should fall off the bone great served over rice !

name: Crock pot minestrone soup
ingredients: lentils|pearl barley|black-eyed peas|beef broth|water|diced tomatoes|zucchini|onion|carrots|celery|mushrooms|italian seasoning|garlic|bay leaves|salt|pepper|crushed red pepper flakes
steps: combine beans , broth , and water in a large crockpot and cook on high for 4-5 hours or until beans are tender add remaining ingredients and cook on low for 4 to 5 hours or until vegetables are tender yummy topped with grated parmesan cheese

name: Crock pot moroccan chicken and lentils
ingredients: chicken thighs|cornstarch|onion|garlic cloves|brown lentils|paprika|cinnamon|turmeric|cumin|ground coriander|chicken broth|salt|pepper|olive oil|nonstick cooking spray
steps: spray the inside of the crock-pot with non-stick spray use the onion slices to cover the bottom of the crock-pot , and then sprinkle the garlic slices on top sprinkle a small pinch of salt and pepper over the onions and garlic rinse and pat dry the chicken thighs sprinkle with salt and apply a thin dusting of cornstarch- rub in lightly pre-heat a large non-stick skillet over medium high with the olive oil place chicken in pan with enough room for steam to escape cook until brown , about 3-5 minutes flip and brown on the other side remove from heat mix the spices together in a small bowl sprinkle about 1 / 3 of the mix over the onions and garlic place chicken in an even layer on top of onions in the crock-pot sprinkle 1 / 3 of the spices on the chicken pour the lentils on top of the chicken and sprinkle the rest of the spices on top pour the chicken broth over the top , turn the crock-pot on high , and cover cook for about 4 hours i serve mine along with steamed couscous and roasted cauliflower

name: Crock pot pot roast
ingredients: beef roast|lipton onion soup mix|cream of mushroom soup|worcestershire sauce|garlic|black pepper|dried thyme leaves
steps: spray interior of crockpot with cooking spray rub minced garlic over roast and place roast in sprayed crockpot in separate bowl , whisk together onion soup mix , mushroom soup concentrate , worcestershire sauce , black pepper and thyme leaves until smooth pour over roast cover and cook on low for 8 hours

name: Crock pot potato chowder
ingredients: potatoes|onion|chicken broth|condensed cream of chicken soup|cream cheese|bacon|chives
steps: combine potatoes , onion , broth , and cream of chicken soup in crock pot cover and cook on low 8-10 hours or until potatoes are tender add cream cheese and blend top with bacon and chives before serving

name: Crock pot potato soup
ingredients: potatoes|onion|celery|bacon bits|chicken bouillon cubes|ham soup base|water|cream of chicken soup|salt and pepper
steps: peel and dice potatoes add potatoes and remaining ingredients to crockpot cook on high for 4 hours

name: Crock pot red beans with andouille sausage
ingredients: dried navy beans|water|green pepper|onion|celery|garlic cloves|andouille sausages|creole seasoning|jalapeno peppers
steps: place all ingredients in a crockpot and cook on low about 8 hours or until beans are done

name: Crock pot roast pork
ingredients: pork roast|salt and pepper|garlic clove|onions|bay leaf|hot water|soy sauce
steps: rub pork roast with salt and pepper make tiny slits in meat and insert slivers of garlic place in broiler pan and broil about 15-20 minutes to remove excess fat check frequently mix hot water and soy sauce put one sliced onion in bottom of crockpot add browned pork roast and remaining onion and other ingredients cover and cook on high for 4 or so hours low setting would probably be 6-8 hours to thicken gravy: remove roast to serving platter blend 2 tablespoons cornstarch with 2 tablespoons cold water to form a smooth paste stir well and let come to a boil doesn't get too thick which is how we like it)

name: Crock pot salsa chicken
ingredients: chicken breasts|salsa|taco seasoning|low-fat cream of mushroom soup|reduced-fat sour cream
steps: put chicken , salsa , taco seasoning , and soup in crock pot cook on low for 6-8 hours remove from crockpot and break up chicken stir in sour cream serve over rice

name: Crock pot shredded chicken sandwiches
ingredients: boneless chicken|chicken flavor stuffing mix|cream of chicken soup|chicken broth
steps: empty can of chicken into large bowl or even crockpot container , do not drain open stuffing and can of cream of chicken , mix with large spoon or use clean hands to break up meat and throughly mix ingredients place in crockpot cook on medium for approx 2 hours or until warmed thru , stir as needed add and stir in the chicken broth as needed if mixture becomes a little dry if preparing to bake in oven , add extra broth prior to baking in a greased casserole at 350

name: Crock pot slow cooker enchilada casserole
ingredients: ground beef|onion|garlic clove|salt|pepper|corn tortillas|fresh corn|enchilada sauce|cheddar cheese|sliced ripe olives|sour cream
steps: brown ground beef and drain add onion and garlic cook over medium heat until tender and transparent add salt and pepper place 2 tortillas in bottom of crockpot place a third of the following in layers over the tortillas: meat , corn , sauce , cheese and olives repeat tortillas and other layers two times cover and cook on low 6-8 hours serve with sour cream

name: Crock pot smothered chicken
ingredients: vegetable oil|onion|green bell pepper|celery|carrot|garlic cloves|skinless chicken breast|mushroom gravy|button mushrooms|evaporated milk|salt & pepper
steps: heat oil over medium-high heat add onion , green bell pepper , carrots garlic and celery saute 2 minutes or until vegetables are crisp tender add chicken and cook 6 to 7 minutes per side or until browned add to crockpot combine mushroom gravy mix and milk stir into chicken mixture in crockpot add mushrooms and liquid to crockpot cover , set temperature to low and cook 6 to 8 hours serve over buscuits or noodles , if desired

name: Crock pot southern living style tortilla soup
ingredients: boneless chicken breasts|frozen whole kernel corn|onion|garlic cloves|chicken broth|tomato sauce|tomatoes and green chilies|black beans|salt|cumin|chili powder|ground red pepper|black pepper|bay leaf|tortilla chips|cheddar cheese
steps: combine all ingredients in a slow cooker cover and cook for 4- 6 hours on high or 8 hours on low shred chicken before serving serve topped with tortilla chips and cheese may serve over tortillas chips if desired

name: Crock pot spaghetti sauce
ingredients: ground beef|ground pork|onion|diced tomatoes|tomato paste|tomato sauce|bay leaves|garlic cloves|dried oregano|salt|dried basil|brown sugar|dried thyme
steps: brown meats & onion in a skillet & drain well transfer to your crockpot add remaining ingredients & mix well cover & cook on low for 8-10 hours serve over hot spaghetti noodles

name: Crock pot steak fajitas
ingredients: chunky salsa|tomato paste|olive oil|minced garlic clove|fresh lime juice|pepper|salt|flank steaks|onion|sweet red pepper strips|fajita-size flour tortilla
steps: combine first eight ingredients in the crockpot place chopped onion and red peppers on top cook on low for 6 to 8 hours enjoy !

name: Crock pot sunday pot roast
ingredients: beef roast|cream of mushroom soup|french onion soup|potatoes|baby carrots
steps: place all ingredients in crock pot on low setting before going to bed roast will be tender and ready for lunch next day !

name: Crock pot sweet sour meatballs
ingredients: meatballs|sweet and sour sauce|pineapple chunks
steps: mix all ingredients and cook on high on crockpot on high for 2 hours or on low for 4 hours serve over hot rice enjoy

name: Crock pot sweet sour tofu
ingredients: extra firm tofu|cornstarch|vegetable oil|white onion|yellow bell pepper|broccoli floret|carrot|sliced water chestnuts|sweet and sour sauce|water
steps: press moisture out of the tofu and cut into cubes place tofu in a gallon-sized plastic bag with the corn starch shake bag to coat tofu fry tofu in vegetable oil over medium heat until it has a crunchy coating , about 15 minutes on each side put tofu and vegetables into the crock-pot pour bottle of sweet & sour sauce over the top add a tablespoon of water to the "empty" jar shake and pour over the top of the tofu & vegetables stir to combine cover and cook on low for 3 hours

name: Crock pot swiss chicken
ingredients: chicken breasts|swiss cheese|cream of mushroom soup|milk|seasoned stuffing mix|butter
steps: lightly spray crock-pot with cooking spray place chicken breasts in bottom of crock-pot top with cheese combine soup and milk , stirring well spoon soup mixture over cheese sprinkle with stuffing mix drizzle melted butter over stuffing mix cook on high 4 to 6 hours

name: Crock pot trip to the orient
ingredients: vegetable oil|fresh ginger|garlic cloves|onion|carrot|stew meat|star anise|cinnamon sticks|five-spice powder|light soy sauce|sugar|beef stock
steps: heat oil in wok over high heat add the ginger , garlic , and onion stir fry for 1 minute add beef chunks and carrots , and continue to stir fry for 2 to 2 1 / 2 minutes on high heat add remaining ingredients and mix well transfer to crock pot and cook on low 6 to 8 hours serve with rice enjoy !

name: Crock pot turkey breast and gravy
ingredients: turkey breast|olive oil|garlic powder|salt|italian seasoning|black pepper|onion|carrots|celery|turkey stock|butter|flour
steps: remove skin if desired , and brine turkey the night before rinse turkey thoroughly and pat dry rub with olive oil , followed by seasonings and spices place carrots , onion and celery in bottom of slow cooker place turkey on top of vegetables add enough stock to cover vegetables cook on high 1 hour , and low until done , 3-6 hours depending on your slow cooker and size of turkey i checked the temperature after 3 1 / 2 hours and it was done at 165 degrees , but i kept it on warm until dinner since it was done much earlier than i expected remove turkey and let rest while you make gravy to make gravy , measure 2 cups of broth from the slow cooker even though you only added about a cup or so of stock , the turkey and veg make more juice careful , it's hot ! i turned off my cooker about a half hour earlier so it wouldn't be as scalding melt butter over med heat and whisk in flour for 2-3 minute to make a blonde roux slowly add stock while constantly stirring until desired consistency reached season with salt and pepper to taste , but taste it first because mine needed no salt

name: Crock pot turkey vegetable soup aka diet soup
ingredients: water|tomato juice|beef bouillon cubes|soy sauce|lean ground turkey|cabbage|carrots|celery rib|onion|frozen green beans|salt|pepper
steps: brown & drain ground turkey combine all ingredients in slow cooker cover cook on low 4-8 hours

name: Crock pot vegetarian chili
ingredients: butternut squash|carrots|onion|tomatoes|black beans|kidney beans|green chilies|vegetable stock|chili powder|salt|fresh cilantro
steps: combine all ingredients except cilantro in medium-sized crockpot cook on low 6-8 hours add cilantro cook on high 15-20 minutes longer

name: Crock pot white beans
ingredients: dried great northern beans|water|olive oil|onions|celery|bell pepper|fresh kale|seasoning salt|dried thyme|dry oregano|garlic powder|bay leaves|andouille sausages
steps: sort beans and soak overnight in enough pure , fresh , water to cover the beans - or - use the quick method: sort the beans then put them in a saucepan with enough water to cover , and bring them to a boil boil the beans for 3 minutes , then cover and remove from heat allow to sit for one hour after boiling after using either pre-soak method , be sure to rinse and drain the beans completely of their soaking liquid before putting them in the crock pot put a couple table spoons of olive oil in the bottom of the crock pot then throw in the beans and all the other ingredients the water used to soak the beans should be discarded because it may add bitterness cover and cook on low for about 8 hours , or until beans are tender and creamy prep time is long only because of the soaking & slow cooking the ingredients come together very quickly - no more than about 10 minutes of actual prep

name: Crock pot wild rice pilaf
ingredients: wild rice|onion|salt|ground black pepper|low sodium chicken broth|water|sliced mushrooms|dried thyme leaves
steps: spray 3 quart slow cooker with nonstick cooking spray rinse rice and drain well combine in crockpot together with green onion , salt , chicken broth and water and mix well cover crockpot and cook on high for 3-4 hours add mushrooms and thyme and stir gently cover and cook on low for 30-60 minutes longer , until wild rice pops and is tender

name: Crock roasted summer vegetables
ingredients: red bell peppers|red onions|yellow squash|zucchini|fresh green beans|garlic cloves|olive oil|fresh basil|salt|fresh ground pepper|flat leaf parsley|white balsamic vinegar
steps: add all the vegetables to the slow cooker add in the oil and basil season with salt and pepper to taste toss to coat evenly cover and cook on high 1 to 2 hours or until the vegetables are just tender and still hold their shape serve sprinkled with the parsley and vinegar

name: Crocked bacon wrapped chicken
ingredients: boneless skinless chicken breasts|bacon|sour cream|cream of mushroom soup|mushrooms|pimiento
steps: wrap each chicken breast with a slice of bacon and secure with a toothpick combine the sour cream and mushroom soup and mushrooms pour over the chicken breasts cook on low in the crock pot or 8-10 hours or on high for 6-8 hours

name: Crocked beef fajitas
ingredients: chunky salsa|tomato paste|olive oil|garlic cloves|fresh lime juice|fresh ground black pepper|salt|flank steaks|white onion|red bell peppers|flour tortilla|guacamole|plum tomato|fresh cilantro
steps: in a bowl , combine the salsa , tomato paste , olive oil , garlic , lime juice , pepper , and salt place the flank steak in the slow cooker pour the mixture over the steak , making sure to coat all exposed surfaces well lay the onion and bell peppers on top cover and cook on low for 6-8 hours , until meat is tender remove the steak and vegetables from the juice and transfer to a serving platter cover with foil and let stand 10 minutes cut the meat across the grain into 1 / 2-inch slices serve it heaped over warm tortillas with the peppers and onions on top garnish with a little guac , chopped tomatoes , and cilantro on top

name: Crocked beer cheese spread
ingredients: sharp cheddar cheese|worcestershire sauce|garlic cloves|hot sauce|salt|fresh ground black pepper|beer
steps: blend all ingredients in a blender or food processor until a coarse puree place in a crock and chill several hours or overnight before serving keeps several weeks in refrigerator

name: Crocked brown rice on a budget
ingredients: brown rice|frozen southwest corn|stewed tomatoes|chicken broth|pinto beans|celery|onion|garlic cloves|sweet paprika|salt|pepper
steps: add all to the crockpot and stir to combine cook on high 2 5 to 3 hours stir gently and serve this completely fills a 4qt crockpot when done

name: Crocked cheese soup
ingredients: cream of celery soup|milk|sharp cheddar cheese|worcestershire sauce
steps: add all to crockpot cook 4-6 hours serve with croutons it's important to cube the cheese so that there are little pockets of cheese throughout the soup

name: Crocked chicken noodle stoup
ingredients: cooked chicken breasts|onion|butter|celery rib|condensed cream of chicken soup|low sodium chicken broth|water|broccoli|carrots|thyme|rosemary|parsley|fresh ground black pepper|egg noodles|salt
steps: heat skillet and melt butter over medium-high heat add onion and celery and cook to soften combine all ingredients , except noodles and broccoli in crock pot cook on low for 5-6 hours or high for 3-4 turn to high if on low setting add broccoli and noodles for last hour

name: Crocked fruit
ingredients: brandy|sugar|peaches
steps: place all ingredients in a glass or plastic container with a loose fitting lid allow to "work" at room temp for two weeks to stop[ process , simply refrigerate , to continue fruit crock every 2 weeks add 1 c sugar , and 1 c fruit

name: Crocked kielbasa
ingredients: lean ground beef|kielbasa|whole tomatoes|frozen french-cut green beans|pitted black olives|red wine|garlic cloves|onion|green pepper|basil|oregano|thyme|pepper|pasta|parmesan cheese
steps: in a medium skillet , saute ground beef when browned , transfer to crock pot add all other ingredients except pasta& parmesan simmer on low for 6-8 hours cook pasta according to directions ladle kielbasa over pasta in large bowls pass the parmesan cheese to garnish

name: Crocked macaroni and cheese
ingredients: evaporated milk|salt|black pepper|garlic powder|dry mustard|sharp cheddar cheese|cheese|margarine|elbow macaroni
steps: mix together milk , water , salt , pepper , garlic powder , mustard , cheeses , and margarine in saucepan heat until cheese is melted and mixture is smooth , stirring constantly place cooked macaroni in crockpot , and pour cheese mixture over top cook for 6 hours on low heat

name: Crocked pineapple chicken
ingredients: boneless skinless chicken breast halves|pepper|paprika|pineapple chunks in juice|dijon mustard|soy sauce|garlic
steps: arrange chicken in bottom of crockpot sprinkle with pepper and paprika in a small bowl , combine drained pineapple tidbits , mustard and soy sauce pour over chicken add minced garlic cover and cook on low 7-9 hours or high 3-4 hours

name: Crocked spiced up pot roast
ingredients: pot roast|brown gravy mix|heinz 57 steak sauce|dijon mustard|worcestershire sauce|bay leaves|garlic powder|balsamic vinegar|water|red wine|salt and pepper
steps: sprinkle meat with salt and pepper place in slow cooker combine remaining ingredients pour over pot roast cover cook on low 8-10 hours-- enjoy

name: Crockery bbq beef for sandwiches
ingredients: cola|worcestershire sauce|vinegar|garlic cloves|beef bouillon|dried mustard|chili powder|boneless chuck roast|onion|ketchup|margarine
steps: combine cola , worcestershire sauw , vinegar , garlic , boullion , mustard , chili powder in a small bowl reserve 1 / 2 cup liquid for sauce trim excess fat from meat cut meat to fit into crock pot top with onions pour sauce over cover and cook 10 to 12 hours on low meanwhile for sauce , in a small sauce pan , combine the 1 / 2 cup reserved liquid , ketchup and margarine heat through transfer cooked meat to cutting board and shred discard cooking liquid , serve meat on bed of shredded letuce or buns pass sauce

name: Crockery cooker pot roast
ingredients: roast|potatoes|mushroom stems and pieces|baby carrots|dried tarragon|salt|condensed mushroom soup|nonstick cooking spray
steps: trim fat from meat spray an unheated large skillet with nonstick cooking spray add meat and brown on all sides place unpeeled potatoes , mushrooms , frozen carrots , and tarragon or basil in a 3-1 / 2- to 4-quart electric crockery cooker place browned meat on top of vegetables sprinkle with salt pour condensed soup over meat cover and cook on low-heat setting for 10 to 12 hours to serve , transfer meat and vegetables to a serving platter serve the sauce over meat and vegetables

name: Crockery pot cabbage rolls
ingredients: cabbage leaves|lean ground beef|cooked rice|tomato paste|water|salt|pepper|thyme
steps: wash cabbage leaves bring 4 cups water to an boil and turn off heat soak leaves in water for 5 minutes remove , drain and cool combine ground meat , rice , salt , pepper , and thyme place 2 tablespoons meat mixture on each leaf and roll firmly stack in slow cooker combine tomato paste and water pour over stuffed cabbabe cook on low setting for 8-10 hours

name: Crockery pot delight
ingredients: boneless beef chuck roast|flour|butter|onion|salt|pepper|garlic clove|beer
steps: coat beef cubes with the 1 / 2 cup flour brown in melted butter drain off excess fat in crockery pot , combine all browned meat with onion , salt , pepper , garlic and beer cover and cook on low 5-7 hours or all day until meat is tender turn crockery pot to high dissolve remaining 1 / 4 cup flour in small amount of water stir into meat mixture , cook on high 30-40 minutes serve with rice and salad for a complete meal

name: Crockery pot spaghetti sauce
ingredients: cooking oil|onion|tomato sauce|water|pepper|red pepper|ground beef|tomato puree|tomato paste|salt|oregano|italian sausages
steps: brown ground beef in 2 tablespoons hot oil in frying pan when almost browned , add onion and continue browning until onion is tender pour meat and onion into 3 1 / 2 quart crock pot add puree , sauce , paste , water , salt , pepper and oregano and set dial on low setting cut sausage into pieces and brown in remaining 2 tablespoons oil when brown , place sausages in sauce in crock pot continue cooking for 12 hours

name: Crockery pot taco casserole
ingredients: ground beef|onion|garlic clove|green pepper|tabasco sauce|tomato sauce|chili powder|frozen corn|chili with beans|cheese|tortilla chips
steps: brown ground meat and drain add onion , garlic , 1 drop tabasco and pepper and cook until onion is transparent add remaining tabasco , tomato sauce and chili powder grease crock pot , and layer in 5 layers , beginning with meat mixture and nacho cheese tortilla tortilla chips , then the corn , chili and grated cheese cover and cook 6-8 hours on low

name: Crockette macaroni cheese
ingredients: cooked macaroni|butter|evaporated milk|salt|processed cheese|onion
steps: toss macaroni with butter or margarine add remaining ingredients pour into lightly greased crock-ette cover and cook 2 1 / 2 to 4 hours , stirring once or twice

name: Crockette souper steak
ingredients: steak|cream of mushroom soup|salt|pepper
steps: sprinkle salt and pepper over steak put steak in crock pot and pour can of soup over it cook about 8 hours

name: Crockpot beef brisket
ingredients: beef brisket|onion|garlic cloves|paprika|salt|black pepper|chili sauce|worcestershire sauce|beer|tomatoes|fresh cilantro stems
steps: spray crockpot with cooking oil place beef brisket fat side down in crockpot and add onion slices , minced garlic , paprika and salt and pepper on top pour chili sauce and worcestershire sauce over brisket and cook on low setting for 6 hours then , pour beer over brisket and increase temperature to high and continue cooking for 30 more minutes when well cook and tender , slice brisket against the grain and place slices on large serving platter serve with hot cooking liquid sauce and garnish with sliced tomatoes and cilantro or parsley , if you like

name: Crockpot nacho potatoes
ingredients: lean ground beef|onion|garlic clove|green peppers|garlic salt|ground black pepper|fiesta nacho cheese soup|milk|potatoes|sour cream|salsa|green onion
steps: in a large skillet , cook ground beef with chopped onion garlic , green peppers , garlic salt and pepper until meat is brown drain fat in a medium bowl , stir together the soup , undrained , and milk in a 4 or 5-quart crock pot , layer half of the potatoes , half of the ground beef mixture , and half of the soup mixture repeat layers cover and cook on low setting for about 3 to 4 hours or until potatoes are tender or on high for 2 to 3 hours gently stir before serving serve with sour cream , salsa and sliced green onions , if you like

name: Crockpot applesauce
ingredients: tart apples|brown sugar|lemon juice|cinnamon
steps: in a 3-4 qt crockpot , combine the apples , brown sugar & lemon juice cook on high 3-4 hours mash with a potato masher into the consistency you want stir in cinnamon & serve warm or cold

name: Crockpot asian turkey and rice soup
ingredients: reduced-sodium chicken broth|turkey breast tenderloin|fresh mushrooms|water|carrots|onion|reduced-sodium soy sauce|fresh ginger|garlic cloves|bok choy|instant brown rice|noodles
steps: in a 3-1 / 2- or 4-quart slow cooker stir together chicken broth , turkey , mushrooms , the water , carrots , onion , soy sauce , ginger , and garlic cover and cook on low-heat setting for 7 to 8 hours or on high-heat setting for 31 / 2 to 4 hours if using low-heat setting , turn to high-heat setting stir in bok choy and uncooked rice cover and cook for 10 to 15 minutes more or until rice is tender ladle into bowls if desired , top with lo mein noodles

name: Crockpot bavarian meatballs
ingredients: meatballs|onion|brown sugar|onion soup mix|beer|hoagie rolls|swiss cheese
steps: combine the meatballs , onion , brown sugar , soup mix and beer in a 3-1 / 2 quart crockpot cover and cook on lo for 3-1 / 2 to 4-1 / 2 hours or until heated through to make the sandwiches: place 6 meatballs on each bun bottom sprinkle each sandwich with 1 / 4 cup cheese place on baking sheets broil 4-6 inches from the heat for 2-3 minutes or until the cheese is melted cover each with bun top

name: Crockpot bbq beef sandwiches
ingredients: chuck roast|tomato ketchup|dijon-style mustard|brown sugar|garlic clove|worcestershire sauce|red wine vinegar|salt|pepper|french rolls
steps: place beef in slow cooker combine remaining ingredients , except rolls pour over meat cover and cook on low 8 hours or overnight shred beef by pulling it apart with 2 forks and add one cup sauce reheat mixture in microwave or on stovetop and spoon bbq beef onto warm , open-face rolls or buns top with additional warm sauce if desired nutrition information per serving: 298 calories 16g fat 18g protein 19g carbohydrates 1g dietary fiber 3g cholesterol 373mg sodium

name: Crockpot beef in mushroom gravy
ingredients: stew meat|cream of mushroom soup|diet sprite|onion soup mix|onion|sliced mushrooms
steps: empty can of sprite , can of soup and soup packet into crockpot add onion and beef stir together , and cook on low for 4-5 hours stir contents , add frehs mushrooms and cook on high 1 hr longer sometimes i add a little crushed red pepper for some spice enjoy just cook about 7-8 hrs on low instead

name: Crockpot beef stew
ingredients: roast|flour|vegetable oil|dried parsley flakes|garlic powder|ground black pepper|seasoning salt|potatoes|baby carrots|onion|water|campbell's golden mushroom soup|bay leaves
steps: in a large bowl add flour and cubed beef , cover meat with flour until well coated and set aside in a large skillet heat oil until hot but not smoking , then add beef when meat starts to brown , sprinkle with seasonings and stir until meat is coated while the meat is browning , place vegetables in the bottom of the crockpot place browned meat over vegetables , add water , soup and place bay leaves on top of soup check after 6 hours and remove bay leaves , stir once or twice until veggies are well blended

name: Crockpot beefed up taco soup
ingredients: 85% lean ground beef|onion|garlic|taco seasoning|pico de gallo|low sodium beef broth|sweet corn|dark red kidney beans|shredded cheddar cheese
steps: brown the ground beef with the onion adding the garlic the last few minutes drain stir in pico de gallo and taco seasoning until warm and combined add to crock pot add corn and kidney beans and stir continue to stir in the beef broth set crockpot to low or medium for 4 hours garnish with shredded cheddar or other favorite taco garnishes !

name: Crockpot black bean tortilla soup
ingredients: black beans|diced tomatoes with green chilies|enchilada sauce|onion|garlic clove|vegetable broth|ground cumin|chili powder|frozen corn|cilantro|corn tortillas
steps: combine all ingredients except tortillas in crockpot , cook on low 8 hours preheat oven to 400f lightly spray both sides of tortillas with nonstick cooking spray cut into thin strips and spread onto baking sheet bake , turning occasionally until crisp , 5-10 minutes sprinkle tortilla strips over hot soup and serve immediately

name: Crockpot brazilian chicken curry paleo
ingredients: chicken breasts|coconut milk|chicken broth|tomato paste|garlic cloves|ground ginger|curry powder|bell peppers|yellow onion|salt and pepper|red pepper flakes
steps: cut chicken pieces in half or quarters combine coconut milk , tomato paste , garlic , ginger , curry powder , salt and pepper , and red pepper flakes in the crockpot and whisk together add in peppers , chicken , and broth mix all ingredients together to completely cover the chicken in the curry mixture cover and cook at low for 6-8 hours or high for 4-5 hours

name: Crockpot breakfast casserole paleo
ingredients: eggs|sweet potatoes|pork sausage|yellow onion|garlic powder|dried basil|salt and pepper|vegetables
steps: grease crockpot with coconut oil , bacon fat , etc to make sure none of the egg sticks shred / grate the sweet potato add all ingredients to the crockpot and mix well cook on low for 6-8 hours spoon or slice out onto plates or into bowls

name: Crockpot breakfast omelette
ingredients: eggs|frozen hash brown potatoes|bacon|onion|green pepper|shredded cheddar cheese|milk|salt
steps: grease the inside of the crockpot with butter now layer your ingredients bottom to top using half of each ingredient each time listed 1 potatoes 2 bacon 3 onions and peppers 4 cheese 5 potatoes 6 bacon 7 onions and peppers 8 cheese now , beat the eggs , milk , and salt together pour this over the whole mixture cook on low for 7-8 hours

name: Crockpot cantonese tempeh
ingredients: tempeh|onion|green bell pepper|red bell peppers|mixed mushrooms|carrots|diced tomatoes|tomato paste|vegetable broth|brown sugar|vinegar|salt|worcestershire sauce|cornstarch|water
steps: mix all ingredients , except cornstarch and water , together in crockpot cover and cook on low for 6 hours dissolve cornstarch in water and stir into crockpot to thicken sauce into a glaze cover and cook another 20 minutes or until sauce thickens serve over rice

name: Crockpot caritas
ingredients: pork shoulder|garlic cloves|fresh jalapeno pepper|fresh cilantro|beer|corn tortilla
steps: with a knife , cut several small slits into the roast insert pieces of garlic cloves in roast place in crockpot with whole pepper and half bunch of cilantro which has been chopped season to taste pour in beer cook on high 4 to 6 hours until fork tender remove meat shred serve with warm tortillas , with by your choice of garnishes suggested garnishes: diced tomatoes , onions , sliced ripe olives , shredded lettuce , sour cream , cheese , salsa , guacamole , and cilantro

name: Crockpot catalina apricot chicken
ingredients: boneless skinless chicken breasts|catalina dressing|dry onion soup mix|apricot jam
steps: place chicken in a greased 3-1 / 2 to 5-quart slow cooker in a bowl , combine salad dressing , onion soup mix and preserves pour over chicken cover and cook on lo heat 5-7 hours do not cook on hi heat serve over hot cooked rice with a fresh garden salad

name: Crockpot cheesy chicken spaghetti
ingredients: spaghetti|velveeta reduced fat cheese product|chicken breasts|98% fat-free cream of mushroom soup|98% fat-free cream of chicken soup|rotel tomatoes & chilies|mushroom stems and pieces|water|onion|green pepper|salt & pepper
steps: spray slow cooker with non-stick cooking spray combine all ingredients in slow cooker and stir well cook on low for 2-3 hours stir again just before serving

name: Crockpot cheesy potatoes
ingredients: hash brown potatoes|butter|cream of chicken soup|onion|sour cream|cheddar cheese|french-fried onions
steps: lightly grease crockpot or 13x9 pan for crockpot , mix all ingredients , except sour cream and cheese , and cook on low for 4-6 hours mix in sour cream and cheese during the last hour of cooking and then add topping for oven , mix all ingredients and pour into pan add topping and bake at 325 degrees for 1 hour

name: Crockpot cheesy southern grits
ingredients: grits|water|heavy whipping cream|sharp cheddar cheese|butter|salt
steps: soften the butter combine all ingredients except the shredded cheese cook on low in the crock pot for 6-8 hours stirring occasionally about 15 - 30 minutes before serving stir in shredded cheese enjoy !

name: Crockpot chicken noodles
ingredients: boneless skinless chicken breasts|cream of chicken soup|chicken broth|butter|egg noodles
steps: place everything but noodles in a crock pot cook on low 5-6 hours remove chicken and shred return chicken to pot and add egg noodles cook 2 more hours you can add pepper for a little kick

name: Crockpot chicken rice
ingredients: chicken tenderloins|cream of mushroom soup|cream of celery soup|rice|chicken broth|frozen peas
steps: all all ingredients to crockpot and turn on high for 4 hours , or until chicken and rice are cooked through should be sticky !

name: Crockpot chicken and dumplings
ingredients: boneless chicken breasts|chicken broth|cream of chicken soup|onion|peas|carrots|biscuits
steps: slice the chicken breast into chunks combine all ingredients except biscuits in crock pot season to taste with salt , pepper , seasoning salt and onion powder cook until chicken is tender , approximately 5 to 6 hours cut biscuits into fourths and add to chicken mixture cover and cook 30 minutes and stir mixture gently , this will thickened chicken broth cover and cook until dumplings are done

name: Crockpot chicken and vegetables
ingredients: chicken breasts|white onion|baby carrots|new potatoes|white wine|chicken broth|salt|paprika|pepper|thyme
steps: cut onions into wedges and place on the bottom of the crock pot add the carrots cut the the potatoes in half or fourths next , add the white wine and broth sprinkle the thyme , half the pepper , and salt over the vegetables then , place the breasts on top rub the paprika and the remaining salt and pepper into the skin of the chicken cook on low for eight hours

name: Crockpot chicken burritos
ingredients: cream of mushroom soup|black beans|salsa|boneless skinless chicken breasts|chilies|cumin|chili powder|cayenne pepper
steps: cook on low all day , pull out your chicken and shred then mix back inches serve on your favorite tortilla with cheese , sour cream , guacamole or whatever i find this gets kind of soupy so you could even throw in some corn and tortilla strips in a bowl and eat like a soup

name: Crockpot chicken enchilada casserole
ingredients: corn tortillas|bell peppers|chicken|chili powder|ground black pepper|salt|green chili peppers|mexican blend cheese|enchilada sauce|black beans|sour cream
steps: spray slow cooker with cooking spray place 3 tortillas in bottom of slow cooker top tortillas with the corn , half of the chicken , about half of the seasonings , and half of the chile peppers sprinkle with half of the shredded cheese and pour about 3 / 4 cup of enchilada sauce over the cheese repeat with 3 more tortillas , the black beans , remaining chicken , seasonings , chile peppers , and cheese top with remaining tortillas and enchilada sauce cover and cook on low setting for 5 to 6 hours serve with guacamole and sour cream

name: Crockpot chicken quesadillas
ingredients: chicken breast|salsa|corn|tortillas|mexican cheese|taco seasoning|sour cream
steps: combine chicken , salsa , corn , and taco seasoning in a crock pot cook on low for 6-8 hours before serving , shred chicken with a fork spray a skillet with cooking spray and add a tortilla on half , add chicken mixture top with cheese fold tortilla over and let brown after 1 minute , flip to other side

name: Crockpot chicken ranch tacos
ingredients: chicken breasts|taco seasoning|ranch dressing|chicken broth|lettuce|tomatoes|cheese|sour cream
steps: place breasts in crock pot add remaining ingredients except toppings cook on low 3 hours remove chicken and shread return to pot cook 1 / 2 hour longer make tacos as you like

name: Crockpot chicken stew
ingredients: russet potatoes|carrots|onion|garlic powder|salt|ground black pepper|sage|thyme|boneless skinless chicken breast halves|cream of chicken soup
steps: place veggies in the bottom of a 2 1 / 2 quart crockpot sprinkle seasonings evenly over the veggies top with chicken , then cover with soup cook on low for 6 hours

name: Crockpot chicken supreme
ingredients: condensed cream of chicken soup|dry onion soup mix|boneless skinless chicken breasts|bacon|reduced-fat sour cream
steps: spray inside of slow cooker with cooking spray combine soup wih dry soup mix in medium bowl mix well layer chicken breasts and soup mixture in slow cooker sprinkle with bacon cover cook on low 8 hours during last hour of cooking , stir in sour cream may serve over noodles

name: Crockpot chicken taco chili
ingredients: onion|black beans|pinto beans|tomato sauce|frozen corn kernels|rotel tomatoes|taco seasoning|cumin|dried chipotle powder|boneless skinless chicken breasts|jalapeno pepper|fresh cilantro
steps: combine beans , onion , chili peppers , corn , tomato sauce , cumin , chili powder and taco seasoning in a slow cooker place chicken on top and cover cook on low for approximately 8 hours or on high for 6 hours check towards end time so as not to overcook half hour before serving , remove chicken and shred return chicken to slow cooker and stir top with fresh cilantro

name: Crockpot chicken tortilla soup
ingredients: boneless skinless chicken breasts|rotel tomatoes & chilies|black beans|kidney beans|corn|onion|low sodium chicken broth|water|garlic powder|chili powder|cumin powder|tortilla chips|sour cream|shredded cheddar cheese
steps: instead of these spices , you could include a packet of taco seasoning if you prefer put chopped onion , cans of beans , rotel , corn , chicken broth , water , and spices in crockpot and stir to mix put chicken breasts on top of mixture and make sure they're at least partly submerged in liquid cook on high 6-7 hours or low 8-9 hours before serving remove the chicken breasts from soup and shred , if needed , return chicken to crockpot , stir to combine to serve put a few tortilla chips in the bottom of a bowl , ladle soup over tortilla chips , top with shredded cheddar cheese , and a dollop of sour cream , serve with more chips if you like enjoy !

name: Crockpot chili sauce chicken
ingredients: chicken thighs|chili sauce|brown sugar|dry onion soup mix|cayenne pepper
steps: spray 5 quart slow cooker and arrange chicken pieces in bottom of cooker combine chili sauce , brown sugar , dry onion soup mix , cayenne pepper and 1 / 4 cup water and spoon over chicken cover and cook on low for 6-7 hours

name: Crockpot cream cheese chicken mushrooms
ingredients: boneless skinless chicken breasts|italian salad dressing mix|butter|whole mushrooms|onion|garlic cloves|healthy request cream of chicken soup|cream cheese|chicken broth
steps: put chicken in crockpot and sprinkle with dressing mix and 2 tablespoons of melted butter cook on low 4-6 hours lightly brush off the dirt from the mushrooms with a damp paper towel , and slice off the tough ends place mushrooms in the crockpot with the chicken and cover melt 2 tbs of butter in sauce pan saute onion and garlic until onions are clear add soup , cream cheese , and broth stir until smooth add to crockpot , stir together to combine ingredients cover and cook on low for another hour

name: Crockpot curried chicken with ginger and yogurt
ingredients: tomato paste|garlic cloves|curry powder|fresh ginger|ground cumin|water|onion|boneless skinless chicken thighs|salt|black pepper|greek yogurt|scallions
steps: in a 4- to 6-quart slow cooker , whisk together the tomato paste , garlic , curry powder , ginger , cumin , and water add the onion and stir to combine place the chicken on top and season with 1 teaspoon salt and the pepper cover and cook until the chicken is tender , on low for 7 to 8 hours or on high for 3 to 4 hours just before serving , add the yogurt and teaspoon salt to the chicken and stir to combine serve with rice or pasta and sprinkle with the scallions

name: Crockpot curried lentils
ingredients: lentils|onion|carrots|celery rib|garlic cloves|chicken broth|soy sauce|worcestershire sauce|tomato paste|dried mushroom|curry powder|ground cinnamon|ground ginger|ground cumin|bay leaves|diced tomatoes|half-and-half|frozen spinach
steps: combine everything except the tomatoes , dairy , and spinach in the crockpot cook on low 8-10 hours 30 minutes before serving , remove the bay leaves , add the tomatoes and pulse with an immersion blender to grind up about half the lentils stir in the half-and-half , and the spinach if using cook another 30 minutes serve hot with rice or couscous

name: Crockpot dijon chicken
ingredients: cream of chicken soup|dijon mustard|cornstarch|black pepper|water|chicken breasts
steps: whisk water , soup , cornstarch , mustard , and pepper in a medium-sized bowl until the consistency is smooth set the chicken in the slow cooker and pour the mustard sauce in , covering the chicken cover , and cook approximately 4 hours on low or 2 hours on high

name: Crockpot dressing
ingredients: cornbread|white bread|eggs|onion|celery|sage|salt|black pepper|cream of chicken soup|chicken broth|butter
steps: butter sides of crockpot in a large mixing bowl , crumble bread and add eggs , onion , celery , sage , salt , pepper , soup and broth mix well pour into crockpot dot top with 2 tablespoons of butter cover & cook on high for 2 hours cook on low for 3 to 4 hours

name: Crockpot dulce de leche
ingredients: sweetened condensed milk|water
steps: place an oven safe dish into a four quart slow cooker pour the condensed milk into the dish pour hot water around the outside of the dish until it comes 3 / 4 of the way up the sides cover and cook on low 8 hours

name: Crockpot dulce de leche sweet potato pudding cake
ingredients: unsalted butter|all-purpose flour|baking powder|baking soda|salt|ground cinnamon|brown sugar|sweet potatoes|eggs|vanilla extract|coconut milk|pecans|dulce de leche|flaked coconut
steps: melt butter in a small saucepan over medium heat cook , whisking constantly , until butter foams and starts to turn golden brown place browned butter in a large mixing bowl in a medium mixing bowl , sift together flour , baking powder , baking soda , salt and cinnamon whisk until combined add brown sugar and sweet potato to mixing bowl with browned butter beat , using a mixer on medium speed , until creamy - about 1 minute beat in eggs and vanilla until combined - about 1 minute reduce mixer speed to low and gradually beat in flour mixture , alternating with coconut milk until just combined stir in pecans until combined spray a slow cooker with cooking spray spread batter evenly into slow cooker cover and cook on low for 45 minutes pour dulce de leche on top , sprinkle with coconut , cover , and cook an additional 1 hour turn slow cooker off and allow to cool 45 minutes before serving

name: Crockpot easiest ever chuck roast
ingredients: chuck roast|italian salad dressing mix|dry onion soup mix|brown gravy mix
steps: that's it ! mix them all up and spread over roast with water on bottom of crockpot cook all day on low you'll be amazed add vegetables of your choice the last hour or two (i do use name brand dry soups

name: Crockpot easy cheesy potato casserole
ingredients: frozen hash brown potatoes|condensed cheddar cheese soup|evaporated milk|french fried onion rings|salt and pepper
steps: combine all ingredients except for 1 / 2 of the french fried onion rings pour into a greased crockpot cover and cook on lo heat for 8-9 hours or on hi heat for 4 hours spoon remaining onion rings on top before serving

name: Crockpot french herbed chicken
ingredients: roasting chickens|seasoned flour|olive oil|carrot|onion|mushrooms|celery|sauterne white wine|fresh parsley|dried thyme|bay leaf|pepper
steps: in shallow bowl or pie plate , dredge chicken in seasoned flour heat a tablespoon of the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat brown chicken in hot oil , in batches , adding more oil if necessary remove to crockpot drain excess fat from skillet add carrots , onions , mushrooms , and celery and saut over medium heat a couple of minutes to soften the vegetables a bit add wine and seasonings and bring just to the boiling point allow to boil a minute or two in order to thicken and reduce the sauce a little pour over chicken in crockpot , including any bits left on the bottom of the skillet cover and cook on low setting for 3-4 hours remove bay leaf and celery before serving

name: Crockpot gourmet chili
ingredients: onion|fresh garlic cloves|olive oil|pork tenderloin|beans|dark red kidney beans|black beans|tomato sauce|sweet corn|mild chili powder|cumin|salt|ground black pepper|cayenne pepper|sharp cheddar cheese|green olives|black olives|avocados|fresh cilantro|grape tomatoes|green onions|red bell pepper|fresh jalapeno peppers|habanero pepper|natural sour cream|tabasco sauce|oyster crackers
steps: heat oil in cast iron skillet or your favorite sautee pan sautee onion and garlic until translucent and garlic is fragrant do not brown the garlic as it will become bitter place pork tenderloin and all remaining ingredients in 5 quart crockpot add sauteed onion and garlic , stir gently set crockpot on low heat and let cook for 8-10 hours , until pork tenderloin is soft put toppings in individual dishes or in a lazy suzan serve chili in bowls and allow guests to choose their toppings this makes a great fun community meal !

name: Crockpot granola
ingredients: oats|honey|butter|chia seeds|slivered almonds|pumpkin seeds|sunflower seeds|dried fruit
steps: put all the dry ingredients into your crockpot melt the butter in the microwave , and add add the honey toss well cover , but vent with a chopstick cook on high for 3-4 hours , stirring every so often dump out on some parchment paper and let cool

name: Crockpot ham
ingredients: bone-in ham|dark rum|brown sugar|dijon mustard|honey|pepper
steps: place ham into crockpot mix together all remaining ingredients pour over ham cook on high for first hour reduce heat to low for next five hours

name: Crockpot ham and bean soup
ingredients: navy beans|onion|celery|ham|bay leaf|salt and pepper|water
steps: soak the beans overnight the next morning , after i rinse the beans , i just throw everything in the crockpot , put in enough water to come within an inch of the top of the crock and put it on low for 8 hours or as long as 12 hours this usually works great in my 3 5 qt crockpot rethinking this , i realized that everyone doesn't have the same size crockpot that i did , i would suggest adding water to no higher than an inch above the beans remove the bay leaf and serve

name: Crockpot ham and potatoes
ingredients: carrots|potatoes|onion|ham|butter|flour|milk|black pepper|parsley|dijon mustard|cheddar cheese
steps: layer carrots , potatoes , onions , and ham in crockpot in skillet , melt butter stir in flour gradually add milk stir frequently until sauce is smooth and thickened add pepper , parsley , mustard , and cheese continue stirring until cheese melts pour over vegetables and ham in crockpot , try to cover them all cook on low for 6 hours

name: Crockpot ham simple
ingredients: spiral cut ham|cranberry sauce|crushed pineapple
steps: put ham in crock pot dump cranberry sauce on top have fun ! rub sauce in between slices dump pineapple and juice on top of ham cook on low for eight hours eat thankfully

name: Crockpot hamburger stroganoff
ingredients: lean ground beef|onion|garlic clove|tomato paste|beef broth|sherry wine|salt|black pepper|fresh mushrooms|sour cream
steps: brown ground beef with onion and garlic drain fat add to crock pot with remaining ingredients except for sour cream cover and cook on low for 5 to 7 hours stir in sour cream heat through serve over egg noodles

name: Crockpot honey apple pork loin
ingredients: pork loin|granny smith apples|honey|cinnamon
steps: lay the apple slices in the bottom of the crockpot sprinkle with cinnamon cut slits in the pork loin drizzle some honey into the slits then place apple slices into the slits place the pork loin into the crockpot drizzle the top with the remainder of the honey place the rest of the apples on top then sprinkle the whole thing with cinnamon cook on low for 7 hours

name: Crockpot hot fudge cake
ingredients: bisquick|sugar|baking cocoa|milk|vanilla|tap water
steps: mix bisquick , 1 / 2 cup sugar , 3 tablespoons cocoa , milk and vanilla pour into greased crockpot mix remaining 1 / 2 cup sugar , 1 / 3 cup cocoa and hot water and pour over batter in crockpot do not stir together cook on high for 2 - 2 5 hours when it's done , the cake will have risen to the top , floating on the hot fudge sauce yum !

name: Crockpot irish oatmeal
ingredients: steel cut oats|water|apple|raisins|cinnamon|brown sugar|honey|salt|cream|irish whiskey
steps: mix all ingredients in crock pot cook on low for 8 hours

name: Crockpot italian roast
ingredients: tomato paste|garlic|onion soup mix|fresh oregano|fresh thyme|salt|pepper|chuck roast|diced tomatoes|onions|carrots|potatoes|celery ribs|bay leaves
steps: mix all your ingredients together - except the garlic - and add them to the slow cooker rub the roast with garlic , then add it to the mixture in the slow cooker and thoroughly coat the roast with the mixture cook for 10 hours on low or 5 hours on high , then serve be sure you take out the bay leaves before serving and eating

name: Crockpot king ranch casserole
ingredients: cooked chicken|onion|green bell pepper|cream of chicken soup|cream of mushroom soup|tomatoes|minced garlic cloves|chili powder|corn tortillas|sharp cheddar cheese
steps: stir together first 8 ingredients in a large bowl tear tortillas into 1 inch pieces divide into thirds layer one-third of tortilla pieces in a lightly greased 6 quart slow cooker top with one-third of chicken mixture and 1 cup of cheese repeat layers twice cover and cook on low for 3 1 / 2 hours or until bubbly and edges are golden brown uncover and cook on low 30 minutes serve with salad and blue corn chips on the side for a pretty presentation

name: Crockpot mac and cheese
ingredients: alfredo sauce|evaporated milk|whole milk|egg|dijon mustard|macaroni noodles|shredded cheddar cheese|american cheese|parmesan cheese|butter|white pepper|onion powder|garlic powder|salt
steps: spray the inside of the slow cooker with nonstick cooking spray in a large bowl , beat alfredo sauce with the fresh and evaporated milks , egg , and mustard stir in uncooked macaroni and all of the shredded cheeses , butter , pepper , onion and garlic powders , and salt mix well pour into 4 quart crockpot cover and cook on low for 3 to 4 hours test to make sure macaroni is cooked do not stir or remove the lid while this dish is cooking

name: Crockpot macaroni cheese
ingredients: macaroni|vegetable oil|evaporated milk|milk|salt|sharp cheddar cheese|butter|onions
steps: toss cooked macaroni in 2 tablespoons oil add all remaining ingredients pour into lightly greased crockpot stir well cover and cook on low for three to four hours , stirring occasionally

name: Crockpot mexican chicken
ingredients: boneless skinless chicken breasts|fat free cream cheese|salsa|taco seasoning|chili beans|cooked rice
steps: put some salsa on the bottom of the crockpot , put 2 chicken breasts down and sprinkle the taco seasoning on them soften the cream cheese and stir it with the remaining salsa and pour over the chicken then put the chili beans on top cook on low for 8 hours or cook on high for 3-4 hours you can stir as you like serve over rice

name: Crockpot mexican pulled pork
ingredients: pork shoulder blade roast|tomatoes|garlic cloves|onion|cilantro|chili powder|ground cumin|black pepper|oregano|paprika|red pepper flakes
steps: trim the visible fat from the pork place 1 can tomatoes on the bottom of the crockpot , follow w / pork , garlic and onion , sprinkle the taco seasoning evenly on the top , then cover w / cilantro cook on high for the 1st 3 hrs and on low for another 5 hours remove the pork and shred it , return to the crockpot , mix w / juice

name: Crockpot nutella hot chocolate
ingredients: milk|unsweetened cocoa powder|nutella|white sugar|hot water|whipped cream|candy sprinkles
steps: combine cocoa , sugar , nutella , and hot water in large pan stir , and bring to gentle boil transfer mixture to crockpot , and add milk stir , then cook on high for approximately 2 2 1 / 2 hours , or until hot pour into mugs , then top with whipped cream and sprinkles !

name: Crockpot parmesan ranch mushrooms
ingredients: fresh mushrooms|butter|ranch dressing mix|parmesan cheese
steps: put the mushrooms in the crockpot melt butter in a bowl and add the hidden valley ranch dressing package mix well and pour over mushrooms in the crockpot sprinkle with about two teaspoons of parmesan cheese or more to your liking cook in crockpot at low for 4 hours it gives a delicious side dishes or topping for a steak

name: Crockpot peanut pork
ingredients: boneless pork loin|red bell pepper|scallion|garlic cloves|rice wine vinegar|dark soy sauce|toasted sesame oil|orange, juice of|honey|powdered ginger|creamy peanut butter|chives|fresh cilantro|lime wedge
steps: place pork , peppers , scallion and garlic in slow cooker whisk together rice wine vinegar , dark soy sauce , sesame oil , orange juice , honey , and ginger pour into slow cooker cook on low 7-8 hours or high 3-4 hours remove meat to a plate and shred with two forks add peanut butter to sauce and blend smooth with immersion blender return meat to sauce serve over jasmine rice garnish with chives / scallions , cilantro and lime wedges

name: Crockpot peanut thai chicken lettuce wraps
ingredients: natural-style peanut butter|garlic|ginger|soy sauce|sesame oil|hot chili paste|chicken broth|chicken breasts|sweet pepper|green onion|lettuce
steps: mix peanut butter , garlic , ginger , soy sauces , sesame oil , sriracha and broth place frozen chick breast in bottom of crockpot and pour peanut sauce over breasts cook on low for 6-8 hours or high for 3-4 hours shred chicken and add back about cup of the peanut sauce serve on lettuce with green onions and peppers

name: Crockpot pinto beans and ham
ingredients: dry pinto beans|baking soda|pinto bean seasoning|sugar|vegetable oil|pepper|onion|ham hocks
steps: sort your beans and remove and broken pieces or pebbles i use one 16 oz package of beans place in a large bowl or pot , covering with water add the baking soda to the water , and let the beans soak at least 6 hours or overnight after 6 hours or overnight drain the water from the beans add the beans to a 6 quart crock pot and cover with fresh water you want the beans to be covered by at least one inch add the pinto bean seasoning , sugar , vegetable oil , pepper and onion taste the beans after several hours of cooking and add more seasonings if you think it needs it i used a total of one tablespoons pepper add one of the following for additional seasoning , one ham hock , ham bone , or slice of country ham cut into pieces place lid on crock pot and cook on high for about 6-8 hours make sure the beans stay covered with water , so check occasionally if you need more water , then add it the beans should have a soup consistency in 6 hours , test beans and if they are cooked remove ham bone and pull of the meat or remove meat from ham hock and serve don't forget the wedge of cornbread

name: Crockpot pork chop and apple dinner
ingredients: pork chops|pork stuffing mix|water|apple pie filling
steps: brown pork chops and drain off any fat place pork chops in a 4-quart crockpot prepare stuffing mix as directed on package , using the 1-1 / 2 cups water spoon stuffing mix over the pork chops top with the apple pie filling cover and cook on lo heat for 4-5 hours , until meat is tender

name: Crockpot pork chops
ingredients: pork chops|onion soup mix|chicken broth|cream of chicken soup|pork gravy mix
steps: place chops in crockpot in a bowl , mix all ingredients together & pour over chops cook on low for 6-8 hours

name: Crockpot pork chops and potatoes in sauce
ingredients: ketchup|water|celery|salt|lemon juice|pepper|onion|worcestershire sauce|vinegar|brown sugar|dry mustard|garlic|pork chops|raw potatoes
steps: mix first twelve ingredients in medium sized bowl spray large crockpot with pam put potatoes on bottom put pork chops on top pour sauce mixture over all cook on low 6 to 8 hours enjoy !

name: Crockpot pork chops with stuffing
ingredients: boneless pork chops|stove top stuffing mix|condensed cream of mushroom soup|water
steps: place pork chops in a greased 4-quart crockpot mix together the stuffing mix , water and soup spread this mixture over the chops cover and cook on hi heat for about 3 hours

name: Crockpot pork pot roast
ingredients: pork roast|salt and pepper|oil|onion soup mix|water|garlic|worcestershire sauce|steak spice
steps: season roast well with salt and pepper brown all over in hot oil , then place in crockpot sprinkle with dry onion soup mix deglaze pan with water or broth add remaining ingredients pour over roast in crockpot cover , cook on low 8-10 hours if desired , thicken broth into gravy in my crockpot , this is done after 9 hours pork should reach an internal temp of 71-76 celcius for medium / well , or higher for well done

name: Crockpot pork shanks sauerkraut
ingredients: pork shanks|sauerkraut|onion|applesauce|caraway seeds
steps: place onion in crockpot place pork on top combine sauerkraut , apple sauce and caraway seed and put on top of pork cover cook on low heat for 8 hours

name: Crockpot pot roast using fond
ingredients: top round roast|beef broth|garlic cloves|steak seasoning|olive oil
steps: put the oil in a pan and turn the heat to medium high sprinkle the beef with your choice of steak seasoning and garlic sear each side put the beef in the crockpot and pour beef broth just 2 / 3 of the way over the beef cook on medium for up to eight hours , if you like your beef to fall apart cook for six hours if you like it to stay together we often freeze the beef after searing weve had luck adding the beef to the crock pot still frozen and pouring the beef broth inches when we start frozen , we cook it on high for about six hours and turn it to low when we get back from work serve with broth

name: Crockpot potato soup
ingredients: frozen shredded hash browns|chicken broth|cream of chicken soup|onion|ground pepper|cream cheese
steps: in a crockpot , combine everything except the cream cheese cook for 6 -8 hours on low heat about 1 hour before serving , add cream cheese and keep heated until thoroughly melted serve with cheese , sour cream , bacon bits , green onions or whatever else you think might be good !

name: Crockpot potato soup for weight watchers
ingredients: frozen hash browns|nonfat chicken broth|98% fat-free cream of chicken soup|onion|pepper|low-fat cream cheese|nonfat milk
steps: add first 5 ingredients to crock pot and cook on high for one hour stir and then turn to low , cook for another hour add cream cheese and cook another 30 minutes or until cheese can be stirred into mixture add milk and cook 10-15 minutes longer optional: garnish with chopped green onion and bacon bits variation: use frozen country potatoes or potatoes o'brien in place of plain hash browns

name: Crockpot pulled bbq chicken
ingredients: chicken breasts|barbecue sauce|onion|italian salad dressing|brown sugar|worcestershire sauce
steps: add all ingredients to a crockpot cook on high for 3-4 hours about half way through the cooking time , shred the chicken using two forks chicken will easily fall apart ! serve with potato rolls , hamburger rolls , or nacho chips and cheese

name: Crockpot quinoa chicken and kale soup
ingredients: chicken breasts|onions|celery|garlic cloves|quinoa|low sodium chicken broth|cannellini beans|kale|dried thyme|poultry seasoning|smoked paprika|fresh parsley|salt and pepper|lemon juice
steps: place chicken in a 6 or 7 quart crockpot add onion , celery , and garlic add drained quinoa and pour in chicken broth cover and cook on high 3-4 hours , or low 7-8 hours remove chicken and shred return to soup add in beans , kale , seasonings , and lemon juice taste and adjust seasonings to preference cover and cook on high for 30 minutes more , until kale is tender

name: Crockpot ribs and taters
ingredients: pork spareribs|salt & pepper|onion|bay leaf|pork seasoning|beer|potatoes
steps: rinse and dry the ribs cut down serving size season with salt and pepper to taste place ribs in crockpot on high heat peel and quarter potatoes , rough chop onions and add to the ribs in the crock add bay leaf and pork seasoning pour beer into crock , cover and cook on high 6-8 hours or until done stir halfway through

name: Crockpot roasted chicken poulet roti a recipe inspired by che
ingredients: onions|roasting chickens|thyme|rosemary|garlic powder|kosher salt|pepper
steps: put the onions in the bottom of your crockpot mix together the herbs and spices , rubbing them together with your fingers to blend gently lift the skin from either side of the breast and using your fingers , push a bit of the herb mix under each side turn the chicken over and make a small slit behind each thigh and push some of the herb mix under the thigh skin sprinkle the rest of the herb mixture over the top of the chicken and if you have any left sprinkle it inside the chicken put your chicken into the crockpot , on top of the onions , breast side up no liquid is needed , the chicken will make it's own juices ! cook in the crockpot on the low setting for 4-6 hours my crockpot cooked the chicken in about 5 hours i'd recommend a pop-up timer in the chicken because some crock pots cook faster / slower than others

name: Crockpot rosemary chicken
ingredients: whole chicken|potatoes|carrots|cream of chicken soup|chicken broth|milk|butter|rosemary|salt and pepper
steps: combine all ingredients in the pot and cook on low for about 8 hours or about 4 hours on high until the internal temperature reaches 180 degrees and the meat is falling off the bones of the chicken

name: Crockpot rouladen
ingredients: round steaks|stone ground mustard|bacon|onions|dill pickle spears|flour|butter|baby carrots|beef stock|sour cream|salt|ground black pepper
steps: cut steak into 6 equal portions place each piece between two layers of plastic wrap and pound with a mallet or rolling pin until about 1 / 4" thick spread each piece with mustard and set aside place carrots in bottom of 5-6 qt slow cooker cook bacon in skillet until crisp drain on paper towels meanwhile , in bacon grease left in skillet , saute onions until tender , about 5 minutes remove onion to a bowl with slotted spoon add chopped pickles crumble bacon and add to onion mixture divide equally amongst pieces of beef roll each piece around the filling and secure with kitchen twine dredge in flour , tapping off any excess add butter to any remaining bacon grease when foaming subsides , add beef rolls and brown 1-2 minutes on each side as each is finished , transfer to the slow cooker on top of the carrots pour beef stock over all cover and cook on low 6-7 hours until carrots are tender and beef is very tender remove beef with tongs carefully remove strings remove carrots with a slotted spoon combine sour cream and flour stir well add to liquid remaining in slow cooker and stir well turn heat to high return beef and carrots to pot and cover cook 10-20 minutes until thick season with salt and pepper to taste serve hot

name: Crockpot salsa chicken and black bean soup
ingredients: chicken|black beans|chicken broth|sliced mushrooms|frozen corn|salsa|cumin|sour cream|shredded cheddar cheese
steps: in a 4 quart or larger crockpot , combine all ingredients except sour cream cook on low for 6-8 hours or high for 4-5 hours stir in 1 / 2 cup sour cream to thicken , you could using and immersible blender to blend some of the soup garnish and serve

name: Crockpot santa fe chicken
ingredients: chicken breasts|diced tomatoes with mild green chilies|black beans|frozen corn|fresh cilantro|fat free chicken broth|scallions|garlic powder|onion powder|cayenne pepper|salt|black pepper
steps: combine chicken broth , beans , corn , tomatoes , cilantro , scallions , garlic powder , onion powder , cayenne pepper and salt in the crock pot season chicken breast with salt and pepper and lay on top cook on low for 8 to 10 hours or on high for 6 hours half hour before serving , remove chicken and shred return chicken to slow cooker and stir adjust salt and seasoning and serve warm

name: Crockpot saucy ravioli with meatballsl
ingredients: onions|frozen beef ravioli|meatballs|mozzarella cheese|parmesan cheese
steps: spray a 5-1 / 2 to 6-quart crockpot with nonstick cooking spray add 1 cup of the spaghetti sauce , 1 package of the ravioli , and add all the meatballs sprinkle with 1 cup of the mozzarella cheese add remaining sauce from the opened jar add remaining package ravioli and remaining 1 cup mozzarella pour second jar of spaghetti sauce over mixture cover and cook on lo heat for 4-1 / 2 to 5 hours or cook on hi heat for 2-1 / 2 to 3 hours turn off cooker sprinkle on parmesan cheese let stand , covered , 15 minutes before serving

name: Crockpot sausage and sweet potatoes
ingredients: bulk pork sausage|sweet potatoes|apples|brown sugar|flour|cinnamon|salt|water
steps: layer sausage , sweet potatoes and apples in slow cooker combine remaining ingredients and pour on top cover and cook on low for 8-10 hours , or on high for 4 hours

name: Crockpot sausage peppers and cannellini bean stew with parmesa
ingredients: onions|red bell pepper|green bell pepper|olive oil|hot italian sausage|cannellini beans|tomatoes|dried basil|dried greek oregano|ground fennel|ground pepper|bay leaves|homemade chicken stock|parmesan cheese
steps: use a 3 1 / 2 quart slow cooker for this recipe chop onions , red bell pepper , and green bell pepper into pieces about 1 / 2 inch square heat olive oil in a large frying pan , then saute onions and peppers until they begin to soften , then add to slow cooker squeeze italian sausage out of casings and add to frying pan , adding a bit more olive oil if needed brown sausage well , breaking apart with turner as it cooks , then add to slow cooker pour beans into a colander placed in the sink and rinse with cold water until no more foam appears , then add to slow cooker add tomatoes with juice , dried basil , dried oregano , ground fennel , black pepper and bay leaves to slow cooker pour chicken stock over other ingredients and stir to combine cook on high about 4 hours or on low for all day serve hot , with freshly grated parmesan cheese for sprinkling on the stew south beach suggestions: make with turkey italian sausage , this stew is perfect for any phase of the south beach diet , which allows low-glycemic dried beans in small amounts , even for phase one since this recipe has a generous amount of vegetables and sausage in proportion to the beans , it would be great for phase one

name: Crockpot seafood cheese dip
ingredients: processed cheese food|reduced-fat cream cheese|sour cream|small shrimp|crabmeat|lobster|seafood seasoning|worcestershire sauce|french bread
steps: combine processed cheese food , cream cheese , sour cream , shrimp , crab , and lobster in a crockpot cover and cook on low heat until cheese is melted , about 1 hour , stirring occasionally to break up lumps once the cheese is melted , stir in seafood seasoning and worcestershire sauce serve with french bread or sturdy cracker

name: Crockpot sliced cranberry pork roast
ingredients: pork loin roast|jellied cranberry sauce|dry mustard|ground cloves|sugar|cranberry juice|cornstarch|cold water|salt
steps: place pork roast in a slow cooker mash cranberry sauce stir in sugar , cranberry juice , mustard and cloves in a bowl pour over meat cover and cook on low for 6-8 hours or until meat is tender remove roast and keep warm skim fat from juices , measure 2 cups , adding water if necessary , and pour into a saucepan bring to a boil over medium-high heat combine the cornstarch and cold water to make a paste stir into gravy cook and stir until thickened season with salt serve with sliced pork

name: Crockpot split pea lentil and barley soup aka weight watchers
ingredients: dried split peas|barley|brown lentils|turkey pepperoni|onion|carrot|garlic clove|bay leaves|salt|pepper|fat-free chicken broth
steps: in a slow cooker , layer every ingredient except the broth in order listed boil broth , then add to slow cooker cover and cook on high for 4-5 hours or until vegetables are tender 3discard bay leaves before serving

name: Crockpot sweet sour chicken
ingredients: chicken breasts|pineapple tidbits|onion|red bell pepper|green bell pepper|soy sauce|thai sweet chili sauce|chicken broth|cornstarch|cold water
steps: place the frozen chicken in the crockpot and dump the pineapple on top scatter the chopped vegetables over the chicken and pineapple whisk together the soy sauce , thai sweet chili sauce , and the chicken broth , then pour over all cover and cook for 6 hours on low remove chicken to cutting board and cut into slices or cubes return chicken to pot whisk together the cold water and the cornstarch until smooth , then stir into the pot cover and continue to cook on low for at least 1 hour serve over hot cooked rice

name: Crockpot sweet and saucy chicken and potatoes
ingredients: skinless chicken pieces|potatoes|carrots|celery|ketchup|honey dijon mustard|sweet and sour sauce|season salt
steps: 1 layer skinned chicken in crockpot 2 mix ketchup , honey dijon mustard , and sweet and sour sauce - pour over chicken 3 peel and cut potatoes and carrots chop celery add vegetables to crockpot on top of chicken season with five season salt or your favourite blend 4 cook on high for 4 hours or low for 6-7 hours

name: Crockpot sweet n sour chicken
ingredients: onion|sugar|ketchup|orange juice|soy sauce|boneless chicken|canned pineapple|green bell pepper|red bell pepper|rice
steps: in a small bowl combine sugar , ketchup , orange juice , soy sauce place chicken , onions , pineapple , and peppers in a crock pot pour sauce over them cook on low for 6 hours serve over cooked rice

name: Crockpot tacos
ingredients: chuck roast|green bell pepper|red bell pepper|onion|mexican-style diced tomatoes|mild salsa|white corn tortilla
steps: place ingredients into crockpot in the order above cook on high for 8 hours we like to make the tacos shells ourselves by frying the corn tortillas in canola oil and shaping them top with shredded mexican blend cheese and sour cream you don't need to add any other ingredients trust me !

name: Crockpot tapioca pudding
ingredients: milk|sugar|pearl tapioca|eggs|vanilla|cinnamon
steps: combine the milk , sugar , and tapioca pearls in crockpot stir thoroughly , cover and cook on high for approximately 3 5 hours , or until the tapioca is soft but the mixture is still runny mix the eggs with the vanilla in a separate bowl in order to avoid having scrambled eggs in your pudding by adding the eggs directly into the hot pudding mixture , temper the eggs by gradually whisking a total of 2 cups of the hot milk and tapioca mixture into the bowl containing the eggs this brings the eggs up to temperate slowly once the eggs have been tempered in this fashion , pour them into the slow cooker and whisk the whole mixture thoroughly cover and cook on high for another 45 minutes , or until the tapioca is pudding-like in consistency turn off slow cooker and let it sit for 1 hour to cool spoon into dishes and chill thoroughly in the refrigerator before serving i love serving it while its still warm during the wintertime sprinkle a little cinnamon and / or nutmeg on top , if desired enjoy !

name: Crockpot thai chicken
ingredients: chicken|red bell pepper|onion|chicken broth|soy sauce|cumin|garlic cloves|red chili pepper flakes|salt|pepper|cornstarch|creamy peanut butter|lime juice|cilantro|green onions|roasted peanuts
steps: place chicken , bell pepper and onion in crockpot mix soy sauce , broth and spices together pour mixture over chicken cook on high for 3 hours whisk peanut butter , starch , 1 tablespoon of soy sauce and lime juice together add 1 cup of juices from crock pot and mix until smooth stir mixture into crock pot cook 30 minutes more garnish with cilantro , green onion and peanuts serve with rice

name: Crockpot tomato basil parmesan soup
ingredients: diced tomatoes|celery|carrot|chicken broth|chicken bouillon cubes|onion|bay leaf|dried oregano|dried basil|butter|flour|parmesan cheese|half-and-half|salt|black pepper
steps: in a large crockpot , combine tomatoes , celery , carrots , chicken broth , onions , bay leaf , oregano , and basil cover and cook on low for 5-7 hours , until flavors are blended and vegetables are soft about an hour before serving prepare a roux: melt butter and whisk in flour until smooth slowly stir in 1 cup hot soup from the slow cooker add another 3 cups soup and stir until smooth add all back into the slow cooker stir and add parmesan cheese , warmed half-and-half , salt , and pepper cover and cook on low for another hour until ready to serve serve with fresh hot bread

name: Crockpot venison roast
ingredients: boneless beef roast|condensed tomato soup|worcestershire sauce|celery|yellow onion|carrots|potatoes|bay leaf
steps: place roast on top of vegetables in crockpot pour soup and worcestershire on roast and add bay leaf cook on low 6 hours add an additonal hour if cooking from frozen remove roast and let it rest , covered for 10 minutes slice beef and serve over drained vegetables optional: place cooking liquid into saucepan on stove and heat to boiling add 2 tbsp cornstarch to 1 / 2 c water and slowly stir mixture into boiling liquid to make a gravy

name: Crockpot white bean and sweet potato stew
ingredients: carrot|onion|celery ribs|garlic cloves|sweet potatoes|bay leaves|olive oil|vegetable broth|water|great northern bean|kosher salt|garam masala
