ingredients: tomatoes|olive oil|vinegar|dried oregano|feta cheese|cucumbers|salt & pepper
steps: in a small bowl combine chopped tomatoes , oil , vinegar , oregano , salt , and pepper toss gently until well mixed chill until serving time just before serving , add feta cheese to tomatoes and mix well peel cucumbers and cut them in half lengthwise using a melon ball scoop or a spoon , scoop out and discard seeds pile tomato mixture into cucumbers serve right away preparation time does not include chilling time

name: Cucumber boats with salad
ingredients: cucumbers|salt|vinegar|cheese|paprika|chow mein noodles|tuna salad
steps: cut the cuckes in half , scoop out the middle sprinkle cukes with salt and vinegar , the pulp can be mixed into your filling , if desired make up 4 cups of salad pile into boats garnish with cheese , paprika and chow mien noodles stick in a sail this is easy to increase

name: Cucumber bow tie salad
ingredients: bow tie pasta|rice vinegar|peanut oil|sugar|hot chili oil|salt|cucumber|red bell pepper|red onions
steps: bring 3 quarts water to a boil over medium-high heat pour in pasta and return to a boil cook until al dente , 8-10 minutes , stirring occasionally meanwhile , in a medium bowl , combine vinegar , oil , sugar , chili oil , and salt mix well add the cucumber , bell pepper , and onion , and toss to coat drain the pasta and rinse with cold water drain again , add to the cucumber mixture , and toss well serve immediately or cover and chill

name: Cucumber bruschetta no bread
ingredients: avocado|fresh lime juice|fresh cilantro|red onion|salt|pepper|english cucumber
steps: prepare your avocado by cutting in half , removing the pit , peeling and cubing it mix together the avocado , lime juice , cilantro , and onion salt and pepper to taste spoon small avocado mix onto cucumber slices and serve

name: Cucumber canapes
ingredients: cucumber|french baguette|cream cheese|ranch dip mix|garlic powder|dill
steps: mix cream cheese with ranch dip mix and 1 / 2 teaspoon garlic powder spread that onto thin-sliced french baguettes put a slice of cucumber on top and a sprinkle of dill

name: Cucumber cape codder
ingredients: sugar|water|english cucumbers|vodka|cranberry juice|fresh lime juice|ice
steps: to make the simple syrup , bring sugar and water to a boil in a small pot reduce heat and simmer , stirring until sugar dissolves remove from heat , stir in grated cucumber and let cool pour through a fine sieve into a bowl or large glass measuring cup and discard solids the cucumber syrup can be refrigerated up to 3 days combine cucumber syrup , vodka , cranberry juice and lime juice in a 2-quart pitcher cocktail can be refrigerated up to 8 hours serve over ice and garnish with cucumber wedges

name: Cucumber carrot salad
ingredients: rice wine vinegar|sesame oil|sesame seeds|salt|fresh ground pepper|carrot|english cucumber|red onion
steps: whisk together vinegar , sesame oil , sesame seeds , salt and pepper in a small bowl combine carrots , cucumber and onion in a medium bowl add the vinegar dressing and mix thoroughly this travels well and tastes great at room temperature

name: Cucumber cheese melt
ingredients: cream cheese|blue cheese|multigrain bread|apricot fruit spread|cucumber|swiss cheese|cooking spray
steps: mix cream cheese and blue cheese spread on 4 slices of bread spread 1 tablespoon of apricot fruit spread over cheese top each with 4 cucumber slices , a slice of swiss cheese and remaining bread slices spray a large skillet with cooking spray cook sandwiches over medium heat until golden on bottoms , about 5 minutes spray tops of sandwiches with cooking spray and brown on the other side

name: Cucumber chicken pitas
ingredients: plain yogurt|cucumber|dried dill weed|dried mint|pita bread rounds|lettuce leaves|chicken breasts|tomatoes|feta cheese
steps: for dressing , in a small mixing bowl stir together yogurt , cucumber , dillweed , and mint set aside for each sandwich , place a pita bread round on a plate top with lettuce , chicken , tomato , and feta cheese spoon dressing on top roll up the pita bread secure with wooden toothpicks serve immediately

name: Cucumber chickpea salad
ingredients: chickpeas|chopped tomato|onion|celery|cucumbers|garlic|dill weed|salt & pepper|lemon juice|olive oil|coriander|cumin
steps: mix oil & lemon juice well and set aside combine all other ingredients and toss with the oil and lemon juice mixture chill before serving and garnish with fresh parsley , if desired

name: Cucumber chili salsa
ingredients: cucumber|onion|cilantro|jalapeno pepper|white vinegar|sugar
steps: mix everything together in a bowl cover and chill at least 2 hours before serving mix again before serving

name: Cucumber chip appetizers
ingredients: avocados|yellow onion|tomatoes|cilantro|cucumber|lime|garlic salt|ground black pepper|chili powder
steps: peel and dice all the onion dice the tomato chop the cilantro peel and pit each avocado in a medium sized mixing bowl combine the avocados , onion , tomato , and cilantro smashing it all together with a fork with the lime half squeeze the lime juice into the mixture add the salt , pepper and chili powder and continue mashing till a creamy / lumpy texture is achieved set a side with the other lime half rub the cut side on a serving platter so the plate has a thin layer of lime juice on top of it on a cutting board thickly slice a cucumber so each slice is about a quarter of an inch lay each slice flat on the platter once all the slices are in place spoon a dollop of the avocado mixture onto each slice of cucumber garnish with cilantro leaves if you like enjoy !

name: Cucumber cilantro pasta salad
ingredients: cucumber|roma tomato|red onion|lime juice|cilantro|sugar|salt|pepper|dry pasta shell macaroni
steps: cook pasta , drain combine lime juice , cilantro , sugar , salt and pepper in small bowl in a large bowl , combine pasta and vegetables toss gently with lime dressing

name: Cucumber cleanser drink
ingredients: cucumber|beetroot|apple|carrots
steps: push everything through the tube of the juicer

name: Cucumber cocktail
ingredients: kiwi|cucumbers|water|lemon juice|salt|ice
steps: mix in blender until smooth

name: Cucumber cocktail sandwiches
ingredients: cream cheese|italian salad dressing mix|cucumbers|rye cocktail bread|dill weed
steps: mix together cream cheese and dressing mix with a small amount of milk until of spreadable consistancy spread on rye bread slices place 1-2 slices of cucumber on top sprinkle with dill weed

name: Cucumber coconut milk raw vegan
ingredients: cucumbers|coconut water
steps: send the cucumbers through your juicer pop open the coconut and add the water to the cucumber juice save the coconut meat for something else drink this nectar and feel amazing ! this stuff is seriously like a sports drink / energy drink but even better !

name: Cucumber crab pasta salad
ingredients: shell noodles|english cucumber|imitation crabmeat|dried dill|salt|pepper|cucumber salad dressing
steps: please the amounts listed here are a pretty good veggie / crab to noodle ratio do not use noodles larger than the medium shells you can use smaller shell noodles , though boil noodles rinse well and let drain for quite a while stir them often when draining them to make sure all the water is out of the shells the less water on them , the better the salad dressing sticks to them slice cucumber to your preference i typically slice it in half lengthwise , then do about 1 / 8 thin slices chop the imitation crab into chunks and add to the noodles sprinkle with salt and dill over entire mixture and stir dill should have a nice amount of "speckling" throughout the dish after stirring if serving right away , pour approx 1 / 2 the bottle of dressing onto the cucumber crab mixture and stir , then slowly add more to lightly cover everything you don't want the noodles sopping wet with dressing , but you want a nice thin coat on everything in the bowl chill until serving if you are taking this to a pot luck or making it ahead , assemble everything but the dressing and keep refridgerated pour the dressing on just before serving keep dressing handy for left-overs because it tends to get sucked into the noodles if it sits in the fridge for any length of time optional: for presentation you can decorate with cherry tomatoes on top and sprinkle with dill for garnish

name: Cucumber crab salad
ingredients: cucumbers|frozen crab|peanut oil|sesame seeds|light soy sauce|rice wine vinegar
steps: slice and dry the cucumbers well , also drain the crab heat a small skillet and brush with oil add the sesame seeds and toast them , stirring constantly until lightly browned , then grind with a morter and pestle lightly toss all ingredients together in a bowl and serve

name: Cucumber cream cheese finger sandwiches
ingredients: onion|mayonnaise|cucumbers|parsley sprig|cream cheese|whole wheat bread|cucumber
steps: combine the cucumbers and cream cheese , then blend in the onion add in a tablespoon or two of mayonnaise and blend until the mixture is soft and spreadable add a little more mayonnaise to soften further cut the crusts off the bread , then either cut each piece into fourths or cut into diamonds spread mixture over half the bread pieces , then top with another piece of bread garnish with parsley or cucumber you can also leave the sandwiches open-faced try this method with tuna or chicken salad , too

name: Cucumber cream cheese sandwich spread
ingredients: cucumber|green onions|cream cheese|sugar|salt
steps: peel the cucumber and cut in chunks if it's got a lot of big seeds , scoop some out and discard put it in a food processor and chop fine if it's really moist , or you didn't seed it , then you may want to squeeze off some of the excess juice put the onion in the processor and chop add the rest of the ingredients process , scrape down the sides , and process again until smooth i like it best on soft , white bread but it's also great on crackers

name: Cucumber cups
ingredients: english cucumbers|hummus|paprika|parsley
steps: peel the cucumbers and slice length wise into 1 inch pieces using a melon baller , carve out the seeds to create a vessel , making sure to leave the bottom intact using a piping bag or a small spoon , fill each one with hummus sprinkle with paprika and finely chopped parsley

name: Cucumber cups filled with crab appetizer
ingredients: english cucumber|fresh herb|crab|lime zest|fresh lime juice|green onion|celery|olive oil|kosher salt|cracked black pepper
steps: mix all the ingredients together , taste for seasoning set aside this can be covered and refrigerated for 1 day cut the unpeeled cucumber into 1-1 / 2" thick slices with the cucumber slice still laying on it's side , make a diagonal cut , now you have two diagonal cut pieces of cucumber use a melon baller to make a small round hole in the center of the cucumber where the seeds are to make a cup do not cut completely through to the other side lightly salt each cucumber cup place on a paper towel to drain they can be refrigerated at this point and finished later when ready to serve remove the cucumber cups from the refrigerator and place a small amount of the crab mixture in the center of each round hole in the cucumber and serve garnish with fresh herbs

name: Cucumber cups with horseradish
ingredients: reduced-fat cream cheese|light mayonnaise|prepared horseradish|cucumbers|fresh parsley
steps: combine the cream cheese , mayonnaise , and horseradish chill at least 30 minutes score the cucumber lengthwise with the tines of a fork cut the cucumber crosswise into 1 / 2-inch slices , making 18 using a melon baller or 1 / 2 teaspoon measuring spoon , scoop out a small hollow on the straight side do not cut all the way through transfer the cream cheese mixture to a pastry bag fitted with a fluted pipe the cheese mixture into the cucumber cups garnish the tops of the cups with parsley or dill sprigs

name: Cucumber delights
ingredients: reduced-fat cream cheese|hidden valley ranch dressing mix|cucumbers|french baguettes
steps: in a medium bowl , combine softened cream cheese and ranch dressing mix packet stir until well-blended slice cucumbers into relatively thin slices slice baguette into medium slices for a "daintier" sandwich , trim off crusts spread cream cheese mixture onto one slice of bread place 4-5 cucumber slices on top of cream cheese spread cream cheese mixture onto a second piece of bread and place the bread on top of the cucumbers , cream cheese side down repeat ! i knew the morning of the shower would be crazy , so i sliced the cucumbers and mixed up the cream cheese spread the night before it tasted great and made things so much easier on the morning of the shower !

name: Cucumber dill deviled eggs
ingredients: hard-boiled eggs|cucumber|onions|dried dill|dill pickle|mayonnaise
steps: hard boil eggs cut length wise remove cooked yokes to separate bowl de-seed , grate , and squeeze any remaining liquid from cucumbers & add to yokes add onion , dill , pickle , & mayo to yokes mix / mash together until you have a creamy mixture take spoonfuls of the mixture and add to the centers of the egg whites where the yokes used to be

name: Cucumber dill dip
ingredients: cream cheese|mayonnaise|cucumbers|green onions|lemon juice|fresh dill|hot pepper sauce
steps: beat cream cheese until smooth stir in remaining ingredients until well mixed cover chill

name: Cucumber dill dip ww
ingredients: low-fat cream cheese|low-fat ranch dressing|skim milk|dried dill weed|cucumber|onions
steps: place cream cheese in a mixing bowl and whip with an electric mixer until fluffy add dressing , milk and dill weed mix well until well blended stir in cucumber and onion cover and refrigerate at least one hour to allow flavor to blend

name: Cucumber dill dip for fresh veggies
ingredients: cream cheese|miracle whip|cucumbers|green onions|lemon juice|fresh dill|tabasco sauce
steps: beat cream cheese until smooth stir in remaining ingredients until well blended cover and chill until serving time

name: Cucumber dill dip or salad dressing
ingredients: cucumber|white pepper|fresh dill|mayonnaise|sour cream
steps: peel , seed and finely dice the cucumber using a colander , squeeze out any excess water from the cucumber chunks place in a bowl and blend well with the dill blend in the remaining ingredients and mix thoroughly cover and chill

name: Cucumber dill dressing
ingredients: english cucumber|balkan style yogurt|milk|mayonnaise|cider vinegar|green onion|garlic clove|fresh dill|pepper
steps: peel , seed and shred cucumber gently squeeze out liquid set aside in a small bowl , whisk together yogurt , milk , mayonnaise and vinegar stir in cucumber , green onion , garlic , dill and pepper

name: Cucumber dill pasta salad
ingredients: shell pasta|green onion|cucumbers|low-fat mayonnaise|low-fat sour cream|lemon juice|fresh dill|salt|coarse black pepper
steps: cook shells per package directions drain and rinse with cold water drain again in large bowl combine pasta with green onions and cucumbers in another bowl , blend together dressing ingredients , adding more or less of ingredients to get the right taste for you toss dressing with pasta and refrigerate serve cold plan to eat this within 2 hours of making

name: Cucumber dill salad with radish and feta
ingredients: cucumbers|radishes|lemon juice|feta cheese|white wine vinegar|fresh dill|sugar|garlic clove|olive oil|salt and pepper
steps: mix cucumber , radishes and cheese together whisk together lemon juice , vinegar , dill , sugar , and garlic in a bowl until sugar has dissolved whisk in the oil in a slow steady stream until emulsified add viniagrette to cucumbers and toss well add salt and pepper to taste

name: Cucumber dill shrimp spread
ingredients: cream cheese|mayonnaise|dill relish|fresh dill weed|cucumber|small shrimp|cracker
steps: beat first 4 ingredients together until smooth spread evenly on 9" pie plate or a nice platter cover with cucumber& shrimp garnish with dill weed

name: Cucumber dip
ingredients: cucumbers|vinegar|salt|garlic salt|cream cheese|mayonnaise
steps: wash and grate unpeeled cucumbers use a grater with 1 / 2-inch holes add vinegar and salt cover and allow to sit overnight in refrigerator next day , press out liquid blend garlic salt , cheese , and mayonnaise combine with cucumbers serve with fresh veggies

name: Cucumber dip with fresh dill
ingredients: cucumber|low-fat plain yogurt|fresh dill
steps: puree the cucumber in a blender until chunky but not liquefied stir in the yogurt and dill cover and chill in refrigerator until ready to serve serve with raw vegetables , pita bread or spicy foods

name: Cucumber dressing
ingredients: cucumber|cream|dried dill|salt|lemon pepper|pepper
steps: toss the cucmbers into a food processor puree add the rest of the ingredients and give it a whirl until combined

name: Cucumber drink a k a cuke juice
ingredients: cucumber|water|honey|ice cubes
steps: blend all ingredients until no unswallowable pieces of cucumber remain strain if desired

name: Cucumber feta amazingness
ingredients: feta cheese|extra virgin olive oil|lemon juice|baguette|cucumber|salt and pepper
steps: if using a baguette , toast in the oven for 5-8 minutes or until crusty combine feta , evoo and lemon juice in a bowl - mash it really well slice the bread into 1 inch thick rounds spread a good amount of the feta mixture onto the bread slices / crackers arrange 2 half slices of cucumber on top of each feta pile drizzle with a little evoo and sprinkle with salt and pepper skip the salt if you are using crackers enjoy !

name: Cucumber gimlet gin
ingredients: tanqueray london dry gin|tonic water|simple syrup|lime juice|english cucumbers|cucumber
steps: place cucumber wheels at the bottom of a collins glass add tanqueray london dry gin , simple syrup and lime juice add ice and top with tonic garnish with a cucumber peel

name: Cucumber gin and tonic
ingredients: gin|tonic water|ice cubes|cucumbers
steps: add the ice to a cocktail glass add cucumber slices add gin fill glass with tonic water

name: Cucumber herb vinaigrette
ingredients: cucumber|extra virgin olive oil|red wine vinegar|fresh chives|fresh parsley|nonfat yogurt|dijon mustard|prepared horseradish|sugar|salt
steps: puree all ingredients together in a blender until smooth

name: Cucumber honeydew smoothies
ingredients: honeydew melon|cucumber|lime juice|salt|cucumbers
steps: in blender combine honeydew melon , cucumber , lime juice , and salt cover and blend until smooth if desired , garnish each serving with cucumber slices and / or lime wedges and honeydew melon chunks threaded onto skewer

name: Cucumber hors d oeuvres
ingredients: good seasons salad dressing mix|cream cheese|cucumber|dill|pumpernickel cocktail bread
steps: mix salad dressing and cream cheese spread onto bread peel and slice cucumber if you want , leave strips of green on the cucumber place 1 slice of cucumber onto bread sprinkle with dill

name: Cucumber iceberg salad
ingredients: red wine vinegar|salad oil|sugar|black pepper|dried dill|salt|cucumber|iceberg lettuce
steps: whisk together the vinegar , oil , pepper , dillweed , sugar , and a sprinkle of salt add cucumber and lettuce toss lightly and serve immediately

name: Cucumber in sour cream salad
ingredients: cucumber|salt|sour cream|white vinegar|tabasco sauce|chives|dill seeds|pepper
steps: sprinkle the cucumber with salt let stand 30 minutes drain thoroughly dry on paper towel combine sour cream , vinegar , tabasco , chives , dill seed and pepper pour over cucumber chill well before using garnish with fresh dill

name: Cucumber in vinegar pickled cucumbers
ingredients: cucumbers|sugar|white vinegar|canning salt|white onions|green peppers|red peppers|mustard seeds|dill
steps: place in large container , stir vinegar , sugar , salt , herbs until sugar completely dissolved , add vegetables , let stand 24 hours eat or keep in refrigerator brine should cover all vegetables keeps through the winter

name: Cucumber ketchup
ingredients: cucumber|red pepper|sugar|cinnamon|onion|vinegar|salt|clove|black pepper
steps: pare enough ripe cucumbers to make 1 quart after seeds and soft centers have been removed add onion , pepper , and enough water to prevent sticking cook slowly , stirring frequently , until tender , about 20-30 minutes add remaining ingredients cook slowly , stirring frequently , until thick serve with burgers , as a relish with meats , etc the instructions didn't say anything about canning , but there is enough vinegar to can place into sterilzed jars , seal , and place in water bath about 10 minutes

name: Cucumber kimchee
ingredients: cucumbers|sea salt|chili powder|salt|daikon radish|green onion|chives|granulated sugar|garlic|ginger|sesame seeds
steps: soak cucumbers in coarse salt for about 1 / 2 hour rinse mix other ingredients together add cucumbers soak at room temperature for about an hour , then refrigerate for at least 2 hours

name: Cucumber lemonade
ingredients: cucumber|lemonade|ice
steps: make a pitcher of your favorite lemonade grate the cucumber over the pitcher , and mix in the cucumber juice and pulp serve over ice

name: Cucumber lime jello salad
ingredients: lime jell-o gelatin|boiling water|cold water|cucumbers|cream cheese
steps: peel the cucumbers and cut into small cubes cut the cream cheese into small cubes put the cucmber and cream cheese cubes in a serving dish dissolve the jello mix in the boiling water stir in the cold water pour the jello over the cucumber and cream cheese refrigerate until jello is set

name: Cucumber lime pickles
ingredients: cucumbers|pickling lime|water|vinegar|sugar|salt|green food coloring
steps: soak the cucumbers lime and water in enamel or crockery for 24 hours , stirring occasionally remove from lime water and rinse in 3 cool waters soak 3 additional hours in ice and water remove carefully to drain mix syrup ingredients and stir until dissolved pour over the cucumbers let set 5 or 6 hours or overnight add pickling spices to taste boil mixture for 35 minutes fill sterilized jars with cucumber slices and pour syrup over cucumbers leaving 0 125 inch head space seal jars if syrup does not cover cucumbers while boiling , mix partial recipe of syrup and add it

name: Cucumber lime smoothie
ingredients: cucumbers|lime|water|ice|honey
steps: peel , seed and chop 2 medium cucumbers blend them with all the other ingredients until smooth

name: Cucumber limeade
ingredients: english cucumber|water|sugar|lime, juice of|coarse salt|ice cube
steps: peel cucumber , cut in half lengthwise and remove the seeds this is easily done by scraping a spoon chop coarsely and combine in a blender with the remaining ingredients , blending until smooth serve over ice with cucumber spears as garnish

name: Cucumber logs filled with black and gold hummus
ingredients: cucumbers|chickpeas|extra virgin olive oil|water|lemon juice|salt|black olives
steps: cut off the ends of the cucumbers cut each cucumber crosswise into 6 rounds and turn the pieces so they're flat gently scoop out some of the flesh from the top of each cucumber round , making a cup in a food processor or blender , make the hummus by combining the chickpeas , oil , water , lemon juice and salt puree , adding more water if needed for creaminess stir in black olives spoon the mix into the hollowed out part of each cucumber round arrange on a serving tray enjoy ! you may make the hummus up to a week in advance

name: Cucumber martini
ingredients: gin|cucumbers|dry vermouth
steps: mix gin and thick cucumber slices in pitcher cover and chill overnight or up to 3 days strain gin , discarding thick cucumber slices pour half of gin into cocktail shaker add 1 tablespoon vermouth , then fill shaker with ice shake vigorously strain into three glasses repeat with remaining gin and vermouth garnish with thin cucumber slices

name: Cucumber melon cooler
ingredients: honeydew melon|cucumber|water|sugar|fresh lemon juice|ice
steps: remove rind from honeydew and cut into chunks peel cucumber , cut 8 nice slices from the middle to use as garnish and cut the rest of the cucumber into chunks using a blender and working in 2 batches , puree the melon , cucumber and water strain mixture and discard solids whisk sugar and lemon juice into the liquids remaining from melon / cucumber taste it and add up to 2 cups more water if it is too concentrated for your liking refrigerate until chilled and serve over ice with a floating slice of cucumber as a garnish

name: Cucumber melon salad with raspberry vinegar
ingredients: cucumber|cantaloupe|radish|raspberry vinegar|pepper|lettuce leaves
steps: partially peel the cucumber so it leaves stripes of dark green for color cut the cucumber into bite-size pieces and put in a medium bowl cut the cantaloupe into cubes or use a melon baller add to the cucumber thinly slice the radishes add to the melon and cucumber toss the salad with the vinegar sprinkle with pepper refrigerate , covered , until chilled , about 30-60 minutes serve on salad plate over lettuce leaves

name: Cucumber millet bean salad with feta
ingredients: millet|water|english cucumber|reduced-fat feta cheese|white beans|ground red chili pepper|dried dill|salt and pepper
steps: rinse millet and add to a small sauce pan with the 250 ml water bring to a boil , simmer for 5 minutes and then allow to soak up all the remaining water for 10 more minutes in a big bowl combine all the rest of the ingredients add the millet and season with salt and pepper to taste eat either warm or cold

name: Cucumber mint and basil soda
ingredients: sugar|water|cucumber|mint leaves|fresh basil leaves|soda water
steps: bring water and sugar to a boil to make simple syrup keep 1 5 cups in a small saucepan and remove pan from heat add cucumber slices , 24 mint leaves , and basil cover and let steep for 30 minutes strain cucumber-herb syrup into a jar , pressing on solids in strainer fill a 12-oz glass with ice cubes add 2 tablespoons syrup and top with soda water stir to combine garnish with cucumber slice and sprig of mint repeat to make 11 more sodas

name: Cucumber mint chutney
ingredients: white vinegar|sugar|cucumber|red bell pepper|of fresh mint|lime juice|onion
steps: combine vinegar & sugar in a sml bowl & stir till sugar is dissolved add remaining ingredients & mix well serve immediately or chill till ready for use , but allow time out of fridge for return to room temperature

name: Cucumber mint dip
ingredients: cucumber|onion|yogurt|lemon juice|salt|mint leaf
steps: peel cucumber and remove seeds cut into rough cubes and place in food processor with rest of ingredients until smooth put in bowl and add mint leaves chill until required

name: Cucumber mint gimlet
ingredients: gin|fresh lime juice|simple syrup|mint sprig
steps: mix in a cocktail shaker filled with ice , and shake ) garnish each with mint cucumber gin : steep 1 / 2 cup diced , peeled cucumber in 1 cup gin 8 hours to 4 days strain store indefinitely in the refrigerator easily mul mint simple syrup : heat 1 cup sugar and 1 cup water over medium-high heat , stirring until dissolved add 1 cup mint leaves remove from heat cover steep 30 minutes to 1 hour strain discard mint refrigerate up to 2 months

name: Cucumber mint raita
ingredients: cucumbers|red onion|plain nonfat yogurt|garlic|of fresh mint|cayenne
steps: slice cucumber halves into thin half-moons blot off moisture with paper towels put veggies in a bowl mix yogurt , garlic , and mint together and add to veggies toss to coat sprinkle with pepper , if desired chill before serving

name: Cucumber mint salad
ingredients: cucumbers|of fresh mint|fresh parsley|apple cider vinegar|honey|lemon juice
steps: mix all ingredients together , serve chilled

name: Cucumber mint salad with goat cheese
ingredients: english cucumbers|mint|garlic cloves|green onion|goat cheese|olive oil|lemon juice|black pepper|salt
steps: combine cucumbers , mint , garlic , green onion , and cheese in a bowl combine olive oil , lemon juice , pepper , and salt in a screw top jar shake until well combined pour over salad enjoy at room temperature or chilled instead , i just used a light olive oil mist , which may not have been necessary cucumbers are plenty wet as it is !

name: Cucumber mint tea sandwiches
ingredients: seedless cucumber|fresh mint leaves|unsalted butter|cream cheese|white bread|salt
steps: place cucumber slices between layers of paper towels to remove excess moisture in a small bowl , combine the mint , butter , and cream cheese spread on one side of each slice of bread lay the cucumber slices onto the buttered side of 8 slices of bread sprinkle with salt top with the remaining slices of bread , buttered side down gently cut the crusts from each sandwich with a sharp knife cut the sandwiches in half diagonally and then cut in half again makes 8 whole sandwiches , or 16 halves , or 32 fourths

name: Cucumber mojito camelback inn s recipe
ingredients: rum|cucumbers|lime wedges|of fresh mint|brown sugar|carbonated lemon-lime beverage
steps: muddle cucumber with lime wedges , mint , rum and sugar fill glass with ice splash with sierra mist serve in a 12oz hurricane glass garnish with mint and cucumber slice

name: Cucumber mold salad
ingredients: unflavored gelatin|cucumber liquid|cucumbers|garlic clove|cream cheese|salt|mayonnaise|onion|dried parsley
steps: after seeding and grating the cucumber , drain them well , reserving 1 / 4 cup of liquid dissolve gelatin in liquid and stir over low heat or microwave until all is dissolved beat cream cheese until fluffy , add remaining ingredients , beat well pour into a jello mold and chill 3-4 hours or overnight

name: Cucumber mostaccioli salad
ingredients: mostaccioli noodles|sugar|vinegar|oil|prepared mustard|pepper|garlic powder|salt|onion|cucumber|parsley
steps: blend together ingredients and let set overnight optional - add 1 chopped green pepper or sliced tomato on top will keep in refrigerator up to 2 weeks

name: Cucumber mustard and dill salad
ingredients: white wine vinegar|dijon mustard|salt|sugar|olive oil|seedless cucumber|fresh dill
steps: whisk together vinegar , mustard , salt , and sugar in a bowl , then add oil in a slow stream , whisking halve cucumber lengthwise and remove seeds with a small spoon , then cut halves crosswise into 1 / 8-inch-thick slices add cucumber and dill to vinaigrette , tossing to coat

name: Cucumber n watermelon salad a summer delight
ingredients: seasoned rice vinegar|sugar|sea salt|lime|olive oil|black pepper|garlic chives|jalapeno|fresh herb|cucumber|watermelon|scallion|pickled ginger
steps: mix salad dressing ingredients in a bowl toss in the salad ingredients chill 1 hour and then enjoy if you can wait the hour

name: Cucumber nachos
ingredients: salsa|cucumber|fat-free cheddar cheese|fat free sour cream
steps: put the salsa in a strainer to remove some of the liquid peel and slice the cucumber put the slices of cucumber into the bottom of a 9x13 pan , without overlapping discard the extra salsa liquid put about 1 teaspoons of salsa on each cucumber slice sprinkle the tops of the cucumbers with the cheese put about 1 teaspoons of sour cream on top of each slice serve cold

name: Cucumber onion mustard pickles
ingredients: cucumbers|onion|salt|brown sugar|cornstarch|turmeric|ground ginger|crushed red pepper flakes|cider vinegar|water|dijon mustard
steps: thinly slice the cucumbers peel and thinly slice the onions in a large bowl , combine the cucumbers and onions sprinkle with the salt and let stand for 3 hours drain in a large saucepan , combine the sugar , cornstarch , turmeric , ginger and the red pepper stir in the vinegar , the water and mustard cover and bring to a boil add the cucumbers and the onions pack into clean , hot pint jars leaving 1 / 2 inch of headroom rub a rubber spatula around the inside of the jars to release the air bubbles and wipe the rims of the jars with a clean rag place the lids and the screw bands on process in a boiling water bath canner for 15 minutes

name: Cucumber onion raisin snack
ingredients: cucumber|red onion|raisins|fat free ranch dressing
steps: slice cucumbers into bowl slice onions into the bowl add raisins toss with fat free ranch

name: Cucumber onion salad
ingredients: cucumber|celery|onion|lemon juice|olive oil|cider vinegar|oregano|garlic|sugar|feta cheese
steps: combine all ingredients , except feta , and let marinate in the fridge for as long as you can wait ! then top with cheese and enjoy for vegan omit the feta

name: Cucumber open faced sandwiches
ingredients: cucumbers|cream cheese|hidden valley ranch dressing mix|mayonnaise|sour cream|rye cocktail bread|dill weed
steps: place cream cheese , dressing mix , mayonnaise and sour cream in a bowl and mix together until well blended chill at least one hour for flavors to blend spread each bread slice with a tsp of the mixture top with a cucumber slice sprinkle with dill weed and arrange on platter

name: Cucumber orange salad
ingredients: cucumber|navel orange|peanuts|rice vinegar|sesame oil|salt and pepper
steps: combine all ingredients in a serving bowl and chill

name: Cucumber orange water
ingredients: cold water|english cucumbers|oranges
steps: combine all ingredients in a large pitcher cover and chill in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes serve

name: Cucumber pan rolls
ingredients: cucumber|low-fat sour cream|water|sugar|salt|all-purpose flour|active dry yeast|fresh chives|fresh dill
steps: place cucumber in a blender or food processor cover and process until smooth place 3 / 4 cup of puree in a saucepan add sour cream , water , sugar , and salt to pan heat to 120 to 130 degrees in a mixing bowl , combine 1 1 / 4 cups flour , yeast , chives and dill add cucumber mixture beat on low speed just until moistened beat on high for 3 minutes add enough remaining flour to form a stiff dough turn onto a floured surface knead until smooth and elastic , about 6 to 8 minutes place in a greased bowl , turning once to grease top cover and let rise in a warm place until doubled about 1 hour punch dough down let rest 10 minutes shape into 12 balls place in a 13 x 9 x 2" baking pan that has been sprayed with nonstick cooking spray cover and let rise until doubled , about 45 minutes bake at 375 for 30 to 35 minutes or until golden brown remove from pan and cool on a wire rack f ! or 10 minutes serve warm

name: Cucumber party bread
ingredients: cucumber|rye cocktail bread|salad dressing mix|cream cheese|dill weed
steps: peel and slice cucumber thinly mix cream cheese and dressing mix together in bowl spread cheese mix generously onto bread slice top with a cucumber slice sprinkle a pinchful of dillweed on top repeat make as many as you want depending upon party size

name: Cucumber party sandwiches
ingredients: cream cheese|mayonnaise|onions|cucumber|salt|bread
steps: prepare cucumber by peeling and grating press out water from cucumber in a medium bowl stir softened cream cheese with mayonnaise until fluffy add grated onions , cucumber and salt spread filling onto 7 slices of bread and top with 7 bread slices crust maybe be trimmed , if desired cut into quarters enjoy !

name: Cucumber pasta salad
ingredients: angel hair pasta|coleslaw dressing|cucumbers|green onions|sugar|red wine vinegar
steps: break pasta into thirds and cook until done and store in refrigerator to cool i usually add a little of the slaw dressing so it doesn't get too stuck together dice cucumbers into small cubes and cut onions mix all ingredients together it is as easy as that tastes even better after it has cooled for a while

name: Cucumber pasta salad with dill
ingredients: bow tie pasta|low-fat sour cream|2% low-fat milk|fresh dill|white vinegar|sea salt|fresh ground black pepper|cucumbers|chopped tomato
steps: follow package directions and boil the pasta until al dente drain and rinse in cold water in a small bowl wh isk together the sour cream and milk until smooth add the dill , vinegar , salt and pepper , whisking to smooth set aside mix the cukes and tomatoes with the cooled pasta pour dressing over top and toss well cover and chill 1 hour , up to 24 hours toss again and serve

name: Cucumber pineapple salad
ingredients: sugar|rice wine vinegar|water|salt|pineapple|cucumber|carrot|red onion|salad greens|toasted sesame seeds
steps: bring sugar , rice wine vinegar and water to a boil in a heavy saucepan stir constantly until reduced to about 1 / 2 cup , about 5 minutes transfer to a large bowl and place into refrigerator when chilled , add pineapple pieces cover and return to refrigerator for one hour add cucumber , carrot and red onion to the pineapple mixture mix well place salad greens onto plates top with pineapple mixture sprinkle with toasted sesame seeds , serve

name: Cucumber pineapple salsa
ingredients: pineapple tidbits|cucumbers|of fresh mint|brown sugar|lime juice|ground ginger|cilantro
steps: combine all ingredients in a mixing bowl and mix well best to cover and refrigerate a few hours for flavors to blend

name: Cucumber pineapple salsa with dried cranberries
ingredients: cucumber|pineapple|dried cranberries|vidalia onion|cilantro|jalapeno|lime juice|white vinegar|garlic clove|gingerroot|salt and pepper
steps: combine all ingredients chill and serve with grilled meats or use as a dip for chips

name: Cucumber pineapple soup
ingredients: fresh pineapple|seedless cucumber|green pepper|water|heavy cream|worcestershire sauce|salt and pepper
steps: add first 4 ingredients to a food processor and blend for 1 minute add remaining ingredients and process until combined pour through a mesh sieve into a bowl , pressing on solids , discard solids chill 30-60 minutes , serve

name: Cucumber pita wedges
ingredients: cream cheese|italian salad dressing mix|pita breads|cucumber|lemon-pepper seasoning
steps: in a mixing bowl , beat cream cheese and salad dressing mix until combined split pita breads in half , forming two circles spread cream cheese mixture over pita circles cut each into six wedges top with cucumbers sprinkle with lemon-pepper

name: Cucumber potato salad
ingredients: potatoes|cucumber|onion|chives|mayonnaise|basil|yogurt|wine vinegar|mustard|salt|black pepper|paprika
steps: combine potatoes , cucumber , onion & chives in a large bowl blend mayonnaise , yogurt , vinegar , mustard , salt and pepper in a small bowl pour over potato mixture and blend thoroughly refrigerate several hours sprinkle with paprika before serving

name: Cucumber quick salad
ingredients: cucumbers|sugar|rice vinegar|water
steps: rinse , dry , seed and slice cucumber place in bowl in separate bowl , mix sugar , water and vinegar pour over cucumbers and toss

name: Cucumber radish slaw
ingredients: english cucumbers|radish|sea salt|red onions|cider vinegar|olive oil|sugar|salt & freshly ground black pepper
steps: peel the cucumbers , halve lengthwise and scrape out the seeds thinly slice the cucumbers on the diagonal combine the cucumbers and radishes in a colander toss together with the sea salt top the vegetables with a plate that will fit inside the colander and weight the plate with a heavy item to help the veggies drain drain the vegetables in the sink for about 20 minutes , squeeze them between paper towels to dry , then transfer to a bowl combine the red onion , cider vinegar , olive oil and sugar pour over the cucumber and radishes toss to combine season with salt and freshly ground pepper to taste and serve immediately

name: Cucumber raita
ingredients: cucumber|plain yogurt|ground cumin|cayenne|ground pepper
steps: shred the cucumber with a hand grater squeeze out extra water with your hands mix all ingredients together , and refrigerate at least 8 hours to bring out the flavors mix again before serving you can use fresh cilantro or parsley as a garnish

name: Cucumber raita cucumber salad
ingredients: cucumber|plain yogurt|cumin|paprika|black pepper|salt|lime juice|mint
steps: 1 drain excess liquid from yoghurt by placing it in a mesh strainer or in cheesecloth for about half an hour 2 roughly chop the cucumber with its seeds and skin season with salt , black pepper , and lime juice set aside 3 transfer the drained yoghurt to a large bowl add cucumber mixture , cumin , and paprika mix well 4 allow the raita to chill for 10-15 minutes , then garnish with mint 5 serve as a cooling side dish with curried vegetables and rice

name: Cucumber raita salad
ingredients: mustard seeds|english cucumbers|salt & freshly ground black pepper|red onion|plain yogurt|lemon|garlic clove|fresh dill
steps: in a dry pan over medium heat , toast the mustard seeds until fragrant , about 2 minutes set aside add the cucumbers to a medium bowl season with three large pinches of salt and set aside for 10 minutes in the meantime , combine the red onion , yogurt , lemon juice , garlic , dill and mustard seeds in a large bowl and stir to combine pour off any excess liquid that has accumulated in the cucumber bowl and pat the cucumbers dry add the cucumbers to the yogurt mixture , mix well , and season to taste with salt and pepper

name: Cucumber raita super simple quick and easy
ingredients: cucumber|salt|plain yogurt|chili powder|ground cumin|fresh ground pepper|paprika
steps: drain the grated cucumber well so that you squeeze out as much moisture as possible add the yougurt , chili powder , ground cumin and salt and pepper to taste chill 30 minutes in refrigerator and stir well before serving dust the single cucumber slice in paprika and garnish goes well with poppadoms

name: Cucumber ranch chicken salad
ingredients: chicken breasts|green seedless grape|red seedless grapes|pecans|celery|mandarin oranges|ranch salad dressing
steps: in a salad bowl combine the chicken , grapes , pecans / almonds , celery , oranges and salad dressing toss to coat and serve !

name: Cucumber ranch dressing
ingredients: cucumber|shallot|light sour cream|low-fat buttermilk|mayonnaise|fresh lemon juice|salt|sugar|cayenne pepper|flat leaf parsley|fresh scallions|fresh dill
steps: stir together cucumber , shallot , sour cream , buttermilk , mayonnaise , lemon juice , salt , sugar , cayenne , parsley , scallions and dill , if using , in a bowl add additional salt and cayenne if needed the dressing can be refrigerated in an airtight container for up to 3 days enjoy !

name: Cucumber relish
ingredients: cucumbers|celery|onions|red bell peppers|canning salt|water|vinegar|sugar|mustard seeds|celery seeds
steps: combine cucumbers , celery , onion and peppers in a large bowl add salt and water cover and refrigerate overnight drain rinse and drain again combine remaining ingredients in a large kettle bring to a boil add vegetables simmer for 10 minutes ladle hot mixture into hot jars , leaving 1 / 4" headspace adjust caps process for 10 minutes in a boiling water bath

name: Cucumber relish topping for burgers
ingredients: dill seed|mustard seeds|cider vinegar|vegetable oil|country-style dijon mustard|cucumber|tomatoes|red onion
steps: combine dill , mustard seed , vinegar , oil and mustard in medium bowl add vegetables toss to coat

name: Cucumber roulades
ingredients: seedless cucumber|philadelphia chive & onion cream cheese spread|smoked salmon|fresh dill
steps: cut cucumber into 12 slices use melon baller to scoop out indentation in center of each fill with cream cheese spread top with salmon and dill

name: Cucumber rounds
ingredients: cucumbers|cream cheese|green onions|salt|pepper|white bread|paprika
steps: peel cucumbers and cut lengthwise into quarters remove seeds finely chop remove liquid by drying and pressing onto paper towel combine cream cheese , cucumbers , green onions , salt and pepper mix well cut rounds with cookie cutter from slices of bread , you can get two or three per slice spread with cucumber mix top with paprika or chili power

name: Cucumber rounds with blue cheese spread
ingredients: blue cheese|cream cheese|butter|worcestershire sauce|cucumbers|salted peanuts
steps: the day before serving , combine blue cheese , cream cheese and butter mix until well blended add worcestershire sauce mix well cover and refrigerate on serving day: slice cucumbers 1 / 4 inch thick , making about 100 rounds pat cucumber rounds dry with a paper towel spread about 1 teaspoon cheese mixture on each round sprinkle peanuts on top

name: Cucumber salad
ingredients: cucumbers|sour cream|fresh chives|salt|white balsamic vinegar|white pepper|sugar
steps: wash and slice cucumbers with thinnest setting on vegetable slicer place in large bowl add salt and toss cucumber slices optional step: pressing the cucumbers put a plate directly on top of cucumber slices in bowl place jars or cans on top of plate for weight to press the sliced cucumbers set the jars / cans inside a plastic bag to keep the salad sanitary , so they don't sit in the liquid let stand for about 20 minutes remove the weights and repeat process 2 more times , stirring each time before pressing stir in sour cream , vinegar , pepper , sugar and chives adjust seasonings to taste refrigerate until ready to serve if you skip the pressing of the cucumbers , the salad will still be delicious , but you'll have much more liquid in the bowl simply strain the salad with a slotted spoon when serving

name: Cucumber salad acar ketimun
ingredients: cucumbers|onion|white vinegar|oil|salt|pepper|garlic powder|sugar
steps: mix all ingredients together if you prefer a little heat , you can add slices of hot chili peppers to taste chill and marinate at least 30 minutes before serving

name: Cucumber salad agurkesalat
ingredients: cucumber|vinegar|caster sugar|water|chives|fresh ground black pepper|salt
steps: wash the cucumber and if the skin is tough , peel it slice thinly and place into a large bowl and sprinkle with salt toss to spread the salt evenly , then place a heavy weight on top of the cucumber mix and leave for about 15 minutes meanwhile mix the vinegar , water and sugar together and season with a little pepper the dressing should taste fairly sweet and not too sharp squeeze the cucumber in a cheesecloth to remove all the liquid place the cucumber in a serving bowl and pour over the dressing leave for a half an hour in fridge before serving add chopped chives or dill before serving if using

name: Cucumber salad turkish cacick
ingredients: garlic clove|wine vinegar|salt|fresh dill|plain yogurt|cucumbers|olive oil|fresh mint leaves
steps: in a bowl combine garlic , vinegar , salt , dill , and yoghurt and mix well blend cucumbers with yoghurt mixture and refrigerate for an hour or so serve sprinkled with olive oil and mint

name: Cucumber salad with horseradish mustard
ingredients: english cucumbers|kosher salt|cider vinegar|sugar|dry mustard|horseradish|fresh dill|onion
steps: slice cucumbers approximately 1 / 8 inch thick sprinkle sliced cucumbers with salt and let stand for 15 minutes rinse , drain and pat dry mix together the vinegar , sugar , mustard , horseradish and dill add to cucumbers along with the sliced onions let stand for 15 minutes this will keep in the refrigerator for a few days

name: Cucumber salad marinade
ingredients: white vinegar|water|sugar|cucumbers
steps: if using regular cucumbers , cut in half lengthwise and scoop out the seeds cut the cucumber halves in thin slices it also calls for a small white onion , thinly sliced place the cucumber and onion slices in a non-aluminum bowl and sprinkle with 1 / 2 t salt by the way , what did you do with the red cabbage ? stir together the vinegar , water and sugar , until the sugar dissolves pour over the cucumbers and let marinate for at least 15 minutes

name: Cucumber salad surprise
ingredients: cucumbers|sweet onion|jalapeno|celery|sour cream|salt and pepper|parsley|sunflower seeds
steps: peel and dice cucumbers quarter onion and slice paper-thin mince jalapeno cut celery in 1 / 4" dice toss all veggies together with sour cream and seasonings garnish with sunflower seeds if desired

name: Cucumber salad with a creamy dill dressing
ingredients: sour cream|mayonnaise|lime juice|fresh dill|english cucumbers|salt & freshly ground black pepper
steps: whisk together the sur cream , mayonnaise , lime juice and dill season to taste score the cucumbers lengthways with the tines of a fork slice 3mm thick and toss in the dressing serve on a platter

name: Cucumber salad with dill sour cream
ingredients: cucumbers|salt and pepper|sour cream|apple cider vinegar|fresh dill|sugar|red onion
steps: in a colander over a bowl , toss the prepared cucumbers with 2 tsps salt and let drain 1 hour in a large bowl , mix together sour cream , cider vinegar , dill and sugar add in the drained cucumbers and sliced onion toss to mix season with pepper , as desired

name: Cucumber salad with lemon dill dressing
ingredients: lemon juice|sugar|oil|salt|fresh ground pepper|fresh dill|cucumbers|scallions
steps: in a bowl , whisk lemon juice , oil and sugar until thick add dill , salt and pepper to taste mix inches add cucumbers and scallions , and coat well with dressing chill for 15 minutes and serve cool

name: Cucumber salad with oranges and mint
ingredients: english cucumber|mandarin oranges|fresh mint leaves|rice wine vinegar|extra virgin olive oil|salt|fresh ground pepper
steps: in a large bowl , combine cucumber , oranges , mint , vinegar , and oil toss to combine season , to taste , with salt and black pepper

name: Cucumber salad with pineapple and jalapeno
ingredients: sugar|white vinegar|water|salt|fresh pineapple chunk|cucumber|carrot|red onion|jalapeno|lettuce|sesame seeds
steps: bring first 4 ingredients to boil in heavy small saucepan , stirring until sugar dissolves simmer until reduced to 2 / 3 cup , about 4 minutes transfer syrup to large bowl and refrigerate until cold add pineapple to syrup cover and refrigerate 1 hour add cucumber and next 3 ingredients to pineapple mixture stir to coat line plates with lettuce leaves spoon salad atop lettuce sprinkle with sesame seeds and serve

name: Cucumber salad with rice vinegar dressing
ingredients: cucumbers|rice vinegar|sugar|dark sesame oil|salt|green onions|dry-roasted unsalted peanuts
steps: combine first 5 ingredients in a medium bowl toss to coat cucumber sprinkle with onions and peanuts before serving

name: Cucumber salad with rice wine vinegar
ingredients: toasted sesame seeds|cucumbers|rice wine vinegar|distilled white vinegar|sugar|kosher salt
steps: in a medium bowl , toss the cucumber slices with all the other ingredients , except sesame seeds cover , and refrigerate for at least an hour sprinkle with the toasted sesame seeds just before serving actually , i pick up a half pound at the health food store , rinse and drain them well , and then toast them in thedry skillet allow them to cool completely , and store them in the freezer until needed they will rapidly go rancid otherwise

name: Cucumber salad with sour cream
ingredients: cucumbers|garlic|sugar|salt|vinegar|sour cream
steps: peel cucumbers and slice very , very thin put in mixing bowl peel and chop clove of garlic , add to cucumber slices add salt , and sugar to cucumber slices mix in sour cream and vinegar and toss well , i use my hands , till cucumbers slices and sour cream are all frothy and foamy place in serving dish and sprinkle a little paprika on top for decoration , and serve well chilled

name: Cucumber salad with sour cream and chives german gurkensalat
ingredients: cucumbers|sour cream|fresh chives|salt & pepper
steps: peel cucumbers and slice them paper thin , and drain if watery in a medium bowl , mix together the sour cream and chives add cucumber slices and stir gently to coat season to taste with salt and pepper serve immediately , or cover and chill for up to one day

name: Cucumber salad with spicy wasabi dressing
ingredients: dry wasabi|cucumbers|rice wine vinegar|sugar|sesame oil|salt and black pepper|green onions|black sesame seeds
steps: mix the wasabi with 1 / 2 teaspoon warm water in the bottom of a mixing bowl and let it stand for 5 minutes peel the cucumbers , cut each one in half lengthwise , and use a melon baller or spoon to scoop out the seeds cut the cucumbers widthwise into 1 / 4-inch crescents add the vinegar and sugar to the wasabi and whisk until smooth whisk in the sesame oil , salt , and pepper just before serving , add the cucumbers , green onion , and sesame seeds to the dressing and mix well

name: Cucumber salad with tahini dressing
ingredients: tahini|lemons|minced garlic clove|cumin|coriander|cayenne pepper|fresh ground pepper|water|cucumbers
steps: stir the tahini and lemon juice together until well blended add the rest of the ingredients except the cucumbers and stir to blend allow the mixture to stand at room temperature for about 30 minutes if it is too thick to pour , you can use it as a dip for the cucumbers or you can thin it out with room temperature water which is what i do peel the cucumbers and slice them into rounds put them in a large bowl and pour the dressing over them toss to coat

name: Cucumber salad with tarragon dijon dressing
ingredients: cucumber|sweet onion|mixed baby greens|champagne vinegar|olive oil|salt and pepper|red wine vinegar|dijon mustard|honey|brown sugar|dry tarragon
steps: combine all salad ingredients in bowl and chill 30-45 minutes prior to serving whisk together all dressing ingredients and chill until ready to serve

name: Cucumber salad with thai vinaigrette dressing
ingredients: rice vinegar|thai sweet chili sauce|sesame oil|sugar|granulated garlic|kosher salt|cucumber|onion
steps: in a small bowl whisk together rice vinegar , sweet thai chili sauce , sesame oil , sugar , granulated garlic and salt place sliced cucumber and onion in another bowl pour vinaigrette over and toss to coat cover and refrigerate for 1 hour toss once more before serving i dont think it gets much easier than that enjoy ! :)

name: Cucumber salad with yogurt middle east palestine
ingredients: plain yogurt|cucumber|salt|garlic clove|of fresh mint
steps: stir yogurt until smooth add cucumber , salt , and garlic garnish with mint normally eaten with pita bread enjoy !

name: Cucumber salad swedish style
ingredients: cucumbers|salt|sugar|white vinegar
steps: wash cucumbers , dry off and remove the ends score the skins with the tines if a fork , dragging it the length of the cuke repeat all the way around slice cucumbers very , very thin place in a bowl sprinkle with salt and sugar add vinegar and press slightly with back of a spoon cover and refrigerate overnight keeps well in a covered jar the end result is similar to an uncooked pickle

name: Cucumber salsa
ingredients: cucumbers|tomatoes|green bell pepper|jalapeno pepper|onion|garlic|fresh lime juice|fresh parsley|fresh cilantro|dried dill weed|salt
steps: in a medium bowl stir together all ingredients cover and refrigerate at least one hour serve with tortilla chips

name: Cucumber salsa mexican style
ingredients: diced tomatoes|tomatoes|cucumber|diced green chilies|jalapenos|cilantro|green onions|garlic|lemon juice|lime juice|salt
steps: place all ingredients in blender you may need to do in 2 batches blenderize to desired consistency salt to taste if you like it chunkier , add extra diced cucumber , tomato , and green onion when placing in jars stores in glass jar in refrigerator up to 3 weeks serve with chips or food

name: Cucumber salsa relish
ingredients: cucumber|tomatoes|red onions|cilantro|salt|lemon juice|black pepper
steps: cut cucumber in half length-wise and scoop out the seeds with a spoon if using a seedless cucumber skip this step dice cucumber , tomatoand mix add lemon juice , red onion , salt , black pepper and finely chopped cilantro chill for 5 minutes then serve with your favorite dish !

name: Cucumber sambol pipinja sambola
ingredients: cucumber|salt|coconut milk|red chile|fresh green chile|onion|lemon juice
steps: peel cucumber and slice very thinly put in a bowl , sprinkle with salt and let stand for at least 30 minutes press out all liquid and if too salty , rinse with cold water drain well

name: Cucumber sancwiches
ingredients: philadelphia cream cheese|italian salad dressing mix|cucumbers|rye cocktail bread|paprika
steps: cream philadelphia cream cheese with package of good season's italian dressing let stand at room temperature for 15 minutes cut cucumber into very thin slides spread onto cocktail bread place cucumber slices on top , and garnish with spice of choice refrigerate on wax paper to separate nice presentation circles on squares

name: Cucumber sandwich at the empress
ingredients: white bread|cucumbers|butter|mayonnaise|salt and pepper|horseradish
steps: spread the butter and mayonnaise on both slices of bread add thinly sliced cucumber to one slice of bread add seasoning to cucumbers top with the other slice of bread cut off crusts and slice into squares or triangles sandwiches should be small for finger foods optional: add horseradish to the mayonnaise to give the sandwich a bit of a bite

name: Cucumber sandwich filling
ingredients: cream cheese|mayonnaise|cucumber|fresh dill weed|garlic salt
steps: press the cucumber through a colander to remove excess moisture process cream cheese and mayonnaise in a blender or food processor until smooth combine mixture , cucumber , dill and garlic salt chill until ready to use to allow flavors to blend

name: Cucumber sandwiches
ingredients: rye cocktail bread|light mayonnaise|cucumbers|lawry's seasoned salt|black pepper
steps: thinly slice the cucumbers approximately 1 / 8 inch thick or less i usually use the larger slices first , to completely cover the bread spread a thin layer of mayonnaise on each slice of rye bread top with a slice of cucumber lightly sprinkle each one with seasoned salt , then just a dash of black pepper may be eaten immediately if you prefer , however best if allowed to chill in the refrigerator before serving

name: Cucumber sandwiches 1 ww point each
ingredients: cucumbers|reduced-fat cream cheese|hidden valley ranch dressing mix|fat-free mayonnaise|fat free sour cream|pumpernickel cocktail bread|dill weed
steps: mix cream cheese , dressing mix , mayo and sour cream until well blended spread mixture on pumpernickel slices top with a slice of cucumber and sprinkle with dill weed enjoy !

name: Cucumber sauce
ingredients: cucumber|mayonnaise|plain yogurt|fresh parsley|lemon juice|onion
steps: peel cucumber and scoop out seeds grate coarsely to make 3 / 4 cup in 2 cup microwaveable bowl , measure , combine cucumber , mayonnaise , yogurt , parsley , lemon juice and onion microwave high 2-3 minutes or until warm

name: Cucumber sauce for fish seafood
ingredients: cucumber|sour cream|miracle whip|fresh chives|fresh lemon juice|salt and pepper
steps: mix the cuke with the sour cream , miracle whip , chives , lemon juice , salt& pepper mix well and chill until serving with hot or cold seafood

name: Cucumber sauce for gyros
ingredients: sour cream|mayonnaise|garlic powder|lemon juice|dried dill|cucumber|salt|pepper
steps: put the cucumber into a colander and sprinkle with a little salt let rest for 10-15 minutes to allow extra juices to escape the cucumber gently squeeze the cucumber in a paper or cloth towel put everything a bowl and mix well add salt and pepper to taste refrigerate for a couple of hours prior to using a turn or two in the food processor would yield a nice smooth sauce good on anything , especially gyros

name: Cucumber shrimp salad
ingredients: shrimp|english cucumbers|rice vinegar|sugar|soy sauce|wasabi powder|unsalted dry roasted peanuts|fresh parsley|green onion
steps: rinse and drain shrimp blot dry with papertowels to remove excess water slice the cucumbers thinly in a pretty bowl , combine the vinegar , sugar , soy sauce , and wasabi , then mix in the cucumbers and shrimp chill 20 minutes garnish with peanuts , parsley , and / or green onions just before serving

name: Cucumber shrimp san
ingredients: green onion|fat free cream cheese|fat-free mayonnaise|plain fat-free yogurt|dill|garlic|salt and pepper|sandwich bun|medium shrimp|cucumber|radish|lettuce leaf
steps: combine first seven ingredients in a bowl cut rolls in half horizontally and spread cream cheese mix over the cut sides put shrimp on bottom half , cover with cukes and radishes and a little lettuce top with upper slice of bread serve with fresh fruit

name: Cucumber shrimp spread
ingredients: small shrimp|cream cheese|garlic|cucumber|sour cream|green onions|ketchup|worcestershire sauce
steps: combine all ingredients and mix well serve with crackers the cucumber shrimp spread is a great appetizer the cucumber adds freshness and crunch and works well with the cream cheese and shrimp

name: Cucumber shrimp tea sandwiches
ingredients: green onion|light cream cheese|fat-free mayonnaise|plain low-fat yogurt|fresh dill|garlic salt|black pepper|small shrimp|cucumber|bread
steps: combine first 7 ingredients in a bowl trim the crusts from the bread slices spread the cream cheese mixture over the bread slices and cut into 4 triangles until you reach the number of shrimp you have arrange shrimp on each bread triangle arrange the cucumber evenly over shrimp chill , covered until serving

name: Cucumber side car
ingredients: cucumbers|onion|mayonnaise|sugar|celery seed|salt and pepper
steps: slice the cucumbers slice rings of onion add all ingredients and toss with vegetables make well in advance the liquid from the cucumbers blend and make a sauce

name: Cucumber slaw
ingredients: english cucumber|salt|chives|fresh dill|plain low-fat yogurt
steps: cut the cucumbers in quarters lengthwise , remove and discard the seeds coarsely grate the cucumber and place it in a bowl add the salt and stir well refrigerate for 2 hours then drain and rinse in a sieve , pressing to remove excess moisture mix the chives , dill and yogurt well and add to the cucumbers , stir to mix

name: Cucumber slices provenal betty crocker appetizer
ingredients: cucumber|sun-dried tomato|chevre cheese|fresh basil leaf
steps: make lines or indentations lengthwise down cucumber at 1 / 4-inch intervals , using vegetable peeler or tines of fork cut cucumber into 32 slices , 1 / 2 inch each place on paper towels to drain spread each slice with about 1 teaspoon tomato spread sprinkle each with about 1 / 2 teaspoon cheese serve immediately , or refrigerate up to 1 hour top each slice with basil leaf just before serving

name: Cucumber slices with onions
ingredients: sugar|white vinegar|water|salt|cucumber|onion
steps: slice cucumbers and onions in a medium bowl with a lid , mix the cucumbers , onion , and salt , tossing to coat evenly set aside for at least 30 minutes in a 1-cup measuring cup , combine sugar , vinegar , and water stir to combine after the cucumbers and onions have sat for at least half an hour , rinse off the salt then , pour the vinegar mixture over the cucumbers and onions and stir to coat refrigerate for at least 1 hour will keep for 1 week or more in the fridge with lid on if they last that long !

name: Cucumber slices with salmon mousse
ingredients: whipping cream|cream cheese|fresh lime juice|shallot|fresh dill|kosher salt|black pepper|smoked salmon|english cucumber|dill weed
steps: score the cucumber skins lengthwise with the tines of a fork slice them cross-wise 1 / 2-inch thick , scoop out a small amount making a hole in the centers with a melon baller sprinkle the cucumber rounds with a small amount of salt set aside in a mini processor or mixer combine the whipping cream and cream cheese , add the lime juice , shallot , dill , salt and pepper to taste fold in the smoked salmon just before serving place a mound of mousse in each cucumber round , garnish with dill weed and serve

name: Cucumber slices with smoked salmon and avocado cream
ingredients: cucumber|smoked salmon|fresh lemon juice|salt and pepper|avocado|sour cream|cayenne pepper|green onions
steps: cut 18 rounds from cucumber and save any leftover for another use top each round with a thin slice of salmon cut to fit drizzle a little lemon juice over the salmon , then season with salt and pepper place avocado , sour cream , 1 teaspoon pf lemon juice , salt , pepper , and cayenne pepper in a food processor and process until smooth and blended garnish each cucumber slice with a dollop of avocado cream and sprinkle with green onions

name: Cucumber smoked salmon rolls low carb
ingredients: seedless cucumber|cream cheese|chives|horseradish|salt|pepper|smoked salmon
steps: quarter cucumber lengthwise , cutting off and discarding rounded ends pat cucumber dry stir together cream cheese , chives , horseradish , salt , and pepper to taste until combined well arrange enough salmon to completely wrap 1 cucumber quarter in 1 layer on a sheet of plastic wrap , then spread with a thin layer of cream cheese mixture wrap coated salmon around cucumber quarter to cover completely , pressing gently to help it adhere repeat with remaining cucumber quarters cut rolls crosswise into 3 / 4-inch pieces

name: Cucumber soup soppa p gurka
ingredients: onion|potatoes|butter|water|tomatoes|cucumber|heavy cream|salt|pepper|parsley|sugar
steps: saute the onion in the butter / margarine add potatoes and water / vegetable broth cook until the potatoes crumbles add cucumber and tomatoes and cook another 5 minutes add the cream and salt , pepper and parsley to taste

name: Cucumber soup with wasabi avocado cream
ingredients: english cucumbers|water|seasoned rice wine vinegar|kosher salt|avocado|fresh lime juice|plain yogurt|wasabi|fresh chives|white pepper|ice cubes
steps: puree cucumbers with water , vinegar , and 2 teaspoons kosher salt in batches in a blender until smooth mash together avocado , lime juice , and remaining teaspoon kosher salt until smooth whisk in yogurt , wasabi paste , chives , and pepper , to taste just before serving , blend soup with ice in batches until smooth serve topped with avocado cream enjoy !

name: Cucumber spaghetti salad with dill
ingredients: angel hair pasta|coleslaw dressing|seasoning salt|pepper|dill weed|half-and-half cream|cucumbers|green onion
steps: cook pasta according to directions for "al dente" rinse drain well combine dressing , seasoned salt , pepper , dill weed , half & half stir together add cucumbers and onions set aside combine with pasta chill best when allowed to sit overnight so all the flavors and the sauce can absorb into the pasta

name: Cucumber spread
ingredients: cucumber|salt|cream cheese|mayonnaise|sour cream|tabasco sauce|lime juice|garlic powder|sun-dried tomato|green onions|salt and pepper
steps: peel , core , and seed the cucumber , then grate sprinkle cucumber with salt in a colander and toss let stand for 30 minutes , stirring once or twice , then remove and gently squeeze liquid from cucumber mix grated cucumber with remaining ingredients and chill for a least an hour before serving serve with crackers or bread

name: Cucumber sprout salad
ingredients: mung bean sprouts|cucumber|celery|lemon juice|extra virgin olive oil|fresh cilantro|sunflower seeds|salt and black pepper
steps: mix together the veggies and sprouts in a bowl whisk together the salt , pepper , lemon juice and olive oil in a separate bowl add to the salad and toss well to mix garnish with cilantro and sunflower seeds and serve at room temperature or slightly chilled

name: Cucumber stir fry
ingredients: cucumbers|canola oil|fresh ginger|garlic|green onion|shrimp|soy sauce|crushed red pepper flakes
steps: place a wok or heavy pan over high heat when wok is hot , add 1 tablespoon of the oil when oil is hot , add cucumbers and 1 tablespoon of the ginger and a couple of splashes of soy sauce stirfry until cucumbers are tender-crisp to the bite pour onto a platter and keep warm pour remaining 2 tablespoons oil into wok when oil is hot , add garlic , remaining 1 tablespoon ginger , onions , and shrimp / chicken / pork stirfry until all are cooked through add a couple of slashes of soy sauce during the last minute of cooking serve over hot rice

name: Cucumber strawberry salad
ingredients: fresh lime juice|green pepper|cucumber|fresh strawberries
steps: mix the lime juice and green pepper combine the cucumbers and strawberries in a serving bowl drizzle the lime juice and peppers in the bowl toss all ingredients to combine chill before serving

name: Cucumber stuffed with beef
ingredients: cucumber|spring onion|lemon juice|fish sauce|red chile|sugar|salt|lean beef|coriander leaves
steps: preheat the grill / broiler cut the cucumber into 1-inch sections , making alternate straight and zig zag cuts using sharp edged spoon , scoop out the centre of each piece of cucumber grill / broil the steak medium rare chop into fine pieces mix with the rest of the ingredients spoon into the cucumber cups and garnish with coriander leaves

name: Cucumber summer salad
ingredients: cucumbers|apple cider vinegar|mayonnaise|sugar|milk
steps: cut cucumbers into 1 / 4 inches slices , set aside whisk milk , vinegar , mayo , and sugar until smooth combine and serve , but best if chilled for half an hour

name: Cucumber tea sandwiches
ingredients: creme fraiche|dill|bread|seedless european cucumber
steps: combine creme fraiche and dill sandwich assembly: spread one side of each bread slice with the dilled creme fraiche layer the cucumber slices over half of the bread slices top with the remaining bread and slice each sandwich into four smaller triangular tea sandwiches pierce garnish with frilly toothpick and through the sandwich

name: Cucumber tea sandwiches with tarragon butter
ingredients: english cucumber|salt|white vinegar|unsalted butter|fresh tarragon|fresh chervil|whole wheat bread|watercress leaf|mayonnaise|fresh parsley
steps: put cucumber slices into a large , non-metal bowl toss with salt sprinkle with vinegar toss to mix well let stand 1 hour drain well in colander blend butter , tarragon and chervil to assemble , spread butter over 1 side of each bread slice cover 15 slices with cucumbers , dividing evenly close sandwiches trim crusts cut into 36 rectangles arrange on platter , garnished with watercress leaves optional: for looks , dip one end of a sandwich into mayonnaise , then into minced fresh parsley

name: Cucumber tomato macaroni salad
ingredients: elbow macaroni|cucumber|tomatoes|onion|green bell pepper|hard-boiled eggs|mayonnaise|miracle whip|prepared yellow mustard|celery salt|seasoning salt|black pepper
steps: in a large bowl , combine all ingredients toss to coat cover refrigerate overnight to blend flavors stir before serving

name: Cucumber tomato salad
ingredients: tomatoes|cucumber|green onion|italian salad dressing|vinegar|fresh basil|salt|pepper|garlic salt
steps: in a serving bowl , layer half of the tomatoes , all of the cucumber , then remaining tomatoes sprinkle with onion combine remaining ingredients in a jar with a tight fitting lid and shake well pour over salad cover and chill for 25 to 30 minutes or until ready to serve

name: Cucumber tomato salad with heat
ingredients: roma tomatoes|english cucumber|yellow onion|garlic cloves|jalapeno peppers|dill|white vinegar|fresh lemon juice|extra virgin olive oil|salt
steps: mix together the following ingredients: cucumber , tomato , onion , garlic , peppers , and dill spash over and mix in: vinegar , lemon juice , olive oil and salt refrigerate for an hour before serving

name: Cucumber tomato surprise salad raw recipe
ingredients: tomatoes|cucumber|avocado|lemon, juice of|sea salt|olive oil
steps: place veggies in a bowl mix together juice , salt and olive oil pour over top of veggies and stir

name: Cucumber tuna boat
ingredients: cucumbers|tuna|hard-boiled eggs|cheddar cheese|celery|mayonnaise|sweet pickle relish|onion|lemon juice|salt
steps: cut cucumber in half lengthwise remove and discard seeds cut a thin slice from bottom if necessary so they sit flat in a bowl , combine the remaining ingredients spoon into the cucumbers serve immediately

name: Cucumber turkey burgers
ingredients: lean ground turkey|cucumber|garlic salt|black pepper|rosemary|thyme|lemon juice
steps: dice cucumber in small sqaures & place in small bowl mix all seasonings and lemon juice into cucumbers pour cucumber mix into bigger bowl and add gound turkey smash & mix together with hands & then form into patties you can either use grill or spray frying pan with non-stick oil and heat on low-medium heat cook burgers 4-5 minutes on each side or untill done & eat with favorite bread or buns , we used pumpernickel rolls & it was amazing !

name: Cucumber under wraps
ingredients: cream cheese|flour tortillas|cucumber|salt|pepper
steps: spread 2 tbsp of cream cheese on each tortilla lay a cucumber spear at the edge of each tortilla sprinkle with salt and pepper roll each tortilla up around cucumber wrap tightly with plastic wrap and chill 1 hr before serving

name: Cucumber vegetable salad
ingredients: english cucumber|salt|yellow bell pepper|carrots|cherry tomatoes|red onion|cilantro|vegetable oil|rice vinegar|black pepper
steps: place cucumber slices in a colander , add salt , toss let stand over a bowl until juice has drained pat cucumbers dry and put in large salad bowl add remaining vegetables along with the cilantro and oil toss add vinegar and pepper toss

name: Cucumber vegetable salad with cilantro red onion
ingredients: english cucumber|salt|carrots|cherry tomatoes|red onion|fresh cilantro|vegetable oil|rice wine vinegar|ground black pepper
steps: toss cucumber slices with salt in a colander let stand in the sink or over a bowl until juice has drained , 30-45 minutes pat cucumbers dry with paper towels and turn into a large bowl add remaining vegetables , cilantro , and oil toss to coat add vinegar and pepper toss again

name: Cucumber vinaigrette
ingredients: english cucumber|sherry wine|dill|dijon mustard|pepper|garlic cloves
steps: put all the ingredients in a food processor and blend still lightly chunky refrigerate until serving

name: Cucumber vinegar
ingredients: cucumbers|peppercorn|white vinegar
steps: wash , slice but do not peel the cucumbers place in a clean crock , stainless or enamel pot add the peppercorns and sliced cukes in layers bring the vinegar to a boil pour over the cukes cover and steep for 3 weeks in a cool place strain through clean cheesecloth into another sterile container let stand 6 hours to settle ladle off the clear vinegar into sterile containers seal

name: Cucumber vinegar sauce
ingredients: distilled white vinegar|superfine sugar|sambal oelek|fresh coriander|cucumbers
steps: combine the first three ingredients in a small pan over medium heat and heat gently until sugar is dissolved and chili paste is thoroughly mixed remove from heat and pour into a bowl allow mixture to cool to room temperature stir in the coriander and the cucumber and serve immediately or , store in a well-sealed container in the refrigerator for as long as four days

name: Cucumber water recipe
ingredients: cucumber|water|mint sprigs|lemon|ice cube
steps: in a pitcher , mix the water , cucumber , 3 mint sprigs and lemon let it rest on the fridge for 24 hours if you prepare the water at the last minute , cut the first cucumber in three or four pieces then , squeeze the cucumber pieces to release all the juice before serving remove the cucumber slices used to flavor the water then stir with a wooden spoon , add some ice cubes , 6 or 7 fresh cucumber slices and the remaining 2 mint sprigs enjoy this refreshing drink

name: Cucumber with feta cheese and mint
ingredients: cucumber|feta cheese|mint leaf|olive oil|lemon juice|salt & pepper
steps: wash and dry the cucumber and cut it into very thin crosswise slices place the slices in a salad bowl , sprinkle with feta cheese and mint in a small whisk the oil and lemon juice with the salt and pepper to make a vinaigrette made with lemon juice pour over the salad and toss thoroughly serve immediately

name: Cucumber with feta cheese dressing
ingredients: cucumber|onions|lettuce|feta cheese|olive oil|lemon, juice of|dried oregano|pepper
steps: place a few lettuce leaves on each of four side plates slice the cucumber and onion very , very thinly , and divide the slices between the four plates , arranging them neatly on top of the lettuce chop the cheese very finely , and mix well with the olive oil , the juice of a lemon , the oregano and some freshly ground black pepper pour the dressing over the cucumber and onion on each plate , and serve

name: Cucumber with orange flower water
ingredients: cucumber|lemon juice|olive oil|salt|icing sugar|orange flower water
steps: peel the cucumbers , cut in half , remove the seeds then grate mix all the other ingredients in a bowl toss in the cucumber & chill until ready to serve

name: Cucumber yoghurt raita
ingredients: cucumber|spring onion|garlic clove|fresh ginger|of fresh mint|lemon juice|plain yogurt|salt and pepper|cumin seed
steps: combine cucumber , spring onion , garlic , ginger , mint , lemon juice and yoghurt in a bowl season with salt and pepper to taste cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes to allow flavours to blend sprinkle over cumin seeds just before serving and serve chilled

name: Cucumber yoghurt salad labaan bil kiyaar
ingredients: cucumbers|yoghurt|salt|cracked black pepper|dried mint|garlic clove|rose water
steps: place yoghurt into a bowl add garlic mint , rose water and spices to yoghurt mix well dice cucumbers into small pieces add cucumbers to yogurt serve

name: Cucumber yogurt chips with pita chips ww
ingredients: pita breads|english cucumber|greek yogurt|dill|ground cumin|salt|cayenne
steps: preheat oven to 400 degrees f to make chips , split each pita into 2 rounds , lightly coat both sides with pam and then cut each round into 8 wedges arrange in a single layer on baking sheet bake until crisp for 5-10 minutes and then transfer to rack to cool to make dip , stir together remaining ingredients in a medium bowl serve with pita chips and / or veggies

name: Cucumber yogurt dip
ingredients: plain yogurt|lemon, juice of|garlic cloves|cucumber|dried dill|salt & pepper
steps: to drain the yogurt , line a mesh colandar with cheesecloth or a coffee filter and hang over a bowl let the yogurt drain at least an hour or two , but no big deal if it is easier for you the night before if that is the case , make sure to cover the top and leave it in the fridge this can be skipped if you can get your hands on real greek yogurt , which is thicker than most commerical brands place the now thickened yorgurt to a bowl and add the other ingredients best if it sits for a bit to let the flavors combine , but with me , it is likely that it will get eaten long before you may keep leftovers in the fridge , but i find the raw garlic can get a bit intense upon sitting not that that is a bad thing , but consider yourself warned

name: Cucumber yogurt dip with cumin
ingredients: plain nonfat yogurt|cucumbers|red onions|of fresh mint|ground cumin
steps: in a small bowl , combine yogurt , cucumber , onion , mint and cumin add salt and pepper to taste mix well spoon the yogurt mixture into a strainer lined with coffee filter place a bowl under the strainer to catch the liquid that drains off cover and refrigerate 12 hours , discard liquid

name: Cucumber yogurt dip with greek pita chips
ingredients: seedless cucumber|plain yogurt|low-fat sour cream|lemon juice|all purpose greek seasoning|salt & freshly ground black pepper|whole grain pita|cooking spray
